scripts.text: Someone is giving a speech in a loud voice.
scripts.translation: 有人在用很大的聲音發表演講。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Please take it out of the bag and put it on top of my head.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
請把它從袋子裡拿出來，放在我的頭上。

scripts.text: Someone is giving a speech in a loud voice.
scripts.translation: 有人在用很大的聲音發表演講。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
I've received a signal that you've arrived at your local coordinates.
Is this the location I called you to?
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
我收到了訊號，顯示您已到達本地座標。
這就是我叫您來的地方嗎？

scripts.text: Correct
scripts.translation: 正確

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right, here we are.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，我們到了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think it's here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得這裡不對。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
That's odd, but it seems to fit with the information coming from Mini Elly right now, so let's check around.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
這很奇怪，但這似乎與迷你 艾莉目前傳來的資訊相符，所以我們四處看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Does the guest see anything suspicious?
I've never seen anyone who was neither an intruder nor a guest, but I know that those masked people are suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
客人看到什麼可疑的東西了嗎？
我從未見過既不是入侵者也不是客人的人，但我知道那些戴面具的人很可疑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Those people are residents here...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那些人都是這裡的居民...

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Isn't that an interesting outfit?
I'll remember that.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
那套衣服真有趣。
我會記住的。

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
...No.
We're not talking about peace with your neighbors or anything like that.
What we need is a slightly better future.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
...不。
我們不是在談論與鄰居的和平之類的事情。
我們需要的是一個稍微好一點的未

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
If this isn't repetition, what else can you call it?
How can we ignore this when it's clearly a sign of a divided country?
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
如果這不是重複，那還能叫什麼？
當這明顯是一個國家分裂的跡象時，我們怎麼能忽視它？

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
Why did this happen?
Why can't you respect the other person?
I'm sure everyone has their own thoughts, but I'd say this.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
為什麼會發生這種事？
為什麼你不能尊重他人？
我相信每個人都有自己的想法，但我想說。

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
What does it mean to you as a citizen of this country to entrust all your values to your birth lineage and commit violence against it?
What does it mean to you?
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
作為一個國家的公民，將你的所有價值觀託付給你的出生血統並對它施加暴力，這意味著什麼？
這對你來說意味著什麼？

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
Don't you think it's strange to get angry over such a story?
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
你不覺得因為這樣的故事而生氣很奇怪嗎？

scripts.text:
[Spokesman]
I don't wish for you to fight.
Unless we all come together, we have no future.
scripts.translation:
[發言人]
我不希望你們戰鬥。
除非我們團結起來，否則我們沒有未來。

scripts.text: The speaker continued their speech without paying any attention to the voice from the audience.
scripts.translation: 演講者繼續他們的演講，沒有理會觀眾席上的聲音。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
It's interesting. There are quite a few people wearing masks. It seems like even if we all have the same face like us, we can still distinguish each other.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
這很有趣。有很多人都戴著面具。看來即使我們都有像我們一樣的臉，我們仍然可以區分彼此。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Why is this person interrupting someone who is saying the right thing?
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
為什麼這個人要打斷一個正在說正確事情的人？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because I believe it's not right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因為我相信這是不對的。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
It seems like the fuss is getting louder.
Everyone seems to think they're right and don't want to listen to what anyone else has to say.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
看來騷動越來越大了。
每個人都覺得自己是對的，不想聽別人說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
The noise seems to be getting louder than before.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
噪音似乎比剛才更大了。

scripts.text:
[Nervous Priest]
What should we do... Should we intervene?
scripts.translation:
[緊張的牧師]
我們該怎麼辦...要介入嗎？

scripts.text:
The speech knows no end.
The atmosphere around is hostile.
scripts.translation:
演講沒有盡頭。
周圍的氣氛很敵對。

scripts.text:
The speech knows no end.
The unfortunate priest is looking the other way.
scripts.translation:
演講沒有盡頭。
不幸的牧師正看向別處。

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
Someone here gave a speech while wearing a mask?
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
這裡有人戴著面具發表演講？
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
Don't get me wrong, you outsiders might not know it, but we recognize each other through this half-covered mask.
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
別誤會，你們這些外人可能不知道，但我們能通過這種半遮面的面具認出彼此。

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
He's a brave man, no disguise.
You're probably the only one who can't tell the difference between him and me.
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
他是個勇敢的人，沒有偽裝。
你大概是唯一一個分不清我和他區別的人。

scripts.text:
[Masked Person]
Freya is love.
scripts.translation:
[蒙面人]
芙蕾雅是愛。

scripts.text: Where did the droopy Elly go?
scripts.translation: 垂頭喪氣的艾莉去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Please take it out of the bag and put it on top of my head.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
請把它從袋子裡拿出來，放在我的頭上。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Haha, the main gate is that way, adventurer.
You have to climb the stairs.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
哈哈，正門在那邊，冒險者。
你得爬樓梯上去。

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Maintenance work, as you can see.
...But I'm feeling a little uneasy.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
正如你所見，正在維護中。
...但我感覺有點不安。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Hmm. You're an adventurer.
I've been hearing a strange noise coming from the holy ground recently.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
嗯。你是冒險者。
最近我聽到聖地裡傳來奇怪的聲音。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
I think it's because of the accident a while ago...
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
我想是因為之前的那次事故...

scripts.text: Accident?
scripts.translation: 事故？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
(In a low voice)
There was a tiny accident of mana leakage in there.
The higher-ups are trying to hush it up, but I heard the accident caused some monster emergence.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
(低聲地)
那裡發生了一起微小的瑪娜洩漏事故。
高層正試圖掩蓋此事，但我聽說事故導致了一些魔物出現。

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
My superiors dismissed it as a hogwash,
but listen.
...Can't you hear this strange noise coming from below?
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
我的上級們把這當成胡扯，
但聽一下。
...你聽不到下面傳來的奇怪聲音嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
If this really is a monster, it means there's a monster trapped in the holy temple, which is a big problem.
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
如果這真的是魔物，那就意味著聖殿裡困著一隻魔物，這是個大問題。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Oh right! You can get rid of the monster for our goddess!
I'm sure the higher-ups will reprimand me for being indulgent, but I can't turn my eyes away from a monster problem!
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
對了！你可以為我們的女神消滅魔物！
我肯定會被上級責備我多管閒事，但我不能對魔物問題視而不見！

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
We should step up for the pope!
So? Are you up for it?
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
我們應該為教皇挺身而出！
那麼，你願意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
There would be fanatics who went mad and became monsters.
Kill ^4d4dffIsilla, Vanberk, and Hodremlin^000000.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
可能會有些狂熱者發瘋變成了魔物。
消滅^4d4dff依斯拉、凡貝爾克和邪惡妖精^000000。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Grr, I can't just stand by when monsters are rampaging in there...!
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
可惡，我不能眼睜睜看著魔物在裡面肆虐...

scripts.text:
[Eridanus]
Thank you for doing this.
Please be careful.
Take this ventilation shaft. It leads to the place where monsters are running amok.
scripts.translation:
[厄裡達努斯]
謝謝你願意幫忙。
請小心。
請走這個通風管道，它通往魔物肆虐的地方。

scripts.text: [Guard Dent] Hold on!! Hey! Can't you see the line? ^e5555eIf you're here to see ^000000Niren^000000, then follow the order!
scripts.translation: [衛兵 登特] 等一下！！ 喂！ 你沒看到隊伍嗎？ ^e5555e如果你要見^000000尼倫^000000，就請遵守秩序！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
There are really a lot of people.
But it'll be a problem if we don't meet Niren soon.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
人真的很多。
但如果我們再不快點見到尼倫，就會出問題的。

scripts.text: It's said to be an urgent matter.
scripts.translation: 據說這是緊急事務。

scripts.text: [Guard Dent] What? I'm in a hurry too, you know?
scripts.translation: [衛兵 登特] 什麼？ 我也很趕時間啊。

scripts.text: [Guard Dent] Ugh~ Do you even know how many times I've been dispatched to stop fights just today alone?! People keep fighting left and right, and it's driving us crazy too!
scripts.translation: [衛兵 登特] 唉~ 你知道我今天被派去制止了多少次鬥毆嗎？！ 到處都在打架，這也讓我們頭疼得要命！

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
They don't even pretend to listen when we try to stop the fights!
They've been fighting over whether they're ^e5555eimmigrants^000000 or ^e5555enatives^000000 for ages, but these days, it's really no joke!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
我們試圖制止鬥毆時，他們甚至都不裝裝樣子聽一下！
他們因為自己是^e5555e移民^000000還是^e5555e原住民^000000而爭吵了很久，但最近的情況真的非同小可！

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
They start yEllyng about ^e5555ediscrimination^000000 against natives as soon as we say anything...
Just thinking about it makes my headache.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
只要我們一開口，他們就開始抱怨對原住民的^e5555e歧視^000000...
光是想想就讓我頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Security Officer Dent]
How have you been lately? Neil?
scripts.translation:
[安保人員 登特]
尼爾，你最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
How have you been lately? Neil?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
尼爾，你最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
Sigh~
If only everyone would stop fighting for once...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
唉~
要是大家都能停止打架就好了...

scripts.text: [Guard Neil] Hey, cut it out! But still, you're better than me. You know as well as I do that. I'm a native.
scripts.translation: [衛兵 尼爾] 嘿，別這樣！ 不過，你比我強。 你也知道，我是原住民。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Before I even start talking, they tell me to call another security guard from a native.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
我還沒開口，他們就說要叫另一個原住民的保安來。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
I'm tired of hearing things like 'Do you even know who I am?' when it comes to my native background.
What do they even think the security guard is for!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
聽到“你知道我是誰嗎”這種話，還涉及我的原住民身份，我受夠了。
他們到底覺得保安是幹什麼的！

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
To be honest, things have been really strange lately.
Even people who never caused these problems before are getting involved in fights, turning small fights into big ones.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
說實話，最近事情真的很奇怪。
連以前從不惹事的人也開始捲入鬥毆，把小打小鬧變成大沖突。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Exactly!
It's been chaotic everywhere lately.
Now that I think about it, I also came to the temple yesterday.
The priest over there is the one who called me yesterday, right?
How's the temple these days?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
沒錯！
最近到處都很混亂。
說起來，我昨天也去了神殿。
那裡的牧師就是昨天給我打電話的人，對吧？
神殿最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Exactly!
Things have been chaotic everywhere lately.
Come to think of it, I was also at the temple yesterday.
Was the priest there the one who called me yesterday?
How's the temple these days?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
沒錯！
最近到處都很混亂。
說起來，我昨天也去了神殿。
那裡的牧師就是昨天給我打電話的人嗎？
神殿最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Ah~
Niren seems to be very busy...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
啊~
尼倫看起來非常忙...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Neil, did you happen to see ^e5555eMaram^000000 today?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
尼爾，你今天碰巧看到^e5555e瑪拉姆^000000了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Maram?
I think I saw him around the ^e5555eplaza^000000 on my way to the temple earlier...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
瑪拉姆？
我剛才去神殿的路上，好像在^e5555e廣場^000000附近看到過他...

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
I'm not sure if he's still at the plaza, but maybe we could ask the people there to find out where Maram went?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
我不確定他是否還在廣場，但也許我們可以問問那裡的人，看看瑪拉姆去了哪裡？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Hmm... I see.
The task I asked to {0} earlier, my son Maram will help with that.
He knows more about this matter than anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
嗯...我明白了。
我之前拜託{0}處理的事情，我的兒子瑪拉姆會協助你。
關於這件事，他比任何人都瞭解得多。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I would introduce him myself, but as you can see, I can't leave my post right now.
If you ask around ^e5555enear the plaza^000000, you should be able to find him.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我本想親自介紹你們認識，但正如你所見，我現在無法離開崗位。
如果你在^e5555e廣場附近^000000打聽一下，應該能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Ugh...
Where could High Priestess Niren have gone...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
唉...
大祭司 尼倫到底去哪兒了...

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
We always pray for the true faith and peace of mind of our believers.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
我們總是為信徒們的真正信仰和內心的平靜祈禱。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Ugh, enough with those scripted greetings~
I saw it myself, what~
And besides, if it's nothing serious, there's no reason for the priest to be standing here like this.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
唉，別唸那些套話了~
我都親眼看到了，真是的~
而且，如果不是什麼嚴重的事情，牧師也沒必要像這樣站在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
Don't we need to know the situation of the people these days so that the security guards can be prepared?
Especially since we don't know much about the situation of people coming to the temple.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
我們不是需要了解最近人們的情況，以便保安做好應對準備嗎？
尤其是對於來到神殿的人的情況，我們知之甚少。

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
Give us some information~
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
給我們提供一些資訊~

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
The temple is a place for praying for Priest Freya.
With a calm heart...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
神殿是向牧師 芙蕾雅祈禱的地方。
懷著平靜的心...

scripts.text:
[Guard Neil]
I saw it yesterday.
<FONT SIZE = 14>Here, in the middle of people fighting each other, this priest with half a mask off...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 尼爾]
我昨天看到了。
<FONT SIZE = 14>這裡，就在人們互相打鬥的中間，這位牧師半張面具都掉了...</FONT>

scripts.text: [Priest Freya] Oh no!!! Wait a moment! Stop right there!!!
scripts.translation: [牧師 芙蕾雅] 糟糕！！！ 等一下！ 站住！！！

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
<FONT SIZE = 10>Sigh...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
<FONT SIZE = 10>唉...</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Actually...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
其實...

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
It's true that there have been more people causing problems at the temple lately.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
確實，最近神殿裡惹事的人變多了。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Mostly, they're people venting personal grievances rather than raising official complaints, causing disturbances or shouting at the entrance of the temple.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
大多數情況下，他們是發洩個人恩怨，而不是提出正式投訴，在神殿入口處鬧事或大喊大叫。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Hold on...
Could we hear more details about this?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
等一下...
能讓我們聽聽更多細節嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
High Priestess Niren!!!!
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
大祭司 尼倫！！！

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Ah, well...
It's been common for people with personal grievances to come to the temple and shout, and we've been trying to calm them down and send them away,
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
啊，好吧...
最近經常有帶著個人恩怨的人來到神殿大喊大叫，我們一直在試圖安撫他們並讓他們離開，

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
But recently, there have been more incidents of physical fights among the people visiting the temple...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
但最近，來訪者之間發生肢體衝突的事件越來越多了...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Physical fights in the sacred temple...
Was there no way to resolve their grievances through dialogue?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
在神聖的神殿裡發生肢體衝突...
難道就沒有辦法通過對話來解決他們的矛盾嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Some people, even though we try to reconcile their opinions, accuse us of being heretics and cause disturbances, while others ask how long we will tolerate these heretics. It's not easy for us to resolve these situations.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
有些人，即使我們試圖調和他們的意見，也會指責我們是異端並製造騷亂；而另一些人則質問我們要容忍這些異端多久。要解決這些局面並不容易。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
But since they are complaining like that, it seems like they can't complain to Niren directly and take their anger out on the temple.
Because they know how important Niren values harmony
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
但他們既然這樣抱怨，看來是無法直接向尼倫投訴，只能把怒火發洩在神殿上。
因為他們知道尼倫多麼重視和諧。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sigh...
Heretics...
It seems that our efforts to eliminate discrimination haven't reached their hearts.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
唉...
異端...
看來我們消除歧視的努力並沒有真正走進他們的心裡。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Moreover, causing fights even at the temple is not an issue we can easily overlook.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
而且，在神殿裡引發打鬥，也不是我們可以輕易忽視的問題。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I've heard some disagreements to some extent, but... I may have been wrong to think that they would naturally resolve if we lived together, got to know each other, and understood each other.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我聽說過一些分歧，但...我可能錯了，以為只要大家生活在一起，互相瞭解，就能自然而然地化解這些矛盾。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
Even though the hardliners have stepped back, it's not easy for the hearts of those who supported them to change all at once.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
雖然強硬派已經退了一步，但支援他們的人的心意也不可能一下子改變。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Sadly, that's true.
The time we waited for self-healing has turned into the result of festering wounds.
Now, even dialogue for reconciliation won't be easy...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
令人遺憾的是，事實確實如此。
我們等待自我修復的時間，反而讓傷口潰爛了。
現在，即使想要通過對話來和解，恐怕也不容易...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
<FONT SIZE = 10>We need some kind of catalyst...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
<FONT SIZE = 10>我們需要某種催化劑...</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
High Priestess Niren.
How about this adventurer here as a catalyst?
They're a complete outsider.
Well... wouldn't it be possible to at least start a conversation?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
大祭司 尼倫。
不如就讓這位冒險者充當催化劑？
他們完全是個局外人。
嗯...至少應該可以開始對話吧？

scripts.text:
[Guard Dent]
Anyway, they came here to see you because they have something to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 登特]
總之，他們來這裡是因為有話要對您說。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Oh my...!
{0}!!!
I didn't even notice that {1} was here because I've been so distracted.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
哎呀...！
{0}！！！
我因為心事重重，竟然沒注意到{1}在這裡。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
As you can see, we're currently swamped with internal issues regarding ^e5555eRachel^000000.
But what is it that you want to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
如您所見，我們目前正忙於處理關於^e5555e拉赫^000000的內部問題。
但您想告訴我什麼呢？

scripts.text: About the intruder.
scripts.translation: 關於入侵者。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Ah...
<FONT SIZE = 10>It's a bit difficult to discuss that here.</FONT>
Please follow me.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
啊...
<FONT SIZE = 10>在這裡討論那個有點困難。</FONT>
請跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
It seems High Priestess Niren was looking for you. Did you not meet him?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
看來大祭司 尼倫一直在找您。您沒有見到她嗎？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
{0}, please follow me this way.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
{0}，請跟我來這邊。

scripts.text:
[Priest Freya]
We always pray for the sincere faith and peace of mind of our believers.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 芙蕾雅]
我們總是為信徒們的真誠信念和內心平靜祈禱。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It seems there won't be anyone listening here.
^e5555eEspecially on sensitive matters^000000 like this,
I apologize for having to discuss it in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
看來這裡沒有人會偷聽。
^e5555e尤其是在這種敏感問題上^000000，
抱歉，不得不在這樣的地方討論。

scripts.text: Explain about the intruder's identity.
scripts.translation: 解釋入侵者的身份。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
<FONT SIZE = 14>That's possible!!!</FONT>
^e5555eHeart Hunters^000000 are already targeting ^e5555eYmir's Heart fragments^000000, so we can't afford to ignore this!
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
<FONT SIZE = 14>這是有可能的！！！</FONT>
^e5555e心之獵手^000000已經在盯上^e5555e伊米爾之心碎片^000000了，所以我們不能對此掉以輕心！

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
They infiltrated so easily...
We need to immediately ^e5555eStrengthen the security near the Heart Vault^000000 and actively cooperate with ^e5555eRebEllyon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
他們竟然能如此輕易地潛入...
我們需要立即^e5555e加強心之寶庫附近的安全措施^000000，並主動與^e5555e叛逆艾利昂^000000合作。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
But no matter how much we reinforce the security near the Heart Vault, with the recent tense atmosphere among the residents, it's actually an ideal situation for intruders to run rampant.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
但無論我們如何加強心之寶庫附近的安全，鑑於最近居民之間緊張的氣氛，這反而成了入侵者肆意妄為的理想環境。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'll focus on reinforcing the security for now, so could I ask you, {0}, to ^e5555eMediate among the residents^000000?
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我目前會專注於加強安保，所以能否請你，{0}，去^e5555e調解居民之間的矛盾^000000？

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
No...
Rather than mediating, just listening to their stories and relaying them would be enough.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
不...
與其說是調解，不如說是傾聽他們的故事，並將這些情況轉達給我就足夠了。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
When making a decision that I thought would make many people happy, I failed to properly consider the feelings of those who didn't support that choice.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
當我做出一個自認為能讓大多數人開心的決定時，卻未能充分考慮到那些不支援該選擇的人的感受。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
It's not realistic to expect everyone to get along overnight.
Just...
If we can understand what the grievances are...
I believe we can start over.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
指望大家一夜之間和睦相處是不現實的。
只是...
如果我們能瞭解他們的不滿所在...
我相信我們可以重新開始。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Right now, it seems like nobody is willing to listen, but like Dent said, perhaps an outsider like {0} might be able to help with the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
目前看來，似乎沒有人願意傾聽，但正如丹特所說，也許像{0}這樣的局外人能夠促進對話。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
Human relationships are complicated.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
人際關係真是複雜。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Haha... indeed.
Shall we head back to the entrance of the temple for now?
^e5555eWe need to check with the security^000000 team as well...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
哈哈...確實如此。
我們先回到神殿入口吧？
^e5555e我們還需要與安保團隊確認情況^000000...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Right now, it seems like nobody is willing to listen, but like Dent said, perhaps an outsider like {0} might be able to help with the conversation.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
目前看來，似乎沒有人願意傾聽，但正如丹特所說，也許像{0}這樣的局外人能夠促進對話。

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
Shall we head back to the entrance of the temple for now?
^e5555eWe need to check with the security^000000 team as well...
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我們先回到神殿入口吧？
^e5555e我們還需要與安保團隊確認情況^000000...

scripts.text:
[High Priestess Niren]
I'm a bit busy right now...
Sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[大祭司 尼倫]
我現在有點忙...
抱歉。

scripts.text: Ask if they've seen Maram.
scripts.translation: 詢問是否見過瑪拉姆

scripts.text:
[Villager]
What?
I don't know!
Why would I know where that guy is.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
什麼？
我不知道！
我怎麼會知道那傢伙在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Come to think of it, you!
You're a new face around here...
scripts.translation:
[村民]
說起來，你！
你看起來是個新面孔...

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Why are you looking for him?
Is there something suspicious going on?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你為什麼要找他？
是不是有什麼可疑的事情？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
They're not very friendly.
Since they don't seem like they'll tell us where Maram is, let's ask someone else.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
他們不太友好。
既然他們似乎不會告訴我們瑪拉姆在哪裡，我們去問問別人吧。

scripts.text:

是不是有什麼可疑的事情？

既然他們似乎不會告訴我們瑪拉姆在哪裡，我們去問問別人吧。

scripts.text: Ask if they've seen Maram.
scripts.translation: 詢問是否見過瑪拉姆

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...

[Villager]
I'm not sure?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
我不確定？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
But who are you?
Why are you looking for Maram?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
但你是誰？
你為什麼要找瑪拉姆？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
How do you know Maram?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你認識瑪拉姆？

scripts.text:
[Elly]
This person doesn't seem like they'll tell us where Maram is either.
Let's ask someone else.
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
這個人似乎也不會告訴我們瑪拉姆在哪裡。
我們去問問別人吧。

Who are you?
Why are you looking for Maram?

scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
這個人似乎也不會告訴我們瑪拉姆在哪裡。
我們去問問別人吧。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...
Ask if they've seen Maram.
scripts.translation: 詢問是否見過瑪拉姆

scripts.text:
[Villager]
If you're looking for Maram, they mentioned having an appointment nearby.
They passed by here, so if you go ^e5555eUpwards^000000 from here, you might meet them.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
如果你在找瑪拉姆，他們提到附近有個約會。
他們剛才從這裡經過，如果你從這裡往^e5555e上方^000000走，也許能遇到他們。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
If you're looking for Maram, they mentioned having an appointment nearby.
They passed by here, so if you go ^e5555eUpwards^000000 from here, you might meet them.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
如果你在找瑪拉姆，他們提到附近有個約會。
他們剛才從這裡經過，如果你從這裡往^e5555e上方^000000走，也許能遇到他們。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
These days, the atmosphere in Rachel seems a bit gloomy.
Is there something going on?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
最近，拉赫的氣氛似乎有點陰沉。
發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I wonder when Miriam will arrive~
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
不知道米莉亞姆什麼時候會到~

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello.
I believe it's our first meeting. Is this your first time in Rachel?
May the blessings of Freyja be with you, traveler.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好。
我想這是我們第一次見面。這是你第一次來拉赫嗎？
願弗蕾雅的祝福與你同在，旅行者。

scripts.text: Deliver Niren's message.
scripts.translation: 轉交尼倫的信件

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah!
If it's a task entrusted by my mother, then I must do my best to help!!!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊！
如果是母親託付的任務，那我一定會全力以赴的！！！

scripts.text:
[Elly]
But we don't know much about the situation here. How can we mediate between people?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
但我們不太瞭解這裡的情況。我們怎麼能在人們之間進行調解呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
From my perspective...
Before mediating between people, I hope you understand the situation faced by the natives and our Gray Children.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
從我的角度來看...
在調解人們之前，我希望你能瞭解原住民和我們灰孩子所面臨的處境。

scripts.text: Who are the Gray Children?
scripts.translation: 什麼是灰孩子？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Rachel...
It's a city with a beautiful temple now, but it used to be a ^e5555eBarren Wasteland^000000 where the natives lived.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
拉赫...
現在是一座擁有美麗神殿的城市，但以前這裡是原住民居住的^e5555e荒蕪之地^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
But one day, ^e5555eFreyja's Disciples^000000 suddenly came and pushed the natives aside, building the temple.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
但有一天，^e5555e弗蕾雅的信徒^000000突然來到這裡，將原住民排擠到一邊，建造了神殿。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Some people who followed the temple to settle down here tried to live together with the newcomers, but ^e5555emany couldn't bear it and left^000000 or... some ^e5555esuffered^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
一些跟隨神殿定居下來的人試圖與新來者共同生活，但^e5555e許多人無法忍受而離開了^000000，或者...一些人^e5555e遭受了苦難^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It would have been good if those were just things of the past... but they've ^e5555econtinued until now^000000.
As a result, there are ^e5555echildren who have lost their place to go^000000, and I am one of them.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
如果那些只是過去的事就好了...但它們^e5555e一直持續到現在^000000。
結果，出現了^e5555e失去歸屬的孩子^000000，我就是其中之一。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
My adoptive mother, who felt sorry for us, adopted me. And since she became a high-ranking priestess, she has been leading the way in ^e5555eadopting us into the homes of wealthy immigrants^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我的養母同情我們，收養了我。由於她成為了高階女祭司，她一直引領著^e5555e將我們收養到富裕移民家庭^000000的工作。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Some people found this unacceptable and ^e5555ediscriminated against us^000000, calling us the Gray Children. But my mother hoped that we would become bridges between immigrants and natives.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
有些人認為這不可接受，^e5555e歧視我們^000000，稱我們為灰孩子。但我的母親希望我們能成為移民和原住民之間的橋梁。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
<FONT SIZE = 14>We couldn't fit in anywhere properly, just remained as an outsiders</FONT>.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我們無處容身，只能作為局外人存在</FONT>。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It would be better to hear such stories ^e5555edirectly from people^000000, but...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
最好能^e5555e直接聽當事人講述^000000這些故事，但是...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I have an ^e5555eimportant appointment with a friend^000000 right now, so could you please allow me to meet my friend and explain the situation later?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我現在有個^e5555e重要的約會^000000，能請您先讓我去見一下朋友，稍後再向您解釋情況嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The time we agreed to meet...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們約好的時間...

scripts.text:
[???]
It's already been 5 minutes, hasn't it?
scripts.translation:
[???]
已經過了5分鐘了吧？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
<FONT SIZE = 14>^e5555eMiriam!</FONT>
Since when have you been here?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>^e5555e米莉亞姆！</FONT>
你什麼時候來的？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
But more importantly...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
不過更重要的是...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh!
This is my ^e5555eFriend Miriam^000000.
Miriam, these are {0} and... Elly?
They've come to see me at my mother's request.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦！
這是我的^e5555e朋友米莉亞姆^000000。
米莉亞姆，這位是{0}，還有...艾莉？
她們是受我母親之託來找我的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh!
This is my ^e5555eFriend Miriam^000000.
Miriam, these are {0} and... Elly?
They've come to see me at my mother's request.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦！
這是我的^e5555e朋友米莉亞姆^000000。
米莉亞姆，這位是{0}，還有...艾莉？
她們是受我母親之託來找我的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'm sorry, {0} but could we leave after I quickly buy something?
It'll be quick if I just place the order.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
抱歉，{0}，能等我快速買完東西再走嗎？
只要下好單就會很快。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Buying the item isn't as easy as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
買東西並沒有我想像中那麼容易。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah!
{0}, you are here.
We've gathered the necessary personnel, although we're a bit short.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊！
{0}，你來了。
我們需要的人員已經集合了，雖然還差一點。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
When Miriam returns... Oh!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
等米莉亞姆回來...哦！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Oh!
It's Lord Niren's son!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哦！
是尼倫大人的兒子！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah, you're the ones who came looking for my mother last time.
Tamarin, Mark, and Maggi, right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊，你們是上次來找過我母親的人。
塔馬林、馬克和瑪姬，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Maram.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
瑪拉姆。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Miriam, you're back?
Did you find the clothes?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
米莉亞姆，你回來了？
找到衣服了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I brought some, but...
Is this enough?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
我帶了一些，但是...
這樣夠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]

We'll wear the clothes brought by Miriam and head to the top of this exotic town to move the goods.
I can't disclose the destination yet, so just follow me.

我們要穿上米莉亞姆帶來的衣服，前往這座異國城鎮的頂部運送貨物。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello.
Merchant Sreen.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好。
商人 斯林。

scripts.text: [Merchant Sreen] What are you here for! We have nothing to sell to you, get out from here!
scripts.translation: [商人 斯林] 你們來這裡幹什麼！ 我們沒有什麼東西要賣給你們，快從這裡滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Please don't say that.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
請別這麼說。

scripts.text: [Merchant Sreen] Just because of Niren, I won't forcibly chase you away!
scripts.translation: [商人 斯林] 看在尼倫的面子上，我才不強行趕你們走！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Stop it.</FONT>
Let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
<FONT SIZE = 14>住手。</FONT>
我們回去吧。

scripts.text: [Miriam] I apologize. Merchant Sreen.
scripts.translation: [米莉亞姆] 抱歉。 商人 斯林。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
But Miriam...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
可是米莉亞姆...

scripts.text: [Miriam] Let's go!
scripts.translation: [米莉亞姆] 我們走！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
You were so confident, but ended up looking embarrassed from the start.
Shall we try ^e5555eanother store^000000 then?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你之前那麼自信，結果一開始就碰了壁。
我們要不去^e5555e另一家店^000000試試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sreen]
Hmm... Have you come from another region?
scripts.translation:
[商人 斯林]
嗯...你們是從別的地區來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello.
Mr. Sannat.
Is Mrs. Sannat doing well too?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好。
桑納特先生。
桑納特夫人身體還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
Ah...
Okay...
What's the matter?
Maram.
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
啊...
好的...
有什麼事嗎？
瑪拉姆。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
...
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'm interested in buying some of the items listed here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我對這裡列出的一些商品很感興趣，想要購買。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
Ah... um...
I'm sorry, but we don't have much stock at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
啊...那個...
抱歉，我們目前庫存不多。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Then, could you please check the list and see if there are any items are available?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那麼，請核對一下清單，看看有沒有什麼商品是有貨的？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
Um...
I'm sorry, but the items we have here are all low in stock...
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
那個...
抱歉，我們這裡的商品庫存都很低...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's alright, even if they're a bit low in stock.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
沒關係，即使庫存少一點也沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
I'm sorry...
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Then, what about bread and meat...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那麼，麵包和肉呢...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Sannat]
Ah...
<FONT SIZE = 10>Those are already reserved...</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[商人 桑納特]
啊...
<FONT SIZE = 10>那些已經被預訂了...</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Maram]
...

[Maram]
Alright... I'm sorry.
Then, next time...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
好吧...抱歉。
那麼，下次再來...

<FONT SIZE = 10>Okay...</FONT>

...

scripts.text: Eat the food Maram ordered.
scripts.translation: 吃掉瑪拉姆點的食物

scripts.text: [Tamarin] Oh? Hey, {0}! Nice to see you!
scripts.translation: [塔馬林] 哦？ 嘿，{0}！ 見到你很高興！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
What a coincidence to meet here!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
真巧，在這裡遇到你！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Is the food here really good?
I tried it when I visited Rachel before and it was so delicious that I always make sure to visit this place whenever I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
這裡的食物真的很好吃嗎？
我之前去拉赫的時候嘗過，美味得讓我每次來這裡都會光顧這家店。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Excuse me, could I have one dumpling, please?</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
<FONT SIZE = 14>打擾一下，請給我一個餃子好嗎？</FONT>

scripts.text: Ask what they're doing.
scripts.translation: 詢問他們在做什麼

scripts.text: [Tamarin] Are you eating dumplings? Oh! Are you here in Rachel?
scripts.translation: [塔馬林] 你在吃餃子嗎？ 哦！ 你是在拉赫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Well... I can't go into details, but I received a request, and after meeting with Niren, I suddenly needed extra guards, so I brought Duran and Alph with me.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
嗯...我不能透露太多細節，但我收到了一項委託，在和尼倫會面後，我突然需要額外的衛兵，所以帶了杜蘭和阿爾夫一起來。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
So we're waiting for them, and if we have to wait too long, we might consider moving on to the next area...
But we'll see.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
所以我們在等他們，如果等得太久，我們可能會考慮前往下一個區域...
不過到時候再看吧。

scripts.text: Request assistance with the merchant disguise.
scripts.translation: 請求協助商人偽裝

scripts.text: [Tamarin] Oh! That sounds like a good idea. Let's go find Mark and Maggie and head over together. They're probably shopping near the square.
scripts.translation: [塔馬林] 哦！ 聽起來是個好主意。 我們去找馬克和瑪姬，一起過去吧。 他們應該在廣場附近購物。

scripts.text: Eat the food Maram ordered.
scripts.translation: 吃掉瑪拉姆點的食物

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Once you finish the dumplings, let's find Mark and Maggie and go together.
They're probably shopping near the square.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
做完餃子後，我們去找馬克和瑪姬，一起過去吧。
他們應該在廣場附近購物。

scripts.text: - The dumplings look delicious. -
scripts.translation: - 餃子看起來很美味。-

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hello.
{0}.

[Maggi]
Oh... Hello...

[Tamarin]
Mark, Maggi, are you done with your business?
{0} introduced you to a job, right?
We're going to meet the client now, so let's go together.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
馬克，瑪姬，你們忙完了嗎？
{0}給你們介紹了工作，對吧？
我們現在要去見客戶，一起走吧。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Oh...
I found the book Alph requested.
But I couldn't find the snacks that Dew asked for.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
哦...
我找到了阿爾夫要的那本書。
但是沒找到露要的零食。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then we can leave now.
Let's head to the meeting place.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那我們現在可以出發了。
去約定的地點吧。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Oh...
I found the book Alph requested.
But I couldn't find the snacks that Dew asked for.
scripts.translation:

哦...
我找到了阿爾夫要的那本書。
但是沒找到露要的零食。

scripts.text:

Then we can leave now.
Let's head to the meeting place.
scripts.translation:

那我們現在可以出發了。
去約定的地點吧。

scripts.text:
[Mark]
Hello
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[馬克]
你好
{0}。

scripts.text:
[Maggi]
Oh... Hello...

[Merchant Rencia]
Then please check if the ordered items are correct...
scripts.translation:
[商人 倫西婭]
那麼請確認訂購的物品是否正確...

scripts.text: Hand over the check.
scripts.translation: 遞交清單

scripts.text:
[Merchant Rencia]
Ah~
The amount is just right!
Thank you!
Please use our service again next time~!
scripts.translation:
[商人 倫西婭]
啊~
金額正好！
謝謝！
下次請繼續使用我們的服務~！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Before you leave {0}, let's ^e5555echeck the path outside the door^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
在你離開{0}之前，讓我們^e5555e檢查一下門外的路^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Before you leave {0}, let's ^e5555echeck the path outside the door^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
在你離開{0}之前，讓我們^e5555e檢查一下門外的路^000000。

scripts.text:
[Disguised Maram]
From now on, please escort {0} along with Miriam and Tamarin to ^e5555eOz Gorge^000000 located to the west.
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的 瑪拉姆]
從現在起，請和米莉亞姆、塔馬林一起護送{0}前往西邊的^e5555e歐茲峽谷^000000。

scripts.text:
[Disguised Maram]
Considering the circumstances, I don't think we can take all these people with us, so I'll send them back and follow afterwards.
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的 瑪拉姆]
考慮到情況，我覺得不能帶這麼多人，所以我會先送他們回去，然後隨後跟上。

scripts.text:
[Disguised Maram]
To avoid revealing our destination, it's best to move to a different location and send the people back.
scripts.translation:
[偽裝的 瑪拉姆]
為了避免暴露目的地，最好換個地方，把這些人送回去。

scripts.text:
[Merchant]
The wind is rough...
scripts.translation:
[商人]
風好大...

scripts.text: [Maram] Ah! Finally, I'm out!
scripts.translation: [瑪拉姆] 啊！ 終於出來了！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
If you head a bit ^e5555ewest^000000 from here, you'll find the entrance to the ^e5555evillage^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
從這裡往^e5555e西^000000走一點，就能找到^e5555e村莊^000000的入口。

scripts.text: Village?
scripts.translation: 村莊？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It's more like a ^e5555ehideout^000000 where people who fled from Rachel hide rather than a village.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
與其說是村莊，不如說是從拉赫逃出來的人們的^e5555e藏身處^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
It's better to see it for yourself than to hear me explain.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
與其聽我解釋，不如親自去看看。

scripts.text:
[Camper]
Hoooray~~~
Sometimes, camping like this isn't so bad~~~
scripts.translation:
[露營者]
耶~~~
偶爾像這樣露營也不錯~~~

scripts.text: [Maram] It's me! Me!
scripts.translation: [瑪拉姆] 是我！是我！

scripts.text:
[Camper]
You?
Do we know each other?
scripts.translation:
[露營者]
你？
我們認識嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你在說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Is this the reaction when you bring an ^e5555eoutsider^000000?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
這就是你帶^e5555e外人^000000進來的反應嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then I'll go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那我先走了。

scripts.text: [Maram] Oops!! Imril, wait a moment!!!!
scripts.translation: [瑪拉姆] 糟糕！！伊姆里爾，等一下！！！！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then I'll go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那我先走了。

scripts.text: [Maram] Oops!! Imril, wait a moment!!!!
scripts.translation: [瑪拉姆] 糟糕！！伊姆里爾，等一下！！！！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Suad is late...
What if she doesn't come at all?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
蘇阿德遲到了...
萬一她根本不來怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
We should return to Rachel.
If trust is already broken, ^e5555ewe might not be able to enter the village again.^000000
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
我們應該回到拉赫。
既然信任已經破裂，^e5555e我們可能再也無法進入村莊了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
But if we continue like this, the people in the village will only suffer more.
If necessary, even the help of outsiders...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
但如果我們繼續這樣下去，村裡的人只會遭受更多苦難。
如果有必要，甚至需要外人的幫助...

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
You don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
你不懂。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
...

[Maram]
I also... want to understand... you all...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我也想...理解...你們...

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
...

scripts.text:
[Suad]
To bring an outsider without any consultation...
Consider yourself fortunate that I came to hear your last excuse, considering our past relationship.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
未經商量就帶外人進來...
考慮到我們過去的關係，你能來聽你最後的辯解，算是你運氣好。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Suad!
Bringing an outsider to the village entrance without saying a word was reckless of me!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
蘇阿德！
我一聲不吭就把外人帶到村口，真是魯莽了！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
But these individuals are trustworthy enough for Mother to entrust important tasks to them!
There's no need to worry; nothing bad will happen!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
但這些人足夠可靠，連母親都願意把重要任務託付給他們！
不用擔心，不會出事的！

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Is Niren giving you that much trust to handle tasks?
What does it matter if you have Niren's trust?
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
尼倫給你那麼多信任去處理任務？
就算有尼倫的信任又怎樣？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Niren doesn't even know that you're delivering goods here.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
<FONT SIZE = 14>尼倫甚至不知道你們在拉赫運送貨物。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那是...

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Stop mocking Suad.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
別嘲笑蘇阿德。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
I'm not mocking.
I'm just stating the truth...
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
我沒有嘲笑。
我只是在陳述事實...

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
If it's the truth, ^e5555ethen in Rachel, we won't have anyone to sell goods to us anymore,^000000 and we'll all starve to death like this.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
如果是事實，^e5555e那麼在拉赫，我們就再也沒人賣東西給我們了，^000000大家都會像這樣餓死。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
You can buy goods from Veins or other villages, but ^e5555ethe number of people who can pass through Oz Labyrinth is decreasing.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你可以從伯仁斯或其他村莊購買貨物，但^e5555e能穿過歐茲迷宮的人正在減少。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
For now, ^e5555eif you have combat skills, you can pass by killing monsters,^000000 but later it might not be about combat skills; ^e5555ethe entire maze might be locked in lava.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
目前，^e5555e如果你有戰鬥技巧，可以通過擊殺魔物穿過，^000000但之後可能就不只是戰鬥技巧的問題了；^e5555e整個迷宮可能會被熔岩封鎖。^000000

scripts.text:
[Maram]
By then, the people who could help wouldn't even be able to come this far.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
到那時，那些能幫忙的人甚至無法走到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
And if only ^e5555emediation between the natives and immigrants requested by Mother could be achieved, we could cross Oz's Gorge again with a bridge!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
如果母親要求的^e5555e原住民與移民之間的調解能夠達成，我們就能再次通過奧茲峽谷，架起一座橋！

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Mediation? It seems like Niren is having another dreamy idea.
Just like when the ^e5555egray children^000000 appeared.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
調解？看來尼倫又在做白日夢了。
就像那些^e5555e格雷孩子^000000出現時一樣。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
But thanks to that, we were able to avoid hunger, and now we can help the children in the village.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
但多虧了他們，我們避免了飢餓，現在還能幫助村裡的孩子們。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Fine.
Then let's give them a chance.
Just like Niren gave us a chance.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
好吧。
那就給他們一個機會。
就像尼倫給我們機會一樣。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
What?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Really?!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
真的嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Seriously?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
What is it?
That reaction.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
怎麼了？
你們這反應。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
No~ No~
Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
不~不~
謝謝你~

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Then let's go to the ^e5555eVillage^000000 before Suad changes his mind!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那在蘇阿德改變主意之前，我們去^e5555e村莊^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let's discuss the details inside.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們去裡面討論細節。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Then let's hurry and go to the ^e5555evillage^000000 before Suad changes his mind!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那我們快點去^e5555e村莊^000000吧，趁蘇阿德還沒改變主意！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let's discuss the details inside.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們去裡面討論細節。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hoo~
Shall we try lighting a campfire or something?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
呼~
我們要不要試著生個篝火什麼的？

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 您當前攜帶的物品 -
- 數量過多。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再次嘗試。 -

scripts.text:
[Imril]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Hey!</FONT>
You really came in, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
<FONT SIZE = 14>嘿！</FONT>
你真的進來了，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
I did convey the message.
But ^e5555eSuad^000000 won't allow outsiders to enter the village!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
我確實傳達了訊息。
但是^e5555e蘇阿德^000000不允許外人進入村莊！

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
That probably indicates that the village situation isn't that good.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
這大概說明村莊的情況並不太好。

scripts.text:
[Elly]
It's difficult to be self-sufficient in this environment.
Even the trees are as hard as rocks.
Or perhaps they're not trees, but rocks?
scripts.translation:
[艾莉]
在這種環境下想要自給自足很難。
連樹木都堅硬得像岩石。
或者它們根本不是樹，而是岩石？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I think the situation will improve if we can receive a little help from the outside.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我覺得如果能得到外界的一點幫助，情況會有所改善。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
That would be good if it happens.
Suad may not have said it, but he must have been thinking about it for quite some time.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
如果真能那樣就好了。
蘇阿德雖然沒有明說，但他肯定已經思考這個問題很久了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
And it seems that {0}'s help with purchasing items was effective!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
看來{0}在採購物資方面的幫助很有效！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
^e5555eThey may say that entry is only permitted when acquiring supplies^000000, but once they realize that you're ^e5555esomeone trustworthy^000000, they might feel more at ease.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
^e5555e他們可能會說只有採購物資時才允許進入^000000，但一旦他們意識到你是^e5555e值得信賴的人^000000，可能會感到更安心。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
So, shall we start by talking to ^e5555ethe villagers^000000 for now?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那麼，我們要不先和^e5555e村民們^000000聊聊？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
^e5555eListening to the stories^000000 of the people and getting to know them might reveal ^e5555ethe key to what my mother entrusted^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
^e5555e傾聽^000000人們的故事並瞭解他們，或許能發現^e5555e母親託付之事的關鍵^000000。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Thanks to you, I was able to safely pass through ^e5555eOz Labyrinth^000000.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
多虧了你，我才能安全通過^e5555e歐茲迷宮^000000。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
In the past, as long as I was careful, traveling alone wasn't a big issue. But these days, it's getting harder to go alone.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
過去只要小心一點，獨自旅行並不是大問題。但最近，獨自行動變得越來越難了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Considering our village's current situation, I can't always have an escort, and besides, it's risky to attract attention by traveling in a group.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
考慮到我們村莊目前的情況，我不能總是帶著護衛，而且成群結隊地旅行也會引起注意，很危險。

scripts.text: [Imril] It would be great if we could investigate deeper into Oz Labyrinth. Status of the lava... Distribution of monsters...
scripts.translation: [伊姆里爾] 如果我們能深入調查歐茲迷宮就好了。 熔岩的狀況... 魔物的分佈...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hmm...
Adventurer, since you're strong, would you accompany me to ^e5555eOz Labyrinth when you have some free time^000000?
It might be a shameless request, but it's not every day that I have the chance to meet someone as strong as an adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
嗯...
冒險者，既然你很強，等你有空的時候，能陪我去^e5555e歐茲迷宮^000000嗎？
這也許是個厚臉皮的請求，但能遇到像你這樣強大的冒險者，機會可不多。

scripts.text: Depart now!
scripts.translation: 現在出發！

scripts.text: Later...
scripts.translation: 稍後...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Alright!
If you're busy right now, I guess there's nothing to be done.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
好的！
如果你現在很忙，那也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
If you have time later, will you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
如果你之後有空，能和我一起去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Wow!
Really?
You're willingly accepting my request like this? I'm touched!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
哇！
真的嗎？
你竟然這麼爽快地答應了我的請求？我真的很感動！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then let's meet at ^e5555eOz Labyrinth entrance^000000 first!
You remember the way, right?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那我們先在^e5555e歐茲迷宮入口^000000集合吧！
你還記得路吧？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
The monsters that were moving or dealing with lava are obstacles.
It would be great if there were a way to completely eliminate them.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那些正在搬運貨物或處理熔岩的魔物是障礙物。
如果能徹底消滅它們就好了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Ah...
My skin feels prickly.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
啊...
皮膚有點刺痛。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Where's the fool who dared to venture deep into the maze with such attire?
Be grateful you're not roasted alive!
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
那個敢穿著這種衣服深入迷宮的笨蛋在哪裡？
沒被烤熟真是萬幸！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, no matter what you say!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
總之，不管你說什麼！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, ^e5555eOz Labyrinth situation is getting worse^000000.
^e5555eThe lava area is expanding^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
總之，^e5555e歐茲迷宮的情況正在惡化^000000。
^e5555e熔岩區域正在擴大^000000。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
At this rate, there won't be much time left to navigate through Maze of Oz.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
照這樣下去，留給我們在歐茲迷宮中行動的時間不多了。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Indeed, if the lava has spread to that extent, we need a solution as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
確實，如果熔岩擴散到這種程度，我們需要儘快找到解決方案。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
For now...
To send workers, we need to reduce the number of monsters in Maze of Oz.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
目前...
為了派遣工人，我們需要減少歐茲迷宮中的魔物數量。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou receive a favorable evaluation about you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你獲得了良好的評價。^000000

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Monsters that were moving luggage or dealing with lava are obstacles.
It would be great if there were a way to eliminate them completely.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那些正在搬運貨物或處理熔岩的魔物是障礙物。
如果能徹底消滅它們就好了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
What do you say, adventurer?
^e5555eInterested in monster extermination^000000?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
你覺得如何，冒險者？
^e5555e對消滅魔物感興趣嗎^000000？

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Imril]
You did a great job today. Thank you.
Will you help me tomorrow too?.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
你今天做得很好，謝謝。
明天也願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555ePlease defeat about 20 {0} on the 1st floor of Oz Labyrinth.^000000
Even if the number of monsters decreases slightly, it will greatly help travelers passing through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
^e5555e請在歐茲迷宮1樓擊敗大約20只{0}。^000000
即使魔物數量減少一點，也能極大地幫助通過迷宮的旅行者。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Stop here.
scripts.translation: 到此為止

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Why~? Are you busy?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
為什麼~？你很忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then be careful on your way back~
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那回去路上小心~

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555ePlease defeat about 20 {0} on the 1st floor of Oz Labyrinth.^000000
Even if the number of monsters decreases slightly, it will greatly help travelers passing through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
^e5555e請在歐茲迷宮1樓擊敗大約20只{0}。^000000
即使魔物數量減少一點，也能極大地幫助通過迷宮的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Are you done already?
Because it's reliable!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
已經完成了嗎？
因為很可靠！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
This is still too dangerous, so ^ff0000wait until you're around level 200^000000 to try again!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
這還是很危險，所以^ff0000請等到等級200左右^000000再嘗試！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
You did a great job today. Thank you.
Will you help me tomorrow too?.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
你今天做得很好，謝謝。
明天也願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555eDefeat about 20^000000 {0} in the second floor of the maze of Oz.
Because even a small reduction in the number of monsters will be of great help to the hawkers who pass through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
^e5555e在歐茲迷宮2樓擊敗大約20只^000000{0}。
因為即使魔物數量減少一點，也能極大地幫助通過迷宮的商人。

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Then be careful and go there~
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
那麼請小心，去吧~

scripts.text:
[Imril]
^e5555eDefeat about 20^000000 {0} in the second floor of the maze of Oz.
Because even a small reduction in the number of monsters will be of great help to the hawkers who pass through the maze.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
^e5555e在歐茲迷宮2樓擊敗大約20只^000000{0}。
因為即使魔物數量減少一點，也能極大地幫助通過迷宮的商人。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Are you done already?
Because it's reliable!
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
已經完成了嗎？
因為很可靠！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Why~? Are you busy?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
為什麼~？你很忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Village Boy]
The tournament is about to begin.
It's not a small-scale meeting that happens frequently; it's a tournament where trustworthy people from all around participate!
scripts.translation:
[村裡的男孩]
比賽馬上就要開始了。
這不是經常舉行的小型聚會，而是各地值得信賴的人們都會參加的錦標賽！

scripts.text:
[Village Boy]
<NAVI>[Over there]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is where you should go. There's a spot for the adventurer too.
Of course, now that you're an adventurer, you're someone we can trust.
scripts.translation:
[村裡的男孩]
<NAVI>[那邊]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>就是你要去的地方。那裡也有冒險者的位置。
當然，既然你是冒險者，就是我們可以信賴的人。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
The meeting is about to start! Not just any meeting, but a competition!
<NAVI>[People]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> They're gathered together. Adventurers, go quickly!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
會議馬上就要開始了！不是普通的會議，而是比賽！
<NAVI>[人們]<INFO>wolfvill,144,151,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>他們聚集在一起了。冒險者，快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Boy]
In our village, meetings are held frequently. Everyone gathers to share their opinions at those times.
But competitions are different! It's a really important occasion!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
在我們村子裡，經常舉行聚會。大家都會聚在一起分享意見。
但比賽不一樣！那是非常重要的場合！

scripts.text:
[Boy]
Of course, not just anyone can participate.
They said only trustworthy friends from the village can join.
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
當然，不是誰都能參加的。
他們說只有村裡值得信賴的朋友才能加入。

scripts.text:
[Boy]
Can adventurers participate in the event too?
Well, that's up to you, the adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[男孩]
冒險者也能參加這個活動嗎？
嗯，這取決於你，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
You have arrived. The business of 'Bearded Jack' is a hardware store.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
你來了。“大鬍子 傑克”的生意是一家五金店。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Welcome. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
歡迎光臨。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
When it comes to kitchen knives and pots, there's no place like our shop in Rachel.
Take your time looking around.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
說到廚刀和鍋具，拉赫沒有哪家店比得上我們。
請慢慢看。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Uh, we came looking for something a little different.
What was that, Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
呃，我們想找點不一樣的東西。
怎麼了，冒險者？

scripts.text: Smelly Sock
scripts.translation: 臭襪子

scripts.text: Smelly Dandelion
scripts.translation: 臭蒲公英

scripts.text: Scented Sock
scripts.translation: 香襪子

scripts.text: Scented Dandelion
scripts.translation: 香蒲公英

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Hmm, I don't think that was it.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
嗯，我覺得不是那個。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Why would you find such dirty things in our store?
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
你為什麼會在我們店裡找這麼髒的東西？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Well, look who's finally arrived.
Did you come to check out the place where the fragrant dandelions bloom?
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
哎呀，你終於來了。
你是來參觀香蒲公英盛開的地方嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Go to Veins. You'll find me there.
In a corner of Veins Village, there's a weapon merchant that not many people know about.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
去伯仁斯。你會在那裡找到我。
在伯仁斯村的一個角落，有一家鮮為人知的武器商店。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
If anyone asks who recommended you, just say it's Jack's recommendation, of course.
They're probably just doing business for a short time so they can hit and run quickly. so if you're too late, they won't deal with you
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
如果有人問是誰推薦你的，就說當然是傑克的推薦。
他們可能只是短期做生意，所以會很快收攤。如果你來晚了，他們就不會接待你了。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Well, after connecting to <NAVI>[Weapon Shop]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> it's not under my jurisdiction anymore.
Well then, give it your best shot.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
好吧，既然你連線到了<NAVI>[武器商店]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，那就不歸我管了。
那麼，加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
Um, I don't think it was.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
嗯，我覺得不是那個。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
No, our store is a hardware store, not a laundry.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
不，我們的店是五金店，不是洗衣店。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Well, <NAVI>[Weapon Merchant]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is not under my jurisdiction since you linked it.
Then do your best.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
好吧，既然你連線到了<NAVI>[武器商人]<INFO>veins,293,282,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，那就不歸我管了。
那麼，加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
Welcome. This is 'Bearded Jack' hardware store.
We sell very well-made kitchen knives and pots.
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
歡迎光臨。這裡是“大鬍子 傑克”五金店。
我們出售做工精良的廚刀和鍋具。

scripts.text:
[Bearded Jack]
My name? Of course, it's Bearded Jack.
This store is all mine!
scripts.translation:
[大鬍子 傑克]
我的名字？當然是大鬍子 傑克。
這家店全是我的！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello~
Are you in business?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好~
你們在營業嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
We're closed.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
我們已打烊。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Don't be like that. I came here because Jack introduced me, saying there are smelly dandelions here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
別這樣。我是傑克介紹來的，他說這裡有臭臭的蒲公英。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Who is it, Dandelion, who is it!
hich jerk came up with such a strange password!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
我是誰，蒲公英，我是誰！
是哪個混蛋想出了這麼奇怪的密碼！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah, your name is... So, it was Dandelion.
For something related to security, it's quite simple, isn't it.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊，你的名字是...所以，是蒲公英。
作為安全措施來說，這太簡單了，不是嗎。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Anyway, what's going on!
If you came to buy weapons, just take what you need without hesitation.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
總之，有什麼事！
如果你是來買武器的，儘管拿你需要的，不用猶豫。

scripts.text: I came here to buy some weapons...
scripts.translation: 我來這裡買些武器...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Right? What the adventurer is saying is correct.
Rather than coming to buy one or two weapons, it's more like a bulk purchase, shall we say?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
對吧？冒險者說得對。
與其說是買一兩件武器，不如說是批次採購，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Bulk purchase? How much are you planning to buy?
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
批次採購？你打算買多少？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Well, roughly this much?
Is this amount acceptable at this store?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
嗯，大概這麼多？
這個數量在這家店可以嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Gulp, th-that much? Are you suggesting war?
W-well, if you give me a little time, it seems possible.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
咕，那...那麼多？你是在暗示要開戰嗎？
那...好吧，如果給我一點時間，似乎也是可能的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What should we do? We don't have much time.
I hope we can find it as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我們該怎麼辦？我們沒有太多時間。
希望能儘快找到。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Call your schedule. I'll try to accommodate as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
叫你的日程。我會盡快安排。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's good too, but how about connecting us directly with the supplier?
We'll take care of the intermediary fees without any inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那樣也好，但為什麼不直接把我們和供應商連線起來？
我們會處理中間費用，不會給你添麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Hey! Who's revealing the background while doing business!
Enough, go back, go back!
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
嘿！做生意的時候誰在暴露背景啊！
夠了，回去，快回去！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hey, who are you kidding? I already know everything. Selling this at such a special price is just a flashy business strategy, right?
Anyway, we're not going to have a long-term business relationship, are we?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
嘿，你在逗誰呢？我什麼都知道了。以這種特價出售，不過是一種花哨的商業策略罷了，對吧？
總之，我們不會建立長期的商業關係，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
So, I'm just asking for a bit of information from your end.
Whether it's our urgent situation or the guy taking off the intermediary fee, either works. Isn't it a win-win?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
所以，我只是想從你這裡打聽一點訊息。
無論是我們緊急的情況，還是那個拿走中間費的人，都行。這不是雙贏嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Mmm... Alright. But absolutely do not leak it.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
嗯...好吧。但絕對不要洩露出去。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Such obvious words.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
真是顯而易見的話。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
It's the Thor Volcano. Deep inside, there's a secret base, and the weapons come from there.
I'm letting you know because once their stock there runs out, the deal is going to be cut off anyway.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
是索爾火山。深處有一個秘密基地，武器就是從那來的。
我告訴你，是因為等那裡的庫存用完，交易自然就會斷絕了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
From the way you're talking, it seems like you'll cut ties soon, huh?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
聽你說話的語氣，看來你很快就會切斷聯絡，是吧？

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Kid, don't try to float around more. Find out the rest yourself.
If you've got what you wanted, pay the commission and leave.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
小鬼，別想再套我的話了。剩下的自己去查。
既然得到了你想要的，就付佣金然後離開。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Thor Volcano's secret base... this smells very suspicious.
I have a feeling this might be our final destination, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
索爾火山的秘密基地...這聞起來非常可疑。
我有種感覺，這裡可能就是我們的最終目的地，你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'll see you at <NAVI>[Thor Volcano]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> Make sure to come prepared!
Don't enter the military base directly; instead, come in the direction of 3 o'clock from there, and I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我在<NAVI>[索爾火山]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>等你。一定要做好準備！
不要直接進入軍事基地；而是從那裡3點鐘方向過來，我會在那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Dandelion]
Kid, don't try to float around more. Find out the rest yourself.
If you've got what you wanted, pay the commission and leave.
scripts.translation:
[蒲公英]
小鬼，別想再套我的話了。剩下的自己去查。
既然得到了你想要的，就付佣金然後離開。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I'll see you at<NAVI>[Thor Volcano]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> Make sure to come prepared!
Don't enter the military base directly; instead, come in the direction of 3 o'clock from there, and I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我在<NAVI>[索爾火山]<INFO>thor_v01,169,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>等你。一定要做好準備！
不要直接進入軍事基地；而是從那裡3點鐘方向過來，我會在那裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Over here! Follow me!
Here's a <NAVI>[shortcut]<INFO>que_thr,133,53,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> that will take you around a bit, but it'll keep you out of sight.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
這邊！跟我來！
這裡有一個<NAVI>[捷徑]<INFO>que_thr,133,53,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，雖然會繞一點路，但可以避開視線。

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Oh? Suad! Miriam and Maram are here too.
scripts.translation:
[拉馬庫斯]
哦？蘇阿德！米莉亞姆和瑪拉姆也在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
What's going on, everyone? If it's about the weapons, I've already said everything before.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
大家怎麼了？如果是關於武器的事，我之前已經說過了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Is there something else that needs to be said besides that?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
除了那些，還有別的需要說的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Hey~ that's scary~ Why all of a sudden? Bringing in strangers too. Is there something to be afraid of?
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
嘿~真嚇人~怎麼突然這樣？還帶了陌生人來。有什麼好怕的？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What nonsense is this? I'm more afraid of you guys! How can you attack the upper ranks?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
這是什麼胡話？我更怕你們！你們怎麼能攻擊上級？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
Oh, that? You don't have to praise me.
scripts.translation:
[拉馬庫斯]
哦，那個？你不用誇我。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Really~Ah?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
真是的~啊？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
We came to hear the reason why you attacked the innocent upper ranks.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
我們來聽聽你們攻擊無辜上級的原因。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
What's this about? You've all gathered here over something trivial?
scripts.translation:
[坤]
這是怎麼回事？大家為了這麼點小事聚在一起？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Something trivial? Because of what you've done, we're being branded as rebels. You've given them an excuse to attack us!
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
小事？因為你們做的事，我們被扣上了反叛的帽子。你們給了他們攻擊我們的藉口！

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
If they attack us, we'll just counterattack. What's there to worry about? We have weapons now too, you know?
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
如果他們攻擊我們，我們就反擊。有什麼好擔心的？我們現在也有武器了，知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Do you know who we robbed? If you knew, you'd thank us. It wasn't an innocent upper rank, you know?
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
你知道我們搶了誰嗎？如果你知道，你會感謝我們的。那可不是無辜的上級，知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Do you know what it's called when you attack and rob the upper ranks regardless of innocence? It's called robbery.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
你知道不管對方是否無辜，攻擊並搶劫上級的行為叫什麼嗎？那叫搶劫。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
No, this is too much. Robbery? We targeted Ahmad's upper ranks.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
不，這太過分了。搶劫？我們針對的是艾哈邁德的上級。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
If it's Ahmad...
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
如果是艾哈邁德...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Isn't it Suad's?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
那不是蘇阿德的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Yeah! They treated us like trash and even ignored their own sons!
scripts.translation:
[坤]
是啊！他們把我們當垃圾，甚至無視自己的兒子！

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
They were sucking people like us dry!
scripts.translation:
[拉馬庫斯]
他們一直在壓榨我們這樣的人！

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Isn't it a good thing that we sought revenge on Suad and secured the necessary supplies?
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
我們向蘇阿德復仇並獲得了必要的物資，這不是好事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Exactly!! You suffered a lot because of your father. You came here because of him.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
沒錯！！你因為你父親受了很多苦。你因為他才來到這裡的。

scripts.text:
[Kun]
Simply because you're indigenous, he not only refused to acknowledge you as a capable son but also subjected you to abuse. In fact, he probably never even acknowledged you as his son.
scripts.translation:
[坤]
僅僅因為你是原住民，他不僅不承認你是有能力的兒子，還虐待你。事實上，他可能從未承認過你是他的兒子。

scripts.text:
[Yopi]
Is there anyone here who doesn't know Suad's story??
scripts.translation:
[約皮]
這裡有人不知道蘇阿德的遭遇嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lamacus]
You always imagined it in your heart, right? You didn't deserve such treatment. You wanted revenge against your stepfather.
scripts.translation:
[拉馬庫斯]
你心裡一直這麼想，對吧？你不應該受到這樣的對待。你想向你的繼父復仇。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Say something, Suad.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
說點什麼吧，蘇阿德。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
...Sigh... Alright, I understand... Just... Let's be careful next time. I understand why you did what you did, but we could end up in even bigger trouble...
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
...唉...好吧，我明白了...只是...下次小心點。我理解你們為什麼這麼做，但我們可能會陷入更大的麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Suad? Is that the end of it?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
蘇阿德？就這樣結束了？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I may not know much about this kind of thing, but from my limited perspective, won't they continue like this in the future? Shouldn't we arm ourselves just in case?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我可能不太懂這種事，但從我的角度來看，他們以後還會這樣吧？我們是不是應該武裝自己以防萬一？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Given the shortage of supplies in the village, that's true. It's becoming increasingly difficult for trade.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
考慮到村莊物資短缺，這是真的。貿易變得越來越困難了。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
And as I mentioned before, being armed is necessary. We'll need to find new sources while keeping what we've already acquired. That's why I wanted to discuss it with you all
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
正如我之前所說，武裝自己是必要的。我們需要在保留現有物資的同時尋找新的來源。所以我才想和大家討論這件事。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Suad? Tell us. Are you completely unaware of this decision? Can you honestly say you have no involvement in this matter?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
蘇阿德？告訴我。你完全不知道這個決定嗎？你能誠實地說這件事與你毫無關係嗎？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Wait, wait. I need some time to gather my thoughts.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
等等，等等。我需要時間整理一下思緒。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 您當前攜帶的物品 -
- 數量過多。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再次嘗試。 -

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The damage... is too great.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
損失...太大了。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Moreover, with the bloodshed that occurred, rumors of a native uprising will spread in no time. It's already a bad situation with the headquarters attack incident.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
而且，由於發生了流血事件，原住民起義的謠言很快就會傳開。加上之前總部的襲擊事件，情況已經夠糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
Don't worry about public opinion. Let us handle the recovery.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
別擔心輿論。恢復工作交給我們處理。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
It turns out that recent events were all part of a scheme.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
看來最近發生的一切都是某個陰謀的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
It was our oversight not to examine the suspicious movements within the temple more closely.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
是我們疏忽了，沒有更仔細地調查寺廟內的可疑動向。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Let's save self-blame for later and focus on resolving the situation on both sides for now.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
自我責備的事以後再說吧，現在先集中精力解決雙方的局勢。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Are we sure about the involvement of the Youth Amal Vice-Chancellor?
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我們確定青年阿馬爾的副議長參與其中嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
After the setback, my deputy, who had been languishing, suddenly regained vigor and became enthusiastic. Since then, tensions between the natives and immigrants of Arunafeltz have gradually escalated.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
在遭遇挫折後，一直萎靡不振的副手突然恢復了活力，變得積極起來。從那以後，阿魯納菲茲的原住民與移民之間的緊張局勢逐漸升級。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
That aligns roughly with the time when the Heart Hunters escaped from the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
這大致與心之獵手從宅邸逃脫的時間吻合。

scripts.text:
[Zed]
It seems certain that they conspired together after all.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
看來他們確實是一起合謀的。

scripts.text: Because I even witnessed it.
scripts.translation: 因為我親眼目睹了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
One thing that's troubling is that the Vice-Chancellor of Youth Amal wouldn't be unaware of the value of the Imir's Heart Fragment. Simply causing conflict by infiltrating the organization wouldn't have been enough to easily betray it...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
令人擔憂的是，青年阿馬爾的副議長不可能不知道伊米爾之心碎片的價值。僅僅通過潛入組織製造衝突，不足以讓他輕易背叛...

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Did they agree to receive something more and hand it over?
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
他們是否約定了接收更值錢的東西並交出來？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
I'm not sure, but my deputy... No, I need to go and confirm it myself.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
我不確定，但我的副手...不，我需要親自去確認一下。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Where are you going? Do you have any idea where to start looking?
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
你要去哪裡？你有頭緒從哪裡開始查嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
There's a summer villa on the outskirts of Rachel. Recently, my deputy has been frequenting that place for medical treatment. If he's colluding with those mad scientists to plan something, that's probably where he'd be.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
拉赫郊外有一棟夏季別墅。最近，我的副手經常去那裡接受治療。如果他和那些瘋狂科學家勾結策劃什麼，那裡很可能就是他的藏身之處。

scripts.text:
[Mini Elly]
We'll need to do some tracking.
scripts.translation:
[迷你 艾莉]
我們需要進行追蹤。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Tracking down the person who stole the Heart Fragment should be left to Miriam. I hope the adventurer will accompany her.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
追蹤竊取心之碎片的人這件事，應該交給米莉亞姆。希望冒險者能陪同她。

scripts.text: Understood.
scripts.translation: 明白了

scripts.text:
[Zed]
We'll stay here to attend to the injured and identify any remaining stragglers who might still be around. We also need to consider public opinion.
scripts.translation:
[澤德]
我們留在這裡照顧傷員，並排查可能仍潛伏在附近的漏網之魚。我們還需要考慮輿論的影響。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
We need to return to the forest and handle the aftermath there as well.
Miriam, adventurer. Then I entrust you with tracking.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
我們需要回到普勒斯特處理那裡的善後工作。
米莉亞姆，冒險者。那麼，追蹤的任務就交給你們了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Let's go, adventurer. Before heading to the villa, there's someone who will accompany us. Let's meet at <NAVI>[������ �̷�]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
走吧，冒險者。在前往別墅之前，還有一個人會陪同我們。我們在<NAVI>[奧茲迷宮]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>會面

scripts.text:
[Niren]
We agreed to meet Miriam at <NAVI>[Maze of Oz]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我們約定在<NAVI>[奧茲迷宮]<INFO>oz_dun01,223,116,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>與米莉亞姆會面

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
The situation here is not so good these days.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
最近這裡的情況不太妙。

scripts.text:
Arrived at the meeting place.
It seems like the others haven't arrived yet.
Let's wait.
scripts.translation:
已到達約定地點。
其他人似乎還沒到。
先等等吧。

scripts.text: Were you waiting for Miriam?
scripts.translation: 你在等米莉亞姆嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
I asked for my mother's permission and came out for a moment.
I'm in the middle of handling the protest so I have to go back soon but...
Where is Miriam?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
我徵得母親的同意後出來透口氣。
我正忙著處理抗議活動，得趕緊回去，但是...
米莉亞姆在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Suad]
There she comes.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
她來了。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Sorry for being late. I took some time to find someone.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
抱歉來晚了。我花了一些時間找人。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
This is Ira.
She's a child who often brings my father's books, but she needs help to enter the villa.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
這是艾拉。
她經常幫我父親送書，但她需要幫助才能進入別墅。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What, why is Ira here?
Is she related to this matter?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
什麼，艾拉怎麼會在這裡？
她和這件事有關嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Long time no see, Maramoppa.
I came to repay a favor to Miriam unnie while I'm at it.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
好久不見，瑪拉姆歐帕。
我順便來幫米莉亞姆歐尼的忙。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
You said there's something to see at the villa?
I've been pushing Sir Amal's wheelchair around, so I've been everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
你說別墅裡有東西要看？
我最近一直推著阿馬爾大人的輪椅到處走，所以那裡我都去過。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Coincidentally, I have the keys for the servants. I haven't returned them yet because I've been accompanying Sir Amal recently.
Even recently, I haven't returned them as I've been out with Sir Amal.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
巧的是，我有僕人的鑰匙。因為最近一直陪阿馬爾大人，所以還沒還回去。
最近我也沒還，因為我一直和阿馬爾大人在一起。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
And about that villa.
Sometimes we lend it to the priests.
That's what happened this time too.
But it's a bit strange.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
還有那棟別墅。
有時候我們會借給牧師們住。
這次也是那樣。
但有點奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Strange?
It would be good if you could be specific.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
奇怪？
如果能具體說明就好了。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
They said some priests would be staying for a while, but it feels like a lie...
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
他們說會有幾位牧師住一段時間，但感覺像是謊言...

scripts.text:
[Ira]
It seems like Sir Amal is operating another secret group.
Last time, he said he'd wage war but got pushed out of the temple, didn't he?
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
看來阿馬爾大人又在運作什麼秘密組織了。
上次他說要發動戰爭，結果被趕出了神殿，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
It seems like he hasn't given up yet.
This time, there seem to be more dangerous people staying at the villa than last time.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
看來他還沒死心。
這次，別墅裡住的人似乎比上次更危險。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
I don't care who, but I wish someone would stop him.
The atmosphere is not good either.
If there's a war, we, the indigenous people, will be the ones caught in the crossfire.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
不管是誰，我都希望有人能阻止他。
氣氛也很不好。
如果爆發戰爭，我們原住民就會成為夾在中間的受害者。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Well... no, it won't be a war.
You can relax, it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
嗯...不，不會發生戰爭的。
你可以放心，沒問題的。

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Sister! How can you be so calm?
Do you know how scary it was for me to manage the villa?!
Especially with that strange woman there...
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
修女大人！你怎麼能這麼冷靜？
你知道管理那棟別墅有多可怕嗎？！
特別是那個奇怪的女人...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hahaha....
Alright, calm down, Ira.
We're gathered here to figure that out now.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哈哈...
好了，冷靜點，艾拉。
我們聚在這裡就是為了弄清楚這件事。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
For that reason, we're planning to enter the villa where aggressive guests are staying.
Since they seem to be the same people we encountered at the temple.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
正因如此，我們計劃進入那棟有激進客人居住的別墅。
因為他們似乎就是我們在神殿遇到的那些人。

scripts.text:
[Suad]
I understand what you mean.
Honestly, I'd like to go with you.
But there are still things I need to take care of.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
我明白你的意思。
說實話，我也想和你們一起去。
但我還有些事情需要處理。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Yeah. I hurriedly asked for permission and left for a moment.
I still need to handle the protest and do some coordination work.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
是啊。我匆忙請了假出來一會兒。
我還需要處理抗議活動，做一些協調工作。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Sorry, but Suadand I won't be able to go with you..
Can you understand?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
抱歉，蘇阿德和我無法和你們一起去了。
你能理解嗎？

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Of course.
It's better for you to handle matters among yourselves.
I'll rely on the people of the Wolf Village.
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
當然。
你們處理內部事務更好。
我會依靠狼村的人。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Then, {0}, will you scout the villa with us?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
那麼，{0}，你願意和我們一起偵察別墅嗎？

scripts.text: Leave it to me.
scripts.translation: 交給我吧

scripts.text:
[Suad]
Thank you for understanding.
If you safely enter the villa, we'll bring Ira with us.
scripts.translation:
[蘇阿德]
謝謝你的理解。
如果你能安全進入別墅，我們會帶上艾拉。

scripts.text:
[Miriam]
Thank you.
Then, Ira. Will you send us to the villa?
scripts.translation:
[米莉亞姆]
謝謝。
那麼，艾拉。你能送我們去別墅嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ira]
Of course.
Just talk to me when you're ready.
I'll send you right away.
scripts.translation:
[艾拉]
當然可以。
準備好了就告訴我。
我會立刻送你們過去。

scripts.text:
You can enter the MD Memorial's villa story mode.
Adventurers who have already completed it can only enter to accompany fellow adventurers.
Would you like to enter together for your companion?
scripts.translation:
你可以進入記憶地下城的別墅劇情模式。
已經完成的冒險者只能進入以陪伴其他冒險者。
你想和你的同伴一起進入嗎？

scripts.text: Enter the {0}
scripts.translation: 進入 {0}

scripts.text: ^ff0000An unknown error occurred.^000000
Accompanying is not currently possible. Please check if your accompanying party member has applied for MD.
scripts.translation: 目前無法進行陪伴。請檢查你的陪伴隊伍成員是否已申請記憶地下城。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Only a member of the party can enter the Memorial Dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000只有隊伍成員才能進入記憶地下城。^000000

scripts.text:
[Temple Knight]
The Sanctuary Sethrumnir.
The general chapel is not here, so please go back.
scripts.translation:
[神殿騎士]
這裡是聖所塞特魯姆尼爾。
這裡沒有普通禮拜堂，請回去。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Phew... It's hot!
It used to be a cool cave...
Now, just standing still feels like sweat is pouring down.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
呼...好熱！
這裡以前是個涼爽的洞穴...
現在，光是站著不動就感覺汗水直流。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
If we stay too long, I might get dizzy, so let's explore quickly.
For now, this path is an ^e5555eexternal path^000000, so we just need to walk straight.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
如果待太久，我可能會頭暈，所以我們得快點探索。
目前，這條路是^e5555e外部通道^000000，我們只需要直走即可。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Someone left their luggage behind.
Sometimes when facing monsters or feeling too exhausted to carry items, people hide their luggage like this and move on.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
有人把行李落在這裡了。
有時候，當人們面對魔物或因為太累而無法攜帶物品時，就會像這樣把行李藏起來，然後繼續前進。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
While it's important to move items, life is precious.
Since we're close to the entrance here, it's convenient to retrieve the items later.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
雖然搬運物品很重要，但生命更寶貴。
既然離入口很近，之後回來取物品也很方便。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's leave this luggage for now and move on.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
先把行李留在這裡，我們繼續前進吧。

scripts.text: - A box has been left unattended. -
scripts.translation: - 有一個箱子被遺忘了。 -

scripts.text:
[Imril]
The path here is rough, so be careful.
You might slip and hurt your ankle if you're not careful.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
這裡的路很崎嶇，請小心。
如果不注意，可能會滑倒傷到腳踝。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's go down straight from here.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
從這裡直接往下走吧。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hoo!
It's hot!
Steam is escaping from the cracked crevice.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
呼！
好熱！
裂縫裡正冒出蒸汽。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Fortunately, the ground seems okay for now, but steam rising indicates that the ground deep below has heated up, so we might not be able to go much further before lava starts flowing.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
幸好地面目前看起來還安全，但蒸汽上升表明深處的地面已經升溫，我們可能走不了多遠，熔岩就會開始流動。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
It's really serious that it's starting to heat up near the main path...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
主路附近開始升溫，情況真的很嚴重...

scripts.text: [???] Imril!!
scripts.translation: [???] 伊姆里爾！！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Are you okay, Paul?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
你沒事吧，保羅？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Haha...
I got hit by hot steam while running away from monsters.
I let my guard down on the path I always took.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
哈哈...
我在逃離魔物時被熱蒸汽擊中了。
在我常走的路徑上，我一時大意了。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
I'm not sure where my belongings went either.
Getting hurt and losing my belongings, it's miserable...
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
我也不確定我的物品掉在哪裡了。
受傷又丟了東西，真是慘透了...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Don't say that, your life is more important than your belongings.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
別這麼說，你的生命比物品更重要。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Yeah...
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
是啊...
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
I have some potions here, so drink this and return to the village first.
You can find your belongings later.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
我這裡有一些藥水，喝下去然後先回村莊吧。
你可以之後再去找你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
No, keep it!
We can't waste the village's valuable resources like this.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
不，留著吧！
我們不能這樣浪費村莊寶貴的資源。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Rest for a while, then go back to the village and apply ointment.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
休息一會兒，然後回村莊塗藥膏吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
