Still, I don't want to get hit by monsters while recovering, so can you help me ^e5555eclean up the monsters nearby^000000?
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
不過，我不想在恢復期間被魔物攻擊，你能幫我^e5555e清理一下附近的魔物^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Rest for a while, then go back to the village and apply ointment.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
休息一會兒，然後回村莊塗藥膏吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Still, I don't want to get hit by monsters while recovering, so can you help me ^e5555eclean up the monsters nearby^000000?
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
不過，我不想在恢復期間被魔物攻擊，你能幫我^e5555e清理一下附近的魔物^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Phew~
Thanks!
I'm feeling a bit better now and can move.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
呼~
謝謝！
我現在感覺好多了，可以活動了。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Well, I'll slowly head back to the village now.
It's good to investigate the maze, but be careful of your health.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
好了，我要慢慢回村莊了。
探索迷宮雖然不錯，但也要注意身體健康。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Got it.
Take care, Paul.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
知道了。
保重，保羅。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hmm...
Steam rising from various places is indeed a big problem, not just the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
嗯...
各處升騰的蒸汽確實是個大問題，不僅僅是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Travelers rarely descend further down, but if they are chased by monsters, they might take the wrong path...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
旅行者很少會深入下去，但如果被魔物追趕，可能會走錯路...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's ^e5555ego down a bit more^000000 for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
讓我們^e5555e再往下走一點^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Well, I'll slowly head back to the village now.
It's good to investigate the maze, but be careful of your health.
scripts.translation:
[保羅]
好了，我要慢慢回村莊了。
探索迷宮雖然不錯，但也要注意身體健康。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Got it.
Take care, Paul.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
知道了。
保重，保羅。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Hmm...
Steam rising from various places is indeed a big problem, not just the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
嗯...
各處升騰的蒸汽確實是個大問題，不僅僅是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Travelers rarely descend further down, but if they are chased by monsters, they might take the wrong path...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
旅行者很少會深入下去，但如果被魔物追趕，可能會走錯路...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's ^e5555ego down a bit more^000000 for now.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
讓我們^e5555e再往下走一點^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
There's some luggage here too...
Could this be the luggage Paul lost?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
這裡也有一些行李...
這難道是保羅丟失的行李？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Let's just remember the location for now and retrieve it later.
We still need to check ^e5555efurther down^000000.
This way...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
先記住位置，之後再回來取吧。
我們還需要檢查^e5555e更深處^000000。
這邊...

scripts.text: - The box is left unattended. -
scripts.translation: - 箱子無人看管。 -

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Ugh...
The heat is already unbearable.
It's even more dangerous down here, so we really need to be careful.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
唉...
熱得已經讓人難以忍受了。
下面更加危險，我們必須格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
To be honest, unless you're as strong as an adventurer, coming this far is as good as a death sentence.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
說實話，除非你有冒險者那樣的實力，走到這裡幾乎就等於判了死刑。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
But since I'm here with you, I'll venture further down.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
不過既然我陪在你身邊，我就繼續往下探索。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
It seems like the monsters down here have slightly changed their form just from coming down a bit further.
Even this level of change could pose a risk to adventurers, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
看來下面的魔物稍微深入一點，形態就發生了一些變化。
即使只是這種程度的變化，對冒險者來說也可能構成威脅，你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Since it's too dangerous here, let's just take a quick look around and then head back to town.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
這裡太危險了，我們快速檢視一下週圍，然後回城鎮吧。

scripts.text: [Imril] Elder!!!! You're safe!!!
scripts.translation: [伊姆里爾] 長老！！ 你沒事吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Elder]
No.
Who is this?
Isn't this Imril?
Why did you come to such a dangerous place?
scripts.translation:
[長老]
不。
這是誰？
這不是伊姆里爾嗎？
你為什麼來到這麼危險的地方？

scripts.text:
[Imril]
No, why are you really here, Elder.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
不，您為什麼真的在這裡，長老。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
The maze master is in the maze, where else would I be.
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
迷宮大師在迷宮裡，還能在哪裡呢。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
But this place is too dangerous with monsters...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
但這裡魔物太多，太危險了...

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
Well, it's not only here, so don't worry.
With all the noise the monsters are making these days, I thought there might be someone in danger and came down to check.
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
嗯，不僅僅是這裡，所以別擔心。
最近魔物動靜很大，我擔心有人遇到危險，就下來查看了一下。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
I've told Suad that the lava has reached this far, and below here, the ground has already melted a lot, making it even more dangerous, so don't go down.
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
我已經告訴蘇阿德，熔岩已經蔓延到這裡了。再往下的地面已經融化了很多，更加危險，所以不要下去。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
If it were an adventurer next to you, it might be okay, but it's too dangerous for you.
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
如果是和你在一起的冒險者，或許還可以，但對你來說太危險了。

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Got it.
Please take care of yourself, Elder.
Hurry back to the village.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
明白了。
請保重身體，長老。
快回村莊吧。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
Oh my~
If the maze master isn't in the maze, who will manage the maze!
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
哎呀~
如果迷宮大師不在迷宮裡，誰來管理迷宮呢！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, stubbornness...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
真是固執...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
As Inspirational said, I don't think I can handle going further down, so let's go back to the ^e5555evillage^000000.
I feel like my skin is burning even now.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
正如鼓舞所說，我覺得我無法再往下走了，我們回^e5555e村莊^000000吧。
現在我的皮膚感覺都要燒起來了。

scripts.text:
[Maze Master Elder]
Oh my~
If the maze Master isn't in the maze, who will manage the maze!
scripts.translation:
[迷宮大師長老]
哎呀~
如果迷宮大師不在迷宮裡，誰來管理迷宮呢！

scripts.text:
[Imril]
Anyway, you're so stubborn...
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
真是固執...

scripts.text:
[Imril]
As the elder said, I don't think I can go down any further, so let's go back to ^e5555eVillage^00000.
Even now, my skin feels like it's going to burn.
scripts.translation:
[伊姆里爾]
正如長老所說，我覺得我無法再往下走了，我們回^e5555e村莊^00000吧。
現在我的皮膚感覺都要燒起來了。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 您當前攜帶的物品 -
- 數量過多。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再次嘗試。 -

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh my, look at him breathing. Isn't our little pup just adorable?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀，看它呼吸的樣子。我們的小狗真可愛啊？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Hey, buddy, it's time for you to learn a foreign language too...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
嘿，巴迪，你也該學學外語了...

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh my, look at this! Look at the way they're breathing. They're a genius at inhaling and exhaling! A true genius!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀，看這個！看它們呼吸的樣子。它們是呼吸的天才！真正的天才！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hello! Scania!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你好！斯堪尼亞！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Maram? When did you come? You came earlier than expected?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
瑪拉姆？你什麼時候來的？比預期來得早啊？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Thanks to the adventurer's help, I came a little faster this time.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
多虧了冒險者的幫助，這次我來得快了一些。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Is this the newcomer who just arrived?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
這是剛到的新人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh, that's not it. He is not from around here. He is from a completely different place. He helped with purchasing goods this time, and they've transported them all the way here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦，不是。他不是這裡的人。他來自完全不同的地方。這次他幫忙採購貨物，並把它們一直運到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Hmm... An adventurer...? So, they're an outsider? Are we sure about your identity? What if we search through everything he have?
Or perhaps we could let slip some information over there? If not, what if they try to claim our land like those immigrants?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
嗯...冒險者...？所以，他是外人？我們確定他的身份嗎？如果我們搜查他所有的東西呢？
或者，我們可以在那邊透露一些資訊？如果不這樣做，萬一他像那些移民一樣試圖佔領我們的土地呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
No, not him! He have nothing but kind words for everyone they meet! They're not that kind of person at all. Why would you compare him to those troublemakers?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
不，不是他！他對遇到的每個人都很友善！他根本不是那種人。你為什麼要把他和那些麻煩製造者相提並論？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Do you think someone's intentions are written on their face? Whether they're a thief or a military member, that's something we'll find out over time!
Isha brought back a wolf cub, and now, Marem, are you bringing back people?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你覺得一個人的意圖會寫在臉上嗎？無論是盜賊還是軍人，那都是我們要隨時間觀察的！
伊莎帶回來一隻狼崽，現在，瑪拉姆，你又要帶人回來了？

scripts.text: I'm not that kind of person, though.
scripts.translation: 我可不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh, of course, what comes out of their mouth isn't the truth. It's just talk, that's all.
By the way, a wolf cub? What wolf cub?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦，當然，他們嘴裡說出來的話不一定是真的，只是隨口說說罷了。
對了，狼崽？什麼狼崽？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh! Isha brought back a Baby Grey Wolf from the forest not too long ago! She won't even listen when we tell her to take it back to the woods!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哦！艾莎不久前從普勒斯特帶回來一隻小灰狼！我們讓她把狼崽送回樹林，她都不肯聽！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Do you know what that means? It's already causing trouble for our sheep! Even now, it's behaving like that. What will happen when it gets bigger? It will definitely harm our sheep!
So, why don't you go and try saying it once! I won't listen to what you say!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你知道這意味著什麼嗎？它已經給我們的羊群惹麻煩了！現在它就這樣，等它長大了怎麼辦？肯定會傷害我們的羊！
所以，你為什麼不親自去勸勸她呢！我才不聽你那一套！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh? That's actually a great suggestion. It would be a very constructive conversation. But what should I do? I have to tidy up the stuff I brought.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦？這倒是個好建議。這會是一次非常有建設性的對話。但我該怎麼辦呢？我還得整理一下帶來的東西。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ah, of course! Adventurer! Would you care to go? Explore this place, take in the sights, and perhaps make a lasting impression on the locals as well.
Since we'll be staying here for a while anyway, right? Everyone here is as friendly and kind-hearted as I am, so you won't encounter any hostility.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
啊，對了！冒險者！你要不要去看看？探索一下這個地方，欣賞一下風景，順便也給當地人留下個好印象。
反正我們要在這裡住一段時間，對吧？這裡的人都很友善，心地善良，就像我一樣，你不會遇到任何敵意的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Right, Scania?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
對吧，斯堪尼亞？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
......

[Maram]
Just go and check whether what Aisha brought back is a real wolf cub or just a puppy that looks like a wolf.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
去確認一下艾莎帶回來的是真的狼崽，還是隻是一隻長得像狼的小狗。

scripts.text: What about verifying it?
scripts.translation: 那要核實一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Oh... well, I haven't really thought that far. But wouldn't it be troublesome if it's really a wolf cub? Even a puppy would be a hassle in that case.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哦...嗯，我還沒想那麼遠。但如果真的是狼崽，那不是很麻煩嗎？即使是小狗，也會很麻煩的。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let me explain for our newly arrived adventurer. Here, the land is such that there aren't many animals suitable for raising.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
讓我給這位新來的冒險者解釋一下。這裡的土地環境，並不適合飼養很多動物。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Mostly, Skania takes care of the sheep and chickens. There are hardly any cattle or pigs that can adapt to such places. Therefore, livestock is really precious here.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
通常，斯堪尼亞負責照看羊和小雞。很少有牛或豬能適應這樣的地方。因此，這裡的牲畜非常珍貴。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But what if what Aisha is carrying is indeed a wolf cub?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
但如果艾莎帶回來的確實是狼崽呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The mother is coming to find her cub!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
狼媽媽會來找她的幼崽！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Even if the mother doesn't come looking for it?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
即使狼媽媽不來找它呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The cub will grow up and start harming the livestock!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
狼崽長大後會開始傷害牲畜！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Did you hear?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你聽到了嗎？

scripts.text: Where should I go?
scripts.translation: 我該去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Where did Aisha live again? Ah, right! <NAVI>[Upper Side]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, if you go there, you'll find Aisha's house.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
艾莎住在哪裡來著？啊，對了！<NAVI>[上方]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，如果你去那裡，就能找到艾莎的家。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But there's no point in saying it, right? If I persuade you, it might change your mind about me too.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
但說了也沒用，對吧？如果我勸你，可能會改變你對我的看法。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Adventurer, then, please go and return safely! I'll take my leave for now too!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
冒險者，那就拜託你了，請平安歸來！
我也先告辭了！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
<NAVI>[Aisha]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, no matter how many times I say it to you, it won't make a difference, will it? If I persuade you, it might change my opinion of you too.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
<NAVI>[艾莎]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，無論我說多少遍，對你來說都不會有改變，對吧？
如果我勸你，可能會改變我對你的看法。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
<NAVI>[Aisha]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> for a hundred days won't help? If you convince me, I'll change my opinion of you.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
<NAVI>[艾莎]<INFO>wolfvill,99,178,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，一百天也不行嗎？
如果你能說服我，我會改變對你的看法。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Woof woof. Today's walk is over now. I'm too tired.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
汪汪。今天的散步結束了。
我太累了。

scripts.text:
[Goat]
Yaaawwwn---
scripts.translation:
[山羊]
咩——

scripts.text:
[Scania]
I can't let you go alone. How can I send you to such a dangerous place alone? Of course, I know you can handle a walk by yourself, but I'm worried.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
我不能讓你一個人去。
怎麼能把你一個人送到那麼危險的地方呢？
當然，我知道你自己能應付，但我還是擔心。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Aisha? Why are you here? Did you come to return the wolf?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
艾莎？你怎麼在這裡？
你是來送狼回去的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
No, it's not like that. You brought the wolf... with you? In front of the sheep? Are you out of your mind?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
不，不是那樣的。
你把狼...帶在身邊了？
在羊群面前？你瘋了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Why on earth are you trying to raise a wolf? Do you need a dog? Then get a dog.
No, I'll just become the dog. I'll mess up your house too and occasionally bite you.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你到底為什麼要養狼？
你需要狗嗎？那就養只狗。
不，我來當那隻狗吧。我也會弄亂你的房子，偶爾還會咬你。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Scania, I heard your wishes loud and clear. So, did you even send a person to me? Are you treating me like some kind of a contractor, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
斯堪尼亞，我聽得清清楚楚。那麼，你派人來找我了嗎？
你把我當成什麼承包商了嗎，冒險者？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Despite all your efforts, so what? This person has already sided with me! Hahaha! Come on, show me that face of despair!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
儘管你費盡心思，那又怎樣？
這個人已經站在我這邊了！哈哈！
來吧，讓我看看你那絕望的表情！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
What? Adventurer? You betrayed me? How could you do that? Betrayal at first sight, isn't that too much? I should have known. Outsiders like you can't be trusted.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
什麼？冒險者？你背叛了我？
你怎麼能這麼做？
一見鍾情就背叛，這也太過分了吧？
我早該知道的。像你這樣的外人，是不能信任的。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Scania, have you ever been to the Ice Caves? Is the blood flowing in your veins colder than the frozen water there? You cold-blooded one!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
斯堪尼亞，你去過冰洞嗎？
你血管裡流動的血液，比那裡的冰水還冷嗎？
你這個冷血動物！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
How can you even suggest sending this small and fragile little creature back to such a dangerous place? Its mother is dead, and it can't survive on its own.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你怎麼能建議把這個弱小又脆弱的小傢伙送回那麼危險的地方？
它的母親已經死了，它無法獨自生存。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Its mother... is gone?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
它的母親...不在了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I said that, didn't I? I told you a hundred times. You didn't listen again, did you? You just believe what you want to believe, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我說過吧？
我告訴過你一百次了。
你又不聽，對吧？
你只相信你想相信的，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I don't know about you, but I can't bear to send this small and fragile young wolf back to the market.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我不知道你怎麼想，但我無法忍受把這個弱小又脆弱的幼狼送回市場。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But if that wolf grows up, our sheep...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
但如果那隻狼長大了，我們的羊...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Don't worry about that. Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
別擔心那個。冒險者？

scripts.text: Oh, do I need to talk about it?
scripts.translation: 哦，我需要談談嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
You won't listen to me anyway. You never listen to me when I talk, and you only believe what other people say.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
反正你也不會聽我的。我說話你從來不聽，只相信別人說的話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This wolf cub will be fine if it is trained. If it grows up with other friends from a young age, it will not harm them and will instead protect the sheep.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這隻狼崽如果好好訓練就沒問題。如果從小和其他夥伴一起長大，它不僅不會傷害它們，反而會保護羊群。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Did you hear me? Where is your refutation? Come on, smart genius! Sit down! Hands up!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你聽見了嗎？你的反駁呢？快點，聰明的天才！坐下！舉起手！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
It's true. But... but I don't know how long it will last... I don't know if it will be able to suppress its wild nature...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
確實如此。但是...我不知道能維持多久...我不知道它能否壓制住野性...

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But most of all, I don't think you'll be able to train it that patiently.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
但最重要的是，我覺得你不可能那麼有耐心地訓練它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll help you with any nervousness so you can be fully trained. I'll take him for walks so we can bond.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會幫你克服它的緊張情緒，讓它得到充分訓練。我會帶它散步，讓我們建立感情。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
But...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
但是...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
You said it was hard to keep chasing after the cub when he went for walks alone. Isn't this a good thing?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你說過它獨自散步時很難追上。這不是好事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Are you sure you can take care of our wolf cub? I'm worried about him being outside with all the dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
你確定能照顧好我們的狼崽嗎？外面有很多危險的魔物，我很擔心它。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
See those calluses on your hands, Adventurer? You said Maram brought him here, so he must be trustworthy. He's a veteran we trained in minutes!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
看看你手上的老繭，冒險者？你說瑪拉姆把它帶到這裡，那它一定很可靠。它是我們在幾分鐘內訓練出來的老兵！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh, well... I can't help coming all the way here, so can I ask you a favor? Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀...既然都跑到這裡來了，能幫我個忙嗎？呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
You're so excited, like you've been waiting for this moment. Aren't you taking it too cold?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你太興奮了，好像一直在等待這一刻。你難道不覺得太冷淡了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh no~ You're so~ desperately~ asking!! So, I can't help but...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀~你真是~拼命~地請求啊！！所以，我不得不...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Anyway... I need to talk to the villagers about the cub. Our little one is safe! Let's go, little cub!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
總之...我需要和村民們談談狼崽的事。我們的小傢伙安全了！走吧，小狼崽！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh... suddenly became a temporary shepherd, huh...? Thank you. I had a lot to do. What can I do to help?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哦...突然成了臨時牧羊人，是嗎...？謝謝你。我有很多事要做。我能怎麼幫忙？

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ah, right! Outsiders often like these sorts of things. Do you like it, adventurer? Even if you don't, you can exchange it for something you like with someone who does. Take it with you.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
啊，對了！外來者通常喜歡這種東西。你喜歡嗎，冒險者？即使你不喜歡，也可以找喜歡它的人交換成你喜歡的東西。帶上它吧。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Sure, see you on our walk then.
^4d4dffYou receive favorable evaluations.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
好的，散步時見。
^4d4dff你獲得了良好的評價。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼的村民們已接納你為村莊的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Sure, see you on our walk then.
^4d4dffYou receive favorable evaluations.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
好的，散步時見。
^4d4dff你獲得了良好的評價。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Please wait the end of the quest delay.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
請等待任務冷卻結束。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I think our dog is also satisfied. Did you have a good meal time? Then, please try again tomorrow!
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
冒險者，你辛苦了。我覺得我們的狗也很滿意。你吃得開心嗎？那麼，請明天再來吧！
^4d4dff灰狼的村民們已接納你為村莊的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I think our dog is also satisfied. Did you have a good meal time? Then, please try again tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
冒險者，你辛苦了。我覺得我們的狗也很滿意。你吃得開心嗎？那麼，請明天再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
There are a few places the dog likes, and I will guide you. You only need to deal with dangerous monsters nearby.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
狗有幾個喜歡的地方，我會帶你去。你只需要處理附近的危險魔物。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
It's a pain in the ass because ashrings rush in. Please take care of the surrounding ashrings. I usually catch 20 eagles a day. Then please.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
因為灰燼精靈總是衝過來，真是麻煩。請處理一下週圍的灰燼精靈。我通常每天能抓到20只鷹。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Adventurer, I came on time for our walk. But Aisha didn't show up...
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
冒險者，我準時來散步了。但是艾莎沒有出現...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Ta-da! We're here!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
噹噹！我們到了！

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof!!
scripts.translation:
[福實]
汪！！

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Sure, I'll take you for a walk. Really... do I have to go too? Can I trust you to handle it?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
好的，我帶你去散步。真是的...我也必須去嗎？能信任你處理好嗎？

scripts.text: Alright then.
scripts.translation: 那就拜託了

scripts.text: I'm a bit busy today.
scripts.translation: 我今天有點忙

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ah... I see... You're busy. Well, then there's nothing to be done about it.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
啊...我知道了...你很忙。那也沒辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Oh, come on, look at my disappointed face. There's nothing I can do. Today, come with me. Well then, goodbye, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
哎呀，看看我失望的臉。我也沒辦法。今天跟我來吧。那麼，再見，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
If you're worried, you can come along.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
如果你擔心，可以一起來。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
h, no. Alright then, I'll leave it to you. Take care, pup. If you're worried or don't like it, let me know and come home. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
嗯，不。好吧，那就交給你了。小心點，小傢伙。如果你擔心或不喜歡，告訴我並回家。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goat]
Yahaaaaawwwn---
scripts.translation:
[山羊]
咩啊啊啊——

scripts.text:
[Scania]
I'll guide you to a few places that the pup likes. He can find and eat on his own, so just take care of any nearby dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
我會帶你去幾個小傢伙喜歡的地方。它能自己找到並吃，所以只需處理附近的危險魔物。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ashlings keep swarming and causing headaches... Please take care of the nearby Ashlings. We usually end up catching about 20 of them per day. So, I'd appreciate your help with that.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
灰燼精靈總是成群結隊，讓人頭疼...請處理附近的灰燼精靈。我們通常每天能抓到大約20只。所以，請幫我處理一下。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
I'll guide you to a few places that the pup likes. Just take care of any nearby dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
我會帶你去幾個小傢伙喜歡的地方。只需處理附近的危險魔物。

scripts.text:
[Scania]
Ashlings keep swarming and causing headaches... Please take care of the nearby Ashlings. We usually end up catching about 20 of them per day. So, I'd appreciate your help with that.
scripts.translation:
[斯堪尼亞]
灰燼精靈總是成群結隊，讓人頭疼...請處理附近的灰燼精靈。我們通常每天能抓到大約20只。所以，請幫我處理一下。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
We need to show Scania that our Boksil is safe and reliable!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我們需要向斯堪尼亞證明我們的福實是安全可靠的！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Do you want to see wolf cub poop? How cute is it? Oh, but don't touch it.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你想看狼崽的便便嗎？多可愛啊？哦，但是別碰它。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Boksil~ Let's live together forever with me. If someone comes to harm you, I will personally bury them in the Oz Maze. So don't worry, Wolf Cub~ Just trust me and let's live happily.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
福實~ 讓我永遠和你一起生活。如果有人來傷害你，我會親自把他們埋在奧茲迷宮。所以別擔心，狼崽~ 相信我，讓我們幸福地生活。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof---
scripts.translation:
[福實]
汪——

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
No, Boksil. Calm down a bit. Oh dear. What will happen if you still act unfamiliar? No, I'm not saying anything to you... Let's get closer, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
不，福實。冷靜一點。哎呀。如果你還是這麼生疏怎麼辦？不，我什麼都沒說... 我們靠近一點，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Roaarrrr---
scripts.translation:
[福實]
嗷嗚——

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I understand, I understand. You need some time alone. Honestly, I feel the same way. In the end, we're all alone in this world. So let's live well on our own while still living together.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我懂，我懂。你需要獨處的時間。說實話，我也這麼覺得。畢竟，在這個世界上我們終究都是孤獨的。所以，讓我們各自安好，同時一起生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Roarrrrrr---
scripts.translation:
[福實]
嗷嗚——

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Why? What did I do...... Huh? Who are you? I've never seen you before.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
為什麼？我做了什麼...... 咦？你是誰？我從來沒見過你。

scripts.text: So this is the wolf cub?
scripts.translation: 原來這就是狼崽？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Don't get too close to my wolf cub. Put your hands down. Turn around and disappear.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
別靠近我的狼崽。把手放下。轉過身去，消失吧。

scripts.text: I'm not a bad guy...
scripts.translation: 我不是壞人...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I don't call anyone a bad people. Anyone who tells me to abandon my wolf cub is a villain. And I show no mercy to villains.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我不叫任何人壞人。任何讓我拋棄狼崽的人都是惡棍。而且我對惡棍絕不心慈手軟。

scripts.text: How long have you been here?
scripts.translation: 你在這裡多久了？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I can't disclose that as it's personal information. Why do you ask?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
這是個人隱私，我不能透露。你為什麼這麼問？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, this wolf cub, I don't think he's trained yet.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，這隻狼崽，我覺得它還沒經過訓練。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
... No, that's. She's about a month old now. There's no way she can train while she's still a baby.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
... 不，那是。她現在大約一個月大。還是嬰兒的時候，怎麼可能接受訓練呢。

scripts.text: Actually, I'm here to...
scripts.translation: 其實，我是來...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
What? I knew it! Get at least 10 paces away from my wolf cub right now. Don't come any closer.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
什麼？我就知道！立刻離我的狼崽至少十步遠。不要靠近。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am not here to take her, I am here to check on here... If she separated from the pack, we have to put them back, and we have to be prepared for the mother wolf to come looking for them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是來帶走它的，我是來檢視情況的... 如果它脫離了狼群，我們必須把它送回去，並且要做好母狼回來尋找它的準備。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
She's not stray out of the pack, she was picked up next to next to its dying mother wolf.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
它不是脫離狼群的流浪兒，它是在即將死去的母狼身邊被撿到的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oops. It's probably nervous about being separated from his mother and living in a strange place.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀。它可能是因為與母親分離，又生活在陌生的地方而感到緊張。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Are you sure you're not here to take her away, then why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你確定你不是來帶走它的，那你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I did come to persuade after confirming whether it was indeed a wolf cub...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我確實是在確認那是否真的是狼崽之後，才來勸說你的...

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I knew it! Sent by Scania, right? Why are you meddling with other people's pets? Our wolf cub isn't dangerous, so go back. There's nothing more to see.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我就知道！是斯堪尼亞派你來的吧？為什麼要干涉別人的寵物？我們的狼崽並不危險，所以請回去吧。沒什麼好看的了。

scripts.text: As long as you're careful, there's nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation: 只要小心一點，就沒有什麼好擔心的。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Do you really think so? Do you really think our wolf cub could be a potential threat? Look at how small and cute she is...
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你真的這麼認為嗎？你真的認為我們的狼崽可能會成為威脅嗎？看看她多小多可愛...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You might have thought so under normal circumstances, but... if she doesn't have a mother, at least there wouldn't be any reason for wolves to come here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在正常情況下你可能這麼想，但是...如果她沒有母親，至少狼群就沒有理由來這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I understand what you're saying! But stupid Scania doesn't know that! Even a complete stranger like you understands my heart so well!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我明白你的意思！但愚蠢的斯堪尼亞不懂！連你這樣的陌生人都能如此理解我的心意！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Moreover, this motherless wolf cub wouldn't be able to survive on its own.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且，這隻失去母親的狼崽是無法獨自生存的。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
That's right! That cold-hearted one has turned ice-cold right down to the head.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
沒錯！那個冷血的人，心都冷得像冰一樣。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, for Boksil to live in the village, she needs training. She must learn how to interact with others without causing harm and how to get along.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過，為了讓福實在村莊裡生活，她需要接受訓練。她必須學會如何與他人互動而不造成傷害，以及如何與人相處。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
She is still so young...?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
她還這麼小...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It should be done when she's young. If we start training it from a young age, there won't be any of the concerns the villagers have.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
應該趁她年幼時進行訓練。如果從小開始訓練，就不會有村民們擔心的那些問題了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Firm tone, immediate response, and sufficient praise will be enough for it to understand well. Wolves are smart, you know. What does wolf cub like the most?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
堅定的語氣、及時的回應和充分的表揚就足以讓她理解得很好。狼是很聰明的，你知道嗎。狼崽最喜歡什麼？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Hm... Meat? But there isn't any right now. Do adventurers have some?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
嗯...肉？但現在沒有肉。冒險者身上有嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh...! There's no meat to give as a snack, meat... I need to bring some meat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...！沒有肉可以當零食，肉...我需要帶些肉來。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
How are you supposed to train with meat? You only need one?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你打算怎麼用肉來訓練？只需要一塊嗎？

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 您當前攜帶的物品 -
- 數量過多。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再次嘗試。 -

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Oh, don't touch our Boksil! She doesn't like it!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
哦，別碰我們的福實！她不喜歡這樣！

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Didn't you say you needed a chunk of meat? is not it?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
你不是說需要一塊肉嗎？不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello~ I am {1}. Your name is Boksil, right? Nice to meet you. Are you feeling anxious in this unfamiliar place? I know exactly how you feel, I know everything about you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好~ 我是{1}。你的名字是福實，對吧？很高興見到你。在這個陌生的地方感到焦慮嗎？我完全知道你的感受，我瞭解你的一切。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Roarrr---

[{0}]
But it's okay. Everything's fine. There's no one here who would harm our Boksil. Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但沒關係。一切都好。這裡沒有人會傷害我們的福實。別擔心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now we're all living together. With a warm shelter and delicious food to eat.
Then we need to establish some rules. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在我們住在一起了。有溫暖的住所和美味的食物。
那麼我們需要制定一些規則，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof?
scripts.translation:
[福實]
汪？

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
I feel like I'm talking to a child.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
我覺得我在跟小孩子說話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here, look. Meat. Does Boksil like meat? Grilled, raw, or boiled? You've never tried grilled? That's okay, you'll have plenty of opportunities to try it in the future.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看，這是肉。福實喜歡肉嗎？烤的、生的還是煮的？你從來沒吃過烤的？沒關係，以後你會有很多機會嘗試的。

scripts.text:
[Boksil]
Woof!
scripts.translation:
[福實]
汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's do it right.
Boksil, sit down!
Wait!
Well done. Here is your meat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們要好好做。
福實，坐下！
等一下！
做得好。這是你的肉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you see? If she follows instructions like this, please give her a lot of praise.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看到了嗎？如果她能像這樣聽從指令，請多表揚她。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Mom, Mom. Isn't our child a real genius?
Our Boksil did a great job!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
媽媽，媽媽。我們的孩子真是個天才吧？
我們的福實做得太棒了！！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We need to keep doing this until she gets used to it. Repetitive training is important. Just keep doing it like you're doing now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們需要繼續這樣做，直到她習慣為止。重複訓練很重要。就像現在這樣繼續做下去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Boksil, sit.
Hand.
Wait. Now, try it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
福實，坐下。
握手。
等一下。現在，你自己試試。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Boksil, sit!
Hand!
Wow, that's really amazing.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
福實，坐下！
握手！
哇，這真的很厲害。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Training these kinds of domestic animals varies. Making them feel secure in this place and building a good bond with them will help them settle in well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
訓練這類家畜各有不同。讓她們在這個地方感到安全，並與她們建立良好關係，有助於她們更好地適應。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And if they also interact with other friends and spend time together from a young age, they should get along well without any major issues.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
而且如果她們從小與其他朋友互動並一起度過時光，她們應該能相處得很好，不會有太大問題。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Do people recognize that?
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
人們能意識到這一點嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You just need to show them what you've done. It shows that Boksil is ready to live as a member of this village.
Let's go back to <NAVI>[Scania]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and show off our wonderful and majestic Boksil.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你只需要展示你做了什麼。這表明福實已經準備好作為這個村莊的一員生活了。
讓我們回到<NAVI>[斯堪尼亞]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，展示我們美麗而高貴的福實。

scripts.text:
[Aisha]
Boksil is cute. But we're going to <NAVI>[Scania]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> right? Don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[艾莎]
福實很可愛。但我們要去<NAVI>[斯堪尼亞]<INFO>wolfvill,117,119,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>對吧？別忘了。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 您當前攜帶的物品 -
- 數量過多。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再次嘗試。 -

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Why are you eavesdropping on other people's conversations?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
你們為什麼在偷聽別人的談話？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Uh, once again at the village meeting, all they did was talk nonsense, that old man.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
呃，再次在村民會議上，那個老人只會胡說八道。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
That old man? Ah, the one whose name cannot be mentioned?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
那個老人？啊，就是那個不能提名字的人？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I mean, I can't mention it.
I heard he was someone important in Rahel, said to have some influence in the Gray Wolf Forest.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
我的意思是，我不能提他的名字。
我聽說他是拉赫爾的重要人物，據說在灰狼森林有一定影響力。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
That old man, whether it's Ahap or Ahab!
He doesn't act like that when he's in Rachel~ He must have messed up~
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
那個老頭，不管是阿哈還是亞哈！
他在拉赫的時候可不是這樣的~ 他肯定搞砸了~

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
If that's the case, why bother coming here instead of staying in Rachel?
I really don't understand!
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
既然這樣，為什麼不去拉赫待著，非要來這裡？
我真的不明白！

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Does she still not realize she's in Rachel?
Even sleeping in a drafty tent, hasn't she woken up from her dream yet?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
她難道還沒意識到自己身在拉赫嗎？
即使在漏風的帳篷裡睡覺，她也沒能從夢中醒來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
If you want to dream, do it alone.
Why bother others with your troubles?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
如果你想做夢，就自己去做。
為什麼要拿自己的煩惱去打擾別人？

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Who do you think you are, eavesdropping on our conversation?
Are you the Ahab old man's spy?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
你以為你是誰，在這裡偷聽我們的談話？
你是亞哈那個老頭的間諜嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
You're not even smart enough to cultivate weeds like Ahab.
So, who are you? Eavesdropping on others' gossip. Shameful.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你連像亞哈那樣培育雜草的本事都沒有。
所以，你是誰？偷聽別人的八卦。真丟人。

scripts.text: Just a passing traveler.
scripts.translation: 只是一個路過的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Liar. Where's a passing traveler in this Gray Wolf Forest?
They must be related to us somehow.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
騙子。在灰狼森林裡哪有路過的旅行者？
他們肯定和我們有什麼關係。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
If you won't speak, we'll have to use force to make you.
Are you really just going to keep lying?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
如果你不肯說話，我們就得用武力讓你開口。
你真的打算一直撒謊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Calm down, Redcell. Even if Zlan is not a passing traveler, there could still be someone here we don't know about but wouldn't be out of place.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
冷靜點，紅血球。即使茲蘭不是路過的旅行者，這裡可能還有我們不知道但也不突兀的人。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Who would that be?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
那是誰？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Now that Ahab is starting to listen to people... He doesn't seem like such a bad person after all.
Yeah, that's just how adults communicate.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
現在亞哈開始聽別人說話了... 他似乎並不是個壞人。
是的，這就是成年人溝通的方式。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
It's a relief that they don't end up causing too much trouble by just blocking each other's ears and shouting
Thanks to you. I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
幸好他們沒有因為互相堵耳朵和喊叫而惹出大麻煩。
多虧了你。我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
You're back? What did Ahab say?
What? He said he'll start listening to others now?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
你回來了？亞哈說了什麼？
什麼？他說他以後會聽別人說話了？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I guess he hasn't been listening until now.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
看來他之前一直沒在聽。

scripts.text:
[Kayar]
Hmph... Don't tease, Zlan.
What matters now is that he's decided to do it properly.
scripts.translation:
[卡亞爾]
哼... 別取笑我了，茲蘭。
現在重要的是他決定好好做了。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Ya, ya.
Why did Dah... I mean, Ahab change his mind?
You must have convinced him, being a high-ranking or well-connected person.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
是，是。
為什麼達... 我是說，亞哈改變了主意？
你一定是個地位很高或很有關係的人，說服了他。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Thanks to you, we don't have to kick people out of here anymore.
Even though he said he'd do it, it was still uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
多虧了你，我們不用再趕人走了。
雖然他說他會做，但還是讓人不舒服。

scripts.text:
[Kayar]
I may not be a representative at the village meetings... but we'll show some courtesy.
We're lucky to have someone like you.
 
^4d4dffA favorable evaluation of you occurs.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡亞爾]
我可能不是村民會議的代表... 但我們會表示一些禮貌。
有像你這樣的人是我們的幸運。
 
^4d4dff對你進行了一次有利的評價。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼的村民們已接受你成為村莊的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kayar]
I may not be a representative at the village meetings... but we'll show some courtesy.
We're lucky to have someone like you.
 
^4d4dffA favorable evaluation of you occurs.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡亞爾]
我可能不是村民會議的代表... 但我們會表示一些禮貌。
有像你這樣的人是我們的幸運。
 
^4d4dff對你進行了一次有利的評價。^000000

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Now that Ahab is starting to listen to people... He doesn't seem like such a bad person after all.
Yeah, that's just how adults communicate.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
現在亞哈開始聽別人說話了... 他似乎並不是個壞人。
是的，這就是成年人溝通的方式。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
It's a relief that they don't end up causing too much trouble by just blocking each other's ears and shouting
Thanks to you. I appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
幸好他們沒有因為互相堵耳朵和喊叫而惹出大麻煩。
多虧了你。我很感激。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I hope you'll leave if you don't intend to follow the rules of this forest.
You're no different. Rules are meant to be followed.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
如果你不打算遵守這片森林的規矩，最好離開。
你和其他人沒什麼兩樣。規矩就是用來遵守的。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
The same goes for manners. A society without manners and rules? Barbaric.
I don't want to be in a state of wilderness!
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
禮儀也是如此。一個沒有禮儀和規矩的社會？那是野蠻。
我不想生活在荒野之中！

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Ah, it's troubling. There's a bothersome issue.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
啊，真讓人頭疼。有個棘手的問題。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
It's a problem with relationships, so I don't want to talk to someone I don't know...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
這是人際關係上的問題，我不想跟陌生人談論...

scripts.text:
[Karr]
Would it make sense to speak if it's an important guest?
Since we can't even know about the affairs of the leaders here.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
如果是重要的客人，對話還有意義嗎？
畢竟我們連這裡首領的事務都不清楚。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Is that true?
...Well, if it's a secret to us, then maybe they won't tell us.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
是嗎？
...好吧，如果這對我們來說是秘密，那他們大概也不會告訴我們。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
If they're really important, then listen to us.
If not? They're probably still someone important. Listen.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
如果他們真的重要，那就聽我們的。
如果不重要？他們大概也是重要人物。聽我們的。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
That elder... no, that's just a nickname we use among ourselves.
How can we help that Mr. Ahap?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
那位長老...不，那只是我們內部使用的綽號。
我們要怎麼幫那位阿哈普先生？

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
He's a really bothersome old man, that guy!
He always interrupts village meetings and talks nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
他是個真的很煩人的老頭！
他總是打斷村民會議，說些胡話。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
He doesn't listen to others and just keeps rambling on, and it's not even useful.
He insists he's an elder, so we should listen to him, but it's so frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
他不聽別人說話，只顧自己喋喋不休，而且毫無用處。
他堅持自己是長老，我們應該聽他的，但這太讓人惱火了。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
I heard he used to boss around the immigrants and live off them.
Thinking he can tell the natives what to do based on his past is ridiculous.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
我聽說他過去總是指揮移民，靠他們生活。
以為憑過去的經歷就能指揮原住民，真是荒謬。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
I just want to chase him away if I can.
Maybe if we gather our opinions and assert ourselves strongly.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我只想把他趕走。
也許如果我們統一意見，強硬地表達立場。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Hey, even if that's true, it's not right.
This is where people with nowhere else to go gather.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
嘿，即使那是真的，也不對。
這裡是無處可去的人聚集的地方。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
If we drive him away, he'll have nowhere to go.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
如果我們趕走他，他也將無處可去。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
But do we have to put up with that charade forever?
I have nowhere else to go either, so can I just start acting however I want?
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
但我們必須永遠忍受這種鬧劇嗎？
我也無處可去，所以我可以隨心所欲地行動嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
If you do that, then we'll both be charades. I can't stand it...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
如果你那樣做，那我們倆都是鬧劇。我受不了...

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Hey, you there, high and mighty! You seem really interested in our affairs, still listening?
Even if you're not high and mighty, it doesn't matter. Someone with a broad reach!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
嘿，你，高高在上的人！你似乎對我們的事務很感興趣，還在聽嗎？
即使你不是高高在上，也沒關係。見識廣博的人！

scripts.text:
[Karr]
People rarely change... was I witnessing one of those rare changes?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
人很少改變...我是不是見證了這種罕見的改變？

scripts.text:
[Karr]
It might still need more time, but Mr. Ahap, until now, seems like he could be a good neighbor.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
也許還需要更多時間，但阿哈普先生，直到目前為止，似乎可以成為一個好鄰居。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
In our village, only important people don't participate in village management meetings.
Of course, the decisions themselves are made by the important people, but still...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
在我們的村莊，只有重要人物不參加村民管理會議。
當然，決定本身是由重要人物做出的，但...

scripts.text:
[Karr]
So, there's no one who interferes with the meetings just because they attend.
Except for that Mr. Ahap.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
所以，並沒有人僅僅因為參加就干擾會議。
除了亞哈先生。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
I don't like that attitude, not at all...
The longer it goes on, the worse the impact will be.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我不喜歡這種態度，一點都不喜歡...
時間拖得越久，影響就越糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Mr. Ahab, you seem to be becoming more bearable to be around.
There's still a lot to watch out for, but compared to before, you're much better now.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
亞哈先生，你似乎變得不那麼難以相處了。
雖然還有很多需要注意的地方，但比起以前，你已經好多了。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Watching someone change is a sacred moment.
I should also try harder to behave like a human.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
見證一個人的改變是神聖的時刻。
我也應該更努力地表現得像個正常人。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Make that old Mr. Ahab into a person.
Shouldn't a person look like a person and act like a person...?
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
把那個老亞哈變成一個正常人。
正常人難道不該看起來像正常人，行為也像正常人嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Is it too much criticism? ...Well, I'll admit it's a bit much.
But after working together, you'll see for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
是不是批評得太多了？...好吧，我承認有點過火。
但合作之後，你會自己看到的。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Have you heard everything up to now?
You're the only one who can help us solve this suffering.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
你聽到這裡為止的所有內容了嗎？
只有你能幫助我們解決這個痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Since there's really no solution, if it doesn't work out, I'll suggest expulsion from the village by gathering opinions.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
既然真的沒有解決辦法，如果行不通，我會建議通過收集意見來將他驅逐出村莊。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Geez, let's put that off for later...
But in the end, that'll probably be the last solution.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
天哪，先把這個放一邊...
但最後，那可能將是最終的解決方案。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
It's not just us who are bothered, so if we propose it, it'll be accepted.
Everyone attending the village meeting is in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
不只是我們感到困擾，如果我們提出這個建議，就會被接受。
參加村民會議的每個人都在受苦。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
But! Let's leave that for later.
Help me a bit before the end comes. Bro.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
但是！讓我們先把這個放一放。
在結局到來之前，幫幫我吧。兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
We can't communicate with that old man.
Why don't you go and talk to him?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我們無法與那個老人溝通。
你為什麼不親自去和他談談？

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Wow, that sounds great. Go and talk to him, find out why he's like that, if it's possible for him not to be like that.
It's a real lifetime request.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
哇，聽起來不錯。去和他談談，弄清楚他為什麼那樣，看看他是否有可能不再那樣。
這是一個真正的終身願望。

scripts.text:
[Zlan]
Do it as a lifetime request. I'm saving it for when I get a lover.
scripts.translation:
[茲蘭]
把它當作一個終身願望吧。我把它留給我有戀人的時候。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Yeah, that's fine. I won't be dating anyone.
So that's my lifelong wish. Make that old grump into a person.
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
是的，那很好。我不會和任何人約會。
所以那是我的終身願望。把那個老頑固變成一個正常人。

scripts.text:
[Karr]
It seems like your wish is getting bigger.
Anyway, please do it. Go and talk to Mr. Ahap.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
看來你的願望越來越大了。
不管怎樣，請去做吧。去和亞哈先生談談。

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Someone who can't understand a word! Someone stupid! Someone who makes you say things again! Someone who shows emotions in their work!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
一個聽不懂話的人！一個愚蠢的人！一個讓你重複說話的人！一個在工作中表露情緒的人！

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Someone who hides their mistakes and then can't undo them! Someone who can't take responsibility for their own actions!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
一個隱瞞錯誤然後無法挽回的人！一個不能為自己的行為負責的人！

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
It's just disgusting!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
真令人作嘔！

scripts.text:
[Redcell]
Why do so many people hate you like this?
No, I hate just one person... Just one person!
scripts.translation:
[紅血球]
為什麼這麼多人這樣討厭你？
不，我只討厭一個人...就一個人！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, someone new. Are you a resident here?
Heh heh, it's natural for those in power to have trouble remembering everyone. You'll understand.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
哦，是新面孔啊。你是這裡的居民嗎？
嘿嘿，身居高位的人記不住所有人是很正常的。你會理解的。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Who am I? Why, I'm none other than Ahab, of course.
I'm the one who goes all the way to the council that decides everything in the village, that's me.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
我是誰？我當然是亞哈。
我是那個會一路走到決定村莊一切事務的議事會的人，沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I, I'm also trying my best.
So please don't chase me away.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
我，我也在盡力了。
所以請不要趕我走。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
If I get chased away from here, I have nowhere else to go.
So I've been trying to do my best in my own way. But if everyone dislikes me.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
如果我被趕出這裡，我就無處可去了。
所以我一直在用自己的方式盡力。但如果大家都討厭我。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Tsk tsk, alright, let's hear about manners, Ahab.
If you keep babbling nonsense, I won't forgive you!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
嘖，好吧，讓我聽聽關於禮儀的事，亞哈。
如果你繼續胡言亂語，我可不會原諒你！

scripts.text: Do you know that people dislike you, Ahab?
scripts.translation: 你知道人們討厭你嗎，亞哈？

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Ah... I know! So what!
Is it my fault? They mock the elders for being old!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
啊...我知道！那又怎樣！
是我的錯嗎？他們嘲笑長老們年老！

scripts.text: That's not the issue.
scripts.translation: 這不是問題所在。

scripts.text: It's your problem, Ahab.
scripts.translation: 這是你的問題，亞哈。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
What do you mean I have a problem!
I don't have any problems!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
我有什麼問題！
我沒有任何問題！

scripts.text: You're considering sending me away from here.
scripts.translation: 你在考慮把我趕出這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
What, what did you say? That's not possible!
I have nowhere else to go but here.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
什...什麼？你剛才說什麼？這不可能！
除了這裡，我無處可去。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
In Rachel... everything was going well...
Among the locals, it was a pride that no one was as successful as me.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
在拉赫...一切都很好...
在當地人中，沒有人比我更成功，這是他們的驕傲。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
But due to a misunderstanding with the immigrant boss...
I lost all my wealth and had nowhere else to go, so I came here.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
但因為和移民老闆的誤會...
我失去了所有財富，無處可去，所以來到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hey. How can I avoid being sent away from here?
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
嘿。我怎樣才能避免被趕出這裡？

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I know it. That I have no power here.
Huh? I have no power or money now. What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
我知道。我在這裡沒有權力。
嗯？我現在既沒有權力也沒有錢。我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: You don't need power and money.
scripts.translation: 你不需要權力和金錢。

scripts.text: Treat people with respect.
scripts.translation: 尊重他人。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hmm, I'm doing my best.
I give advice to young people and attend village meetings to voice my opinions.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
嗯，我在盡力。
我給年輕人提建議，參加村民會議表達我的意見。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Is my effort wrong?
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
我的努力有錯嗎？

scripts.text: Don't think of yourself as superior.
scripts.translation: 不要覺得自己高人一等。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
But I'm an adult! Is it wrong for an adult to expect to be treated as an adult?
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
但我已經是大人了！大人希望被當作大人對待，這有什麼錯嗎？

scripts.text: Then, perhaps you should leave....
scripts.translation: 那麼，也許你應該離開這裡....

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hmm, hmm... What should I do!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
嗯，嗯...我該怎麼辦！

scripts.text: Don't shout first.
scripts.translation: 不要先大聲嚷嚷。

scripts.text: Unsolicited advice about the situation is just nagging.
scripts.translation: 未經請求的建議只是嘮叨。

scripts.text: Listen to what others have to say.
scripts.translation: 聽聽別人怎麼說。

scripts.text: Try to learn about this place.
scripts.translation: 試著瞭解一下這個地方。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Ah... I see. Since I've listened to your advice.
I didn't even raise my voice, did I?
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
啊...我明白了。既然我聽了你的建議。
我都沒有提高音量，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I'll try to listen to your advice.
So... please don't chase me away from here.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
我會試著聽從你的建議。
所以...請不要把我趕出這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I just wanted to get along well with the young people...
Was that so upsetting? It's a bit bitter....
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
我只是想和年輕人相處融洽...
這很讓人難過嗎？有點苦澀....

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Anyway, thanks for coming to talk instead of immediately chasing me away.
Tell <NAVI>[Other People]<INFO>wolfvill,85,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> that I'll try to do better now....
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
總之，謝謝你願意來和我說話，而不是直接把我趕走。
告訴<NAVI>[其他人]<INFO>wolfvill,85,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，我會試著做得更好....

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, did you buy the cucumber sauce? Let me see. 
You bought the right one.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
哦，你買了黃瓜醬嗎？讓我看看。
你買對了。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
So, where should we try to eat?
I haven't had a proper meal in that watered-down place for a while, I'm quite hungry.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
那麼，我們去哪裡吃呢？
我已經很久沒在那家味道淡的地方好好吃飯了，我相當餓。

scripts.text: But first, let's talk...
scripts.translation: 但首先，讓我們談談...

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, you impudent young one!
When an elder is about to eat, one must wait politely until the end!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
哦，你這無禮的年輕人！
當長老準備用餐時，必須禮貌地等到最後！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
In Rachel, if there were someone like you, they would've scolded us for not learning anything!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
在拉赫，如果有像你這樣的人，他們會責怪我們什麼都沒學到！

scripts.text: This is about manners, Ahab.
scripts.translation: 這是關於禮儀，亞哈。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Ahab? Ahab? No, are you boasting because you ran an errand now!
If you run an errand twice, then, oh, you'll become best buddies with them and have dinner!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
亞哈？亞哈？不，你是在炫耀因為你幫了個忙嗎！
如果你幫兩次忙，那麼，哦，你會和他們成為最好的朋友並一起吃晚飯！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Alright, let's hear your precious words then!
......While we eat!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
好吧，讓我們聽聽你寶貴的話吧！
......邊吃邊聽！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Why aren't you going already? Can't you understand my words?
Sigh, the young ones here just can't learn any manners.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
你怎麼還不走？聽不懂我的話嗎？
唉，現在的年輕人就是學不會禮貌。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hurry up and go to <NAVI>[Munomart]<INFO>rachel,135,64,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> and buy cucumber sauce!
What, do I have to give you money? Hurry up and go!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
快去<NAVI>[穆諾瑪特]<INFO>rachel,135,64,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>買黃瓜醬！
怎麼，還要我給你錢嗎？快去！

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, someone new. Are you a resident here?
Heh heh, it's natural for those in power to have trouble remembering everyone. You'll understand.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
哦，是新面孔啊。你是這裡的居民嗎？
嘿嘿，身居高位的人記不住所有人是很正常的。你會理解的。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Right, while you're here, could you do me a favor?
It's not difficult. It's a simple task that even a fool could do.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
對了，既然你在這裡，能幫我個忙嗎？
不難。這是連傻瓜都能做到的簡單任務。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
It's just that someone like me has different values of time available to them.
Of course, I'm expensive. Haha!
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
只是像我這樣的人，對時間的價值有不同的看法。
當然，我很貴。哈哈！

scripts.text: I'll run the errand for you.
scripts.translation: 我幫你跑腿。

scripts.text: I'm not here for that kind of thing.
scripts.translation: 我不是來幹這種事的。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Oh, how noble of you.
Yes, a young person should have a bit of nobility.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
哦，你真高尚。
是的，年輕人應該有點高尚。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
You see, there's a delicious sauce that I must have with my meals.
Without it, it feels like I haven't eaten anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
你看，有一種美味的醬，我吃飯時必須配它。
沒有它，感覺就像沒吃一樣...

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
So, go to Rachel and buy some sauce.
If you ask for cucumber sauce at Munomart, they'll understand.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
所以，去拉赫買些醬。
如果在穆諾瑪特要黃瓜醬，他們會明白的。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
Hurry, or it'll go bad. Just get one bottle from <NAVI>[Munomart]<INFO>rachel,135,64,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
Freshness is key to good taste.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
快點，不然會壞的。只要從<NAVI>[穆諾瑪特]<INFO>rachel,135,64,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>拿一瓶。
新鮮是美味關鍵。

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
At the meeting, I try to be humble.
Then the young men's eyes became softer...
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
在會議上，我儘量保持謙遜。
然後那些年輕人的眼神變得柔和了...

scripts.text:
[Ahab]
I think it might be a little to say that it's not a change, but an attitude, and the world is changing. There is no one who doesn't change.
scripts.translation:
[亞哈]
我覺得說這不是改變，而是態度，世界在變。沒有人不改變。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Welcome, this is Munomart grocery store.
What ingredients are you looking for?
scripts.translation:
[店主]
歡迎光臨，這裡是穆諾瑪特雜貨店。
您在找什麼食材？

scripts.text: Obirerger Sauce
scripts.translation: 奧比勒格醬

scripts.text: Obiger Sauce
scripts.translation: 奧比格醬

scripts.text: Oiger Sauce
scripts.translation: 奧伊格醬

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Hmm? We don't have that sauce.
I've never even heard of a sauce with that name before.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
嗯？我們沒有那種醬。
我甚至沒聽說過有那個名字的醬。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Ah, Oiger Sauce! Let me see... Here it is.
This sauce contains cucumber and yogurt, so it's very refreshing. It tastes great when spread on bread.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
啊，奧伊格醬！讓我看看...在這裡。
這種醬含有黃瓜和酸奶，非常清爽。塗在麵包上味道很棒。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
How many would you like? One? Here you go.
Store it in a cool place and consume it quickly after opening the seal.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
您要多少？一瓶？給您。
請存放在陰涼處，開封后儘快食用。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Welcome, this is Munomart grocery store.
It's Rachel's best grocery store, yes.
scripts.translation:
[店主]
歡迎光臨，這裡是穆諾瑪特雜貨店。
是拉赫最好的雜貨店，沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Shop Owner]
Most restaurants use our ingredients.
Just take them home, heat them up, cook them, and voila! You'll have a great meal in no time!
scripts.translation:
[店主]
大多數餐廳都使用我們的食材。
您只需帶回家，加熱或烹飪一下，就能立刻享用美味佳餚！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 您當前攜帶的物品 -
- 數量過多。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再次嘗試。 -

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I assume you must be a new villager around here. Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
我想你一定是附近新來的村民吧。請問你是？

scripts.text: Scholar, what are you doing?
scripts.translation: 學者，你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Oh, oh oh.
...Do I seem like a scholar to you?
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
哦，哦哦。
...在你眼裡，我像個學者嗎？

scripts.text: You're not a scholar?
scripts.translation: 你不是學者？

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
No! I used to be a scholar. Long time ago.
I'm pleased that someone from outside immediately recognizes me as a Scholar.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
不！我曾經是學者。那是很久以前的事了。
很高興有外鄉人能立刻認出我是學者。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Hmm, hmm. What are you asking about what I'm doing.
I'm organizing the collected stories.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
嗯，嗯。你問我在做什麼。
我正在整理收集到的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
It's about gathering the myths and folk tales handed down to us.
It's also about preserving the precious cultural heritage of indigenous people.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
這是關於收集代代相傳的神話和民間故事。
也是為了保護原住民珍貴的文化遺產。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
To ensure that these stories are not lost and can be passed down to future generations, we'll publish them as books.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
為了確保這些故事不會失傳，並能流傳給後代，我們將把它們出版成書。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
It seems like you're interested.
...Are you interested in this work?
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
看來你很有興趣。
...你對這項工作感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Interested.
scripts.translation: 感興趣

scripts.text: Not interested.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
So, your interest means you're willing to help?
Extra hands are always welcome. I would be glad if you could assist.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
那麼，你的興趣意味著你願意幫忙？
多一個人手總是好的。如果你能協助，我會很高興。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Do you know how to write? Excellent.
Please gather stories from the villagers.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
你會寫字嗎？太好了。
請去收集村民們的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I've promised to listen to the stories of one child, one young person, and one grandmother from the village.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
我答應過要聽村裡一個孩子、一個年輕人和一位老奶奶的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
They say it's a long story, so we may not finish in one day. We'll need your patience.
Here, I'll give you a notebook for gathering stories.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
據說故事很長，可能一天聽不完。我們需要你的耐心。
給你，這是一本用於收集故事的筆記本。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
The child's name is Dinar. The young person is a woman named Amira.
After that, you can go to Grandma Shania and write down her story.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
那個孩子叫迪納爾。那個年輕人是名叫阿米拉的女子。
之後，你可以去找莎妮娜老奶奶，記下她的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
We've made a promise to listen to stories from one child, one young person, and one grandmother in the village.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
我們答應過要聽村裡一個孩子、一個年輕人和一位老奶奶的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Since it's a long story and can't be heard all in one day, we'll need your patience to help us through it.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
因為故事很長，一天聽不完，所以需要你的耐心來幫助我們完成。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
The child's name is Dinar. The young woman is called Amira.
Next, go to Grandma Shanina's place, listen to her story, and write it down.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
那個孩子叫迪納爾。那個年輕女子叫阿米拉。
接下來，去莎妮娜老奶奶那裡，聽她的故事並記錄下來。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Dinar and Amira, did you come to tell stories to Granny Shannina?
I'm excited to hear what stories they are. Please show me the notebook.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
迪納爾和阿米拉，你們來給莎妮娜老奶奶講故事了嗎？
我很期待聽到那些故事。請給我看看筆記本。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Is this the story Amira told you?
It's really diverse and wonderful! I also remember hearing stories about these gods when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
這是阿米拉告訴你的故事嗎？
內容真豐富，太精彩了！我小時候也聽過關於這些神的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
But the names of the animal gods in this story are similar to the ones I heard when I was young, but a little different.
Hmm, I'll need to do some research.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
不過，這個故事裡提到的動物神的名字，和我小時候聽到的有些相似，但又略有不同。
嗯，我需要做一些調查。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
These are great stories that fuel my research interests!
Please continue to record Amira's stories for me in the future.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
這些故事極大地激發了我的研究興趣！
今後也請繼續幫我記錄阿米拉的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I'd appreciate it if you could come back tomorrow and record the next part of this story.
Thank you. This is your payment for today's work.
 
^4d4dffA favorable evaluation of you occurs.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
請明天再來，記錄這個故事的下一部分。
謝謝。這是今天工作的報酬。
 
^4d4dff你獲得了良好的評價。^000000

scripts.text:

I'd appreciate it if you could come back tomorrow and record the next part of this story.
Thank you. This is your payment for today's work.
 
^4d4dffA favorable evaluation of you occurs.^000000
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
請明天再來，記錄這個故事的下一部分。
謝謝。這是今天工作的報酬。
 
^4d4dff你獲得了良好的評價。^000000

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
As much as I'd like to hear all the stories today...
Both of you, the adventurer and the people would tire out.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
雖然我很想今天就把所有故事都聽完...
但你們兩位，還有村民們，都會累壞的。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Take a good rest for the remaining day, and please come back after dawn.
During that time, I'll organize and analyze the stories you've gathered.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
請在剩下的時間裡好好休息，天亮後再來。
這段時間，我會整理和分析你們收集到的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
We appreciated your last visit.
Today, we would also like to record our conversation.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
感謝你們上次的來訪。
今天，我們也想記錄下我們的對話。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Dinar and Amira, please go to Grandma Shanina and listen to her story, then write it down.
Here are some blank notebooks for you.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
迪納爾和阿米拉，請去莎妮娜老奶奶那裡，聽她的故事並記錄下來。
這是給你們的一些空白筆記本。

scripts.text: I'll go.
scripts.translation: 我去。

scripts.text: It's difficult right now.
scripts.translation: 現在有點困難

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Ah, is it difficult right now? It's okay, we can do it later.
Just remember, this work requires patience and persistence.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
啊，現在有點困難嗎？沒關係，以後再做也可以。
只要記住，這項工作需要耐心和堅持。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
We're already colleagues on the same path, aren't we?
If it's tough, you can take a break. As long as we keep moving forward steadily.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
我們已經是同一條路上的同事了，不是嗎？
如果太累，可以休息一下。只要我們能穩步前進就好。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Thank you for always being willing to help.
I will repay this kindness by making a good storybook.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
謝謝你們一直願意幫忙。
我會通過製作一本優秀的故事書來回報這份善意。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Oh, of course, I'll make sure you're paid for your work today too.
That's important too, isn't it? I understand.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
哦，當然，我也會支付你們今天工作的報酬。
這也很重要，不是嗎？我理解。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Dinar and Amira, did you bring stories from Shannina Grandma?
I'm excited to hear what kind of stories they are. Please show me the notebook.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
迪納爾和阿米拉，你們帶來莎妮娜老奶奶的故事了嗎？
我很期待聽到那些故事。請給我看看筆記本。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Amira's stories include many myths familiar to me as well.
They are stories that all indigenous people here have heard and grown up with.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
阿米拉的故事中包含了許多我也熟悉的傳說。
這些故事是這裡所有原住民都聽過並伴隨成長的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Of course, there are some differences from the myths I know...
But researching those differences and commonalities is precisely my job, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
當然，這些傳說和我所知道的一些傳說有些不同...
但研究這些差異和共同點，正是我的工作，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
These are stories that fuel my research curiosity!
I hope you continue to transcribe Amira's stories.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
這些故事極大地激發了我的研究好奇心！
希望你們能繼續抄錄阿米拉的故事。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I'd appreciate it if you could come back tomorrow and transcribe the next part of this story.
Thank you. This is your payment for today's work.
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
請明天再來，抄錄這個故事的下一部分。
謝謝。這是今天工作的報酬。
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民們已經接納你成為村莊的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議^000000。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
I'd appreciate it if you could come back tomorrow and transcribe the next part of this story.
Thank you. This is your payment for today's work.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
請明天再來，抄錄這個故事的下一部分。
謝謝。這是今天工作的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Folklorist Gudra]
Dinar and Amira, please go to Grandma Shani's house and listen to her story and write it down.
scripts.translation:
[民俗學家 古德拉]
迪納爾和阿米拉，請去莎妮娜老奶奶家，聽她的故事並記錄下來。

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
You've come to listen to my story, right?
Oh, that's right. I promised Granny Gudra!
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
你是來聽我講故事的吧？
啊，對了。我答應過古德拉奶奶的！

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
Hmm, hmm. I'll tell you once, so write it down carefully.
This is something I really experienced.
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
嗯，嗯。我只講一次，所以請仔細記下來。
這可是我親身經歷的事情。

scripts.text: Not just a rumor?
scripts.translation: 不只是傳聞？

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
What's a rumor? Anyway, please pay attention!
Long ago, when I was still young.
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
什麼傳聞？總之，請專心聽好！
很久以前，當我還年輕的時候。

scripts.text: You're still young now...
scripts.translation: 你現在也很年輕啊...

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
Oh, you keep interrupting!
Among the gray wolves in the Gray Wolf Forest, there was one that seemed like the leader...
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
哎呀，你總是插話！
在灰狼森林的灰狼中，有一隻看起來像是首領的...

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
You've come to listen to my story again today!
Aunt Gudra said she'll turn it into a book later.
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
你今天又來聽我的故事了！
古德拉阿姨說之後會把它寫成書。

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
Hmm..., where did we leave off last time?
Did we stop in the middle of the scene where the dragon and the fairy have their final showdown?
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
嗯...，上次我們講到哪兒了？
是停在巨龍和妖精最終對決的場景中間嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
As the dragon summoned the giant tower of metal for the last time, the fairy confronted it by summoning the giant spirit of fire...
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
當巨龍最後一次召喚出巨大的金屬塔時，妖精召喚出巨大的火焰精靈與它對峙...

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
I really enjoy reading interesting stories.
Reading and imagining the next story is even better!
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
我真的很喜歡讀有趣的故事。
閱讀並想像下一個故事更是妙不可言！

scripts.text:
[Dinar]
The characters, they come alive in my mind.
I just need to watch them like watching a play.
scripts.translation:
[迪納爾]
那些角色在我的腦海中栩栩如生。
我只需要像看戲一樣看著他們表演。

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Are you the one who came after being asked by Sister Gudra?
She made a strange request. She wants to hear an old... story that I know.
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
你是受古德拉姐姐之邀來的嗎？
她提了一個奇怪的請求。她想聽一個我知道的...古老故事。

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Anyway, I promised to tell the story I heard from our grandfather before we came to the Gray Wolf Forest.
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
總之，我答應過要講那個故事。那是我們來到灰狼森林之前，從祖父那裡聽來的。

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Are you ready to listen? Alright, I'll tell you slowly.
There are far more gods in the world than we know...
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
你準備好聽了嗎？好的，我會慢慢講給你聽。
世界上比我們已知的要多得多的神明...

scripts.text:
[Amira]
You've come for Sister Gudra's errand again today.
What does she want to use these stories for?
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
你今天又為了古德拉姐姐的差事來了。
她想用這些故事做什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Anyway, I'll tell you the next story.
This is also a story our grandfather told us, some gods are still...
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
總之，我會給你講下一個故事。
這也是祖父告訴我們的故事，有些神明仍然...

scripts.text:
[Amira]
...So, um, what was the name? I don't remember well, but anyway, the important thing is...
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
...所以，嗯，那個名字是什麼？我記不太清了，但總之，重要的是...

scripts.text:
[Amira]
Our grandfather said so. It's important not to forget our gods.
That's why he's telling me all these stories.
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
祖父是這麼說的。重要的是不要忘記我們的神明。
所以他才把這些故事都告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Amira]
I've heard so many stories, but now there are some that I've forgotten...
If Sister Gudra turns them into a book, I won't forget them anymore.
scripts.translation:
[阿米拉]
我聽過很多故事，但現在有些已經忘記了...
如果古德拉姐姐把它們寫成書，我就不會再忘記了。

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Ah, Grodra's errand? You came to hear an old tale, didn't you?
I'll tell you a story. It's a very old story, not everyone's cup of tea, perhaps, but it's one my grandmother used to tell me.
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
啊，古德拉的差事？你是來聽古老傳說的吧？
我會給你講個故事。這是一個非常古老的故事，也許不是每個人都喜歡，但這是我祖母以前常講給我的。

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Worried it won't be entertaining? Don't worry. It'll be a pleasant distraction.
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
擔心不好聽嗎？別擔心。
這會是一段愉快的消遣。

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
So, long long ago. In a time long past, there lived a blacksmith...
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
那麼，很久很久以前。
在遙遠的過去，住著一位鐵匠...

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Here you are again for Gudra's errand. Quite diligent, aren't you.
You said the stories I tell are alright, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
你又來幫古德拉的忙了。
真勤快啊。
你說過我講的故事還不錯，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
I'm glad if it helps Gudra.
How far did we get in the story? Is it time for a new tale today?
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
如果這對古德拉有幫助，我很高興。
故事講到哪了？今天該講新故事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Oh, the last story wasn't finished yet, was it? My memory's a bit foggy.
Did I mention the blacksmith riding an owl down from the sky?
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
哦，上一個故事還沒講完，是嗎？我的記憶有點模糊了。
我提到鐵匠騎著貓頭鷹從天上飛下來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
Right, my memory serves me well.
Then please tell the next part. The pitiful nymph...
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
沒錯，我的記憶還很好。
那麼請繼續講下一部分。那個可憐的女仙...

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
There's not much excitement in my life now, but telling old tales to young children is enjoyable.
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
我現在的生活沒什麼波瀾，但給小孩子講古老的故事很有趣。

scripts.text:
[Shanina]
I'm very grateful to have someone to listen. Blessings upon them.
scripts.translation:
[莎妮娜]
我很感激有人願意聽。願神明保佑他們。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 您當前攜帶的物品 -
- 數量過多。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再次嘗試。 -

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Outsiders are coming in and out from here.
If you're just snooping around out of curiosity, I can't let you in.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
有外人在這裡進進出出。
如果你只是出於好奇來窺探，我不能讓你進去。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
If you go in front of the temple, there will probably be devotees out there for good deeds that day.
Just say a few words and buy it.
I beg you.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
如果你去神殿前面，那天大概會有信徒在那裡做善事。
就說幾句好話，然後買下來。
拜託了。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
We've heard that you've been poking your nose into our business....
I also heard that they will teach you how to do it easily.
Can you help me too?
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
我們聽說你一直在插手我們的事務....
我還聽說他們會教你怎麼做。你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Budan]
As you can see, we can't easily get to Rachel.
So this is something I really want you to help me with, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
如你所見，我們很難到達拉赫。
所以這是我真的很想請你幫忙的事，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
I want you to get me some things that can only be made in Rachel's Temple of Sessrumnir.
As you can see, there is no easy access to clean water in the area due to volcanic ash and sand in the area around Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
我想讓你幫我弄一些只能在拉赫的瑟斯魯米尼爾神殿製作的東西。
如你所見，由於拉赫周圍地區的火山灰和沙子，這裡很難獲得清潔水源。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
So I developed a water purification artefact...
This thing really absorbs the dirt in the water through some unknown magical process.
Even all kinds of miscellaneous magical powers.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
所以我發明了一種淨水神器...
這東西通過某種未知的魔法過程真正吸收水中的汙垢。
甚至各種雜亂的魔法力量。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Even the sulfur spring water, which contains the mysterious magic of this forest, can be turned into drinking water.
But the magic doesn't last long... so you have to buy it when you need it.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
即使是含有這片森林神秘魔法的硫磺泉水，也能變成飲用水。
但魔法不會持續太久...所以你需要時就得買。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
You get the idea.
Can I ask for help?
Even if we go anyway... they won't sell it to us.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
你明白我的意思了。
我能請求你的幫助嗎？
即使我們去了...他們也不會賣給我們。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
Pretend to be a merchant who stopped by Rachel and quietly buy one, and put it in the water tank over there.
Then you will get completely purified, clean water.
You just need to bring it to me.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
假裝是路過拉赫的商人，悄悄買一個，然後把它放進那邊的水箱裡。
這樣你就會得到完全淨化、乾淨的水。
你只需要把它帶給我。

scripts.text: It won't be difficult
scripts.translation: 這不難

scripts.text: It will be difficult
scripts.translation: 這很難

scripts.text:
[Budan]
If you're busy, so be it then.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
如果你很忙，那就這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
It was a long story, but thank you for the short answer.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
雖然故事很長，但謝謝你的簡短回答。

scripts.text:
[Budan]
If you go to a temple, there will probably be worshippers out doing good deeds that day.
Just say a few words and buy it.
Please do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
如果你去寺廟，那天大概會有信徒在那裡做善事。
只要說幾句話，就能買到。
請幫個忙。

scripts.translation:

我們已經有一段時間有乾淨的水了。

Thank you for helping me secure drinking water. Then I will boil this and prepare a meal.
If you have time to stay here tomorrow, may I ask for another route to Rachel?
scripts.translation:

謝謝你幫我弄到飲用水。那麼我會把它燒開，準備一頓飯。

scripts.text:

Is your answer quick?
Sorry for the long journey. But I want to feed my kids something safe. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[布丹]
你的回答真快。
抱歉讓你跑這麼遠的路。但我想給孩子們吃點安全的東西。謝謝。

Adventurer, you're back.
Do you have time to go to Rachel?

scripts.translation: - 由於你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
May you be safe~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
祝你平安~

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Today's we have holy water purification relic~!
Come early before they're all sold out~!
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
今天我們有聖水淨化聖物~！
趁還沒賣完，早點來~！

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Huh?
How may I help you, outsider?
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
咦？
有什麼可以幫你的，外鄉人？

scripts.text: I need it to go to the top
scripts.translation: 我需要它去上面

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Alas, you've heard the rumors~
I'll explain briefly~
It is a consecrated holy purification relic that purifies a large amount of contaminated water at once.
This is it~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
哎呀，你聽到傳聞了~
我簡單解釋一下~
這是一種經過祝聖的淨化聖物，可以一次性淨化大量受汙染的水。
就是這個~

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
It's made in the temple~
Now that the waterways are well-maintained, it's not in such high demand~
I'm only making a small amount~
The ingredients are hard to find~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
這是在寺廟裡製作的~
現在水路維護得很好，需求沒那麼高~
我只做少量~
材料很難找~

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
I need it in a few days, so I can't buy it in bulk~
But~ there's only so much water you can purify in a single use~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
我幾天後就需要，所以不能大量購買~
但是~一次能淨化的水量是有限的~

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
If you run out of water on the way to your destination, and you have a suitable hydration station, you can use the item~
It's better than carrying water~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
如果你在去目的地的路上沒水了，並且有合適的水源站，就可以使用這個物品~
這比攜帶水要好~

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
But you have to boil the water once~
Some people say it smells~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
不過你得先把水燒開一次~
有人說味道有點怪~

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
It's 550 Zeny.~
scripts.translation:
[銷售員]
550 Zeny。~

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 購買

scripts.text: Don't buy

scripts.text:

It is a holy relic for the essence of today's fish~

scripts.translation:

這是今天魚獲的聖物~
趁沒賣完趕緊買~

scripts.text:
[Salesman]
Ah, the last time you went to the top, didn't you?
You came back sooner than expected. It seems that business is going well~
scripts.translation:

啊，上次你去上面，沒去成吧？
回來得比預期早。看來生意不錯~

scripts.text:
I thought it was relatively clean water, but when I put a holy object in it, it glowed brightly and gave me a somewhat sacred feeling.
As the light subsides, the water looks clean.
scripts.translation:
我以為這是相對乾淨的水，但放入聖物後，它發出明亮的光芒，讓我感到一種神聖的感覺。
光芒消退後，水看起來變乾淨了。

scripts.text: I'll put it in a bucket and take it to Budan.
scripts.translation: 我把它裝進桶裡，帶給布丹。

scripts.text:
This is a water container for drinking water used throughout the village.
One side contains clean water, the other relatively clean water.
scripts.translation:
這是全村用來裝飲用水的水容器。
一邊裝乾淨的水，另一邊裝相對乾淨的水。
