scripts.translation: ^0000ff似乎還沒有加固好。材料沒有消失，請繼續嘗試^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffCamille's body is trembling thinly with the excitement after the battle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff卡米爾的身體因戰鬥後的興奮而微微顫抖。^000000

scripts.text: You had pretty good movement
scripts.translation: 你的身手相當不錯

scripts.text: That was terrible. Don't touch a sword again
scripts.translation: 太糟糕了。別再碰劍了

scripts.text: Why did you abandon the carriage and come this far??
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要拋棄馬車跑到這裡來？

scripts.text: Isn't it just an accident? Apologizing might be unnecessary....
scripts.translation: 這不只是一次意外嗎？道歉可能沒必要....

scripts.text: You're being too harsh on the trade manager.
scripts.translation: 你對貿易管理員太苛刻了。

scripts.text: I'm not going to argue with you anymore. Just do what you think is best..
scripts.translation: 我不想再和你爭辯了。做你認為最好的事吧..

scripts.text: Should we run away?
scripts.translation: 我們要逃跑嗎？

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt seems like you're not in a state to listen to the conversation properly.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff看來你現在的狀態無法好好聽對話。^000000

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you loose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 您當前攜帶的物品 -
- 數量過多。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再次嘗試。 -

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I can't have made the wrong choice in coming here...?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我來到這裡...應該沒有做錯選擇吧？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
We can get most things here, but not steel. I'd like to ask for a small favor. Just 3...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
這裡能買到大部分東西，但沒有鋼材。我想請個小忙。只要3...

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Steel!! Steel, when will it come! ... oh it's here. You're here, Adventurer. It's heavy, isn't it? Give it to me. I can't let you hold it for another second, you're a precious person. Thank you. You've done a good job.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
鋼材！！鋼材，什麼時候到！...哦，到了。你來了，冒險者。很重吧？給我吧。我不能讓你再多拿一秒，你是珍貴的人。謝謝你。你做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
When the clinic is completed, we'll engrave your name on the foundation stone so that your name will live on in the lives of future newborns.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
診所建成後，我們會把你的名字刻在奠基石上，讓後來出生的孩子也能記住你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Although time passes and the building disappears, the adventurer's will will remain forever.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
雖然時間流逝，建築會消失，但冒險者的意志將永遠留存。

scripts.text: No, it's not necessary...
scripts.translation: 不，沒必要...

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
With this steel, I'll now build a clinic that would withstand any kind of weather, and will stand up to any elements.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
有了這些鋼材，我現在就能建造一座診所，它能抵禦任何惡劣天氣，無懼任何自然元素。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Wait, what are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
等等，你在幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Are you saying you're going to build a Clinic? Now?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你是說你要建診所？現在？

scripts.text: Calm down, old man...
scripts.translation: 冷靜點，老人家...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What do you mean by Calm down? We're having an ice-cold, rational conversation. Now!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼叫冷靜點？我們現在正在進行一場冰冷而理性的對話。現在！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Why are you doing this? Are you being territorial about the newcomers?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
你為什麼要這樣做？你是對新人抱有領地意識嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh my, we're not those kind of people.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哎呀，我們可不是那種人。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Then why are you so opposed to it?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
那你為什麼這麼反對？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The comfortable life you want is a trap. Something foreign, something comfortable. Those things will ruin us.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你想要的那種舒適生活是個陷阱。那些外來的、舒適的東西，會毀了我們。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Comfortable housing, thriving schools, clean clinics. Why shouldn't we have them? We've avoided discrimination, not convenience.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
舒適的住房，繁榮的學校，乾淨的診所。為什麼我們不能擁有這些？我們避開的是歧視，而不是便利。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I live here anyway, what's the harm in having better facilities?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
反正我住在這裡，擁有更好的設施有什麼壞處？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
No, I guess that's what the newcomers want?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
不，我想這就是新人想要的吧？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Accustoming your body to comfort makes an uncomfortable life unbearable. Live with satisfaction within the minimum life they provide.
They say that if you protest, they will take this away too.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
讓身體習慣舒適，會讓不舒適的生活變得無法忍受。在最低限度的生活中知足吧。
他們說，如果你抗議，他們連這個也會拿走。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
How long do you think we're going to live here, never mind take our land back!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你覺得我們要在這裡住多久？更別提奪回我們的土地了！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What you have now is enough, what more do you need?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你現在擁有的已經足夠了，還需要什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I'm not doing this because I'm ungrateful. They say that they are not bringing it here because this it's too foreign for them. Technology and facilities have developed over time, but you just don't understand it!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我這麼做不是因為我不感恩。他們說他們不把這些帶到這裡，是因為這裡對他們來說太陌生了。技術和設施隨著時間發展，但你就是不明白！

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Oh my, I think I'm dying. Help...
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
哎呀，我覺得我要死了。救命...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ezekiel!!! Something is wrong!
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
以西結！！！出事了！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Maram? What is it? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
瑪拉姆？怎麼了？發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Joel]
If I die... put my accumulated wealth...! With me. Did you get it?! It's unfair! Maram, make sure you guard my grave well! Don't let a single penny be stolen!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
如果我死了...把我積累的財富...！跟我一起。你聽到了嗎？！這不公平！瑪拉姆，一定要好好守護我的墳墓！別讓一分錢被偷走！

scripts.text:
[Maram]
No, you won't die. Don't be ominous.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你不會死的。別說這種不吉利的話。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What's wrong with Joel?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
喬爾怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
There's been an accident while moving the luggage. I need to get it taken care of quickly. Can you do that, Ezekiel?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
搬執行李時出了事故。我需要儘快處理一下。以西結，你能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh my, how come? I can't use one leg at all and I'm still fine.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哎呀，怎麼會這樣？我一條腿完全不能用了，但我還活著呢。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Let me see. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
讓我看看。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Let's move it to my house quickly. I may not be able to use my legs, but I need to at least apply some medicine to prevent them from rotting.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
趕緊把他送到我家去。雖然我的腿不能動，但至少得先上點藥，防止腐爛。

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Do I have to cut my legs off like Mr. White Pine over here? I can't do that... I just bought a new pair of work boots...!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
難道我要像那邊的白松先生一樣把腿砍掉嗎？我做不到...我剛買了一雙新工作靴...！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Are your boots a problem now?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你的靴子現在是個問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Joel]
... That's right, Maram. I have a favor to ask. Can you find someone who is missing a left leg but has a healthy right leg? I guess I'll have to sell him my right boot.
Sir, please make this as smooth as possible.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
...沒錯，瑪拉姆。我有件事想拜託你。你能幫我找一個缺了左腿但右腿健康的人嗎？我想把我的右靴賣給他。
先生，請儘量讓這件事順利一點。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I'm not going to cutting your leg off, I can heal it.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我不會砍掉你的腿，我能治好它。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What? With a leg that is shaped like that?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼？那種形狀的腿？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
How do you fix a leg like that...! Let's cut it off and put some medicine on it to stop it from getting infected! Don't waste time by holding it...!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
怎麼治那種腿...！快砍掉，上點藥防止感染！別浪費時間抱著它...！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I'm saying I can do it because I can do it. Everybody, get out of the way.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我說我能治，就是因為我確實能治。大家讓開。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
You'll have to trust him. Ezekiel may not look like much in your eyes, but he's pretty good, right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你得相信他。以西結在你眼裡可能不起眼，但他其實很厲害，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
No, the time is...!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
不，時間不多了...！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Ahhh... If only we had the right equipment... I could have done it faster... I can't help it.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
啊...如果我們有合適的裝置...我本可以做得更快...沒辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Aaaaaah!!! I'm dying!!!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
啊啊啊！！！我要死了！！！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Adventurer, how's it going, can I start my construction?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
冒險者，你好，我可以開始施工了嗎？

scripts.text: About that...
scripts.translation: 關於那個...

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I'm trying to keep it out of the way so it doesn't affect anything else, but I guess that doesn't work either.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我試著把它放在不礙事的地方，以免影響其他東西，但看來這樣也不行。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
But I can't give up, and I'm glad you're willing to come back and talk about it, but before then, I need to get a group of like-minded people together and get ready to convince them.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
但我不能放棄。很高興你願意回來和我討論這件事，不過在那之前，我需要召集一些志同道合的人，並說服他們做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I thought about doing what they said, but I can't. I don't know what else to do, but this is something I need to do.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我考慮過照他們說的做，但我做不到。我不知道還能怎麼辦，但這是我必須做的事。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Speaking of which, Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
說到這個，冒險者，我有件事想拜託你。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
You can get most things here, but not Steel. Because of how difficult it is to bring it in, not to mention you need a lot of facilities to make Steel. So, Would it be okay if you bring me 3 of them? just 3...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
這裡大部分東西都能買到，唯獨買不到鋼鐵。因為運輸非常困難，而且製造鋼鐵還需要很多裝置。所以，能麻煩你幫我帶3塊過來嗎？只要3塊...

scripts.text: I'll bring it to you.
scripts.translation: 我會帶過來的。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Thank you for your generosity. I'm glad you're so sympathetic to my cause and willing to help... I'll go get ready for construction.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
謝謝你的慷慨。我很感激你同情我的處境並願意幫忙...我去準備施工了。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Please convince <NAVI>[sir]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>that we need this facility.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
請說服<NAVI>[先生]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，我們需要這個設施。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Ezekiel, you didn't come here to live a life of riches. You came here to do a job!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
以西結，你來到這裡不是為了過富裕的生活。你是來工作的！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
No, but to live here as myself is to really live. I am an eternal stranger here, am I not?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
不，但在這裡做我自己，才是真正地活著。我永遠是這裡的異鄉人，不是嗎？

scripts.text: That person...?
scripts.translation: 那個人...？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Shhh- wait a minute, listen to what he's saying, he sounds like he's saying something.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
噓——等一下，聽聽他在說什麼，他好像有話要說。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
No, but I'm just as much an outsider here as I am there. Isn't that the same? Shouldn't I be more comfortable?
Maybe I should just give up and go home.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
不，但在這裡和在那裡一樣，我都是個局外人。這難道不是一樣的嗎？我不應該更自在一些嗎？
也許我該放棄，回家算了。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
No, but that's what I initially aimed for. Finding my roots...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
不，但這正是我最初的初衷。尋找我的根基...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Ezekiel! How have you been? Why are you muttering to yourself like that?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
以西結！最近怎麼樣？為什麼一個人在那裡自言自語？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Maram? Maram?? That's great. You know what, listen to me. You're busy? You're busy, but listen. Who am I going to tell this to? I don't even know anybody yet. So listen to me.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
瑪拉姆？瑪拉姆？？太好了。你知道嗎，聽我說。你很忙？你很忙，但請聽我說。我還能跟誰說這些呢？我甚至還不認識這裡的人。所以請聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I told you I was going to build a clinic here. When I came here, there was no decent clinic, so I build one.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我告訴過你，我要在這裡建一家診所。我來這裡的時候，沒有一家像樣的診所，所以我建了一家。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's right. That's why I got a lot of things to fill it with this time.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
沒錯。所以我這次帶了很多東西來填充它。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I did that, but as soon as I started digging, the elders here stopped me. They say we should live in harmony with nature as we have done up until now, but they look at me as some sort of environmental destroyer. Am I that kind of person?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我確實這麼做了，但剛開始挖掘，這裡的長老們就阻止了我。他們說我們應該像以前那樣與自然和諧共處，但他們看我的眼神就像我是個破壞環境的人。我是那種人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Is it really that destructive to nature and the environment to just build a more hygienic, more modern clinic, which would allow for a faster response in an emergency?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
僅僅為了建一家更衛生、更現代的診所，以便在緊急情況下能更快響應，真的會對自然和環境造成那麼大的破壞嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
No. You aren't that kind of person. Everyone else, but never you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
不。你不是那種人。其他人也許是這樣，但你絕不是。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Isn't that right? And you've gotten me to the point where... I'm not doing anything right now because I'm thinking, Am I really a bad person?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
是這樣吧？而且你把我逼到了這種地步...我現在什麼都沒做，因為我在想，我真的是個壞人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
If that's the case, you should talk to Suad. That's not fair. We're all trying to live together. The clinic isn't against nature. Oh, come on.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
如果是這樣的話，你應該去和蘇阿德談談。這不公平。我們都在努力共同生活。診所並不違背自然。哎呀，真是的。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Well... I talked to Suad... but he said there was nothing he could do and that he couldn't do what he wanted either.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
嗯...我和蘇阿德談過了...但他說他無能為力，而且他也沒法做他想做的事。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I told him that we need a clinic, but we can't just push it through because the elderly people who have lived here for a long time are against it, so we have to convince them.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我告訴他我們需要一家診所，但我們不能強行推進，因為在這裡生活了很久的老人們反對，所以我們必須說服他們。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
From the sounds of it, so does he. We can't ignore the opinions of the elders, after all, and it's not like Suad's the kind of guy who'd bend over backwards to do so.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
聽上去，他也是這麼想的。畢竟我們不能忽視長老們的意見，而且蘇阿德也不是那種會為了這事彎腰折腰的人。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
So... I'm... going back to Rachel... What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
所以...我...打算回拉赫...你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
What, you came this far and you're going back?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
什麼，你走了這麼遠，現在要回去？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
No, I didn't set out to go back... It's just that people are like that, they come here to have a better life, and if it's the same here or there, why wouldn't they want to stay where it's easier...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
不，我並不是特意要回去...只是人們就是這樣，他們來這裡是為了過上更好的生活，如果這裡和那裡都一樣，他們為什麼不想留在更容易的地方呢...

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
So what I'm saying is... I'm trying to figure it out. When did I say I would just cut it and go back? Can you please not listen to me however you want?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
所以我的意思是...我正在想辦法。我什麼時候說過我會放棄並回去了？你能不能別按你的想法來理解我？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Hmmm... but the clinic is a necessity as far as I'm concerned, and if I can make the case...
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
嗯...但在我看來，診所是必需的，如果我能說服大家...

scripts.text:
[Maram]
That's right! I think the adventurer might be able to help us out. You know, this adventurer is really good at talking, don't you think his face makes him believable? This is just the kind of prize that grown-ups like.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
沒錯！我覺得那位冒險者也許能幫上忙。你看，這位冒險者真的很擅長說話，你不覺得他的長相讓人信服嗎？這正是像我們這樣的成年人喜歡的型別。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
He has a big heart, and he helped us buy and transport supplies.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
他心地善良，還幫我們購買和運輸物資。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
He's a nice guy. He's a good man, yes, but...
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
他是個好人。他是個好男人，沒錯，但是...

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
...Is that really the kind of person who gets the favor of the adults? They're so... so... stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
...他真的是那種能贏得長輩青睞的人嗎？他們太...太...固執了。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
You have to make the most of it. Even if I can't persuade you, what else is there to do but listen to more nagging? Is that the adventurer going to listen to that instead?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
你得好好利用這個機會。即使我沒法說服你，除了聽更多的嘮叨還能做什麼呢？難道讓那位冒險者去聽那些嘮叨嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Well... Can I ask you a favor?
Adventurer, do me a favor, we really need a modern clinic here, even if it's not as big as the one from Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
嗯...能請你幫個忙嗎？
冒險者，幫個忙吧，我們真的需要在這裡建一家現代化的診所，即使它沒有拉赫的那家那麼大。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Where I am now, if I get hurt or sick, I have to rely on folk remedies from the past.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
在我現在的地方，如果我受傷或生病，只能依靠過去的民間療法。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I have some medicines and medical supplies from Rachel, but they are scarce, and I'm not in the right place to use them.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我有一些從拉赫帶來的藥品和醫療用品，但它們很稀缺，而且我不在適合使用它們的地方。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
But there's nothing I can do to convince the naysayers, so I'm going to ask an adventurer <NAVI>[sir]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to do it for me.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
但我無法說服那些反對者，所以我要請一位冒險者 <NAVI>[先生]<INFO>wolfvill,176,111,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 來替我做到這一點。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Please do, and in the meantime, I'll go meet some other people.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
拜託了，在此期間，我會去見見其他人。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
How about this? Don't push yourself for a while, eat good food, think good thoughts, and rest well, and you'll be able to walk or run lightly.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
這樣吧？暫時別勉強自己，吃點好的，保持心情愉快，好好休息，你就能輕鬆自如地行走甚至奔跑了。

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Am I alive?? Am I alive?? Is my leg okay??
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
我還活著嗎？？我還活著嗎？？我的腿沒事吧？？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Uh, since you say it is, it must be, right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
呃，既然你說沒事，那應該就沒問題吧？

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Thank you so much!! You saved my boots! What's your name? I'll be good to you in the future. You're my savior. I never forget his saviors. For life.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
太感謝您了！！您救了我的腿！請問您貴姓？我以後一定好好報答您。您是我的救命恩人。我這輩子都不會忘記救命恩人的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
So, how did you save the leg?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
那麼，你是怎麼救他的腿的？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Because that's what I learned. If the clinic had been properly equipped, we could have treated him more completely and accelerated his recovery.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
因為我是這麼學的。如果診所的裝置齊全，我們就能更徹底地治療他，並加快他的康復速度。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hmm... Is that what everyone does these days?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯……現在大家都這麼做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yeah, it's not going to cost you your leg, as long as you treat it right.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
是的，只要處理得當，就不會失去那條腿。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
You can do that faster and more appropriately if you have a clinic, right?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如果有診所，就能更快、更妥善地處理，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yes...? Isn't that right...?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
是的……？難道不是嗎……？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hmm... That's the way it is these days, isn't it, Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯……現在就是這樣的吧，冒險者？

scripts.text: That's the way it is these days.
scripts.translation: 現在就是這樣的。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Like I said, it's not the technology of the foreigns, it's the technology and facilities of the advanced era.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
正如我所說的，這不是外國的技術，而是先進時代的技術和設施。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hmm, I don't think this is something you should just blindly oppose.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，我覺得這件事不應該盲目反對。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Right? That's my opinion too. It's about saving people. If we do it our way, we can save something from death.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
對吧？我也是這麼想的。這是為了救人。如果我們這樣做，就能從死亡中挽救一些東西。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hmm... How long would it take to build that clinic?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯……建那座診所需要多久？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Eh...? Well, it depends on labor and capital.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
呃……？這取決於人力和資金。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We'll help you as much as we can. Let's build it.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我們會盡最大努力幫助你。讓我們把它建起來吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Instead, it should fit in with the way of life here, it should fit in with the place.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
相反，它應該融入這裡的生活方式，應該與這個地方相協調。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I see... I understand it.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我明白了……我理解你的意思。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Wow, you guys thought of everything. This is exactly what I need, and I'm all for it.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
哇，你們考慮得真周到。這正是我需要的，我完全支援。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Is there anything else we need here?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這裡還需要什麼別的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What, you're accepting more than clinics?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼，你們還接受診所以外的專案？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Didn't that make you think? You have to go with the flow. You can't be stubborn forever.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
難道你沒想過嗎？得順應潮流。不能永遠固執己見。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I mean, we're not going to live the way we do now, even if we do reclaim our land. We already live differently than we used to.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我的意思是，即使我們奪回土地，也不會像現在這樣生活。我們的生活方式已經和以前不一樣了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hey, young man, if there's anything else that's important or necessary, let me know and we'll give it some thought.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嘿，年輕人，如果還有其他重要或必要的事情，告訴我，我們會考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I will. I'll build the clinic as close to this place as possible, as you said.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我會的。正如您所說，我會盡可能讓診所貼近這裡的環境。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Yeah. You know we're not going to live here forever, right?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
是啊。你知道我們不會永遠住在這裡，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yes, that's exactly what I thought.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
是的，這正是我所想的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, we'll take our leave. Thank you for your time today.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
好了，我們要走了。感謝你今天抽出時間。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Let's see!!!
Whoa- that's a relief, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
讓我們看看！！！
哇——這下放心多了，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yeah, it's there... right? But it's so abrupt that it's a little baffling, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
是啊，它在那裡...對吧？但這轉折來得太突然，讓人有點摸不著頭腦，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maram]
Now that they've seen it with their own eyes, they think differently. That's good. Now, let's finish what we started, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
既然他們親眼看到了，想法就變了。這很好。現在，讓我們繼續完成開始的事情，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Yes. But first, I think we need to change the design to match this place.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
是的。但首先，我認為我們需要修改設計，以匹配這個地方。

scripts.text:
[Maram]
The Adventurer will help you, right?
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
冒險者會幫你的，對吧？

scripts.text: That's... right...

[Maram]
If you need any equipment or tools, let me know in advance and I'll bring them next time.
Joel, let's go get some rest, too.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉姆]
如果你需要任何裝置或工具，提前告訴我，我下次會帶來。
喬爾，我們也去休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Joel]
Goodbye, my savior. I'll be back in the near future!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾]
再見，我的救星。我很快就會回來的！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Adventurer, thank you so much for your help. This is what I got when I got settled here, and I don't need anything... I'll give it to you, Adventurer, as a token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
冒險者，非常感謝你的幫助。這是我定居在這裡後得到的，我不需要...我把它送給你，冒險者，作為我感激之情的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Well, until next time, and maybe I'll ask you for a favor, so stop by often!
^4d4dffThis will result in a favorable evaluation of you.^000000
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
好了，下次見，也許我會請你幫忙，所以請常來！
^4d4dff這將對你產生有利的評價。^000000
^4d4dff灰狼的村民們已接納你為村莊的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Well, until next time, and maybe I'll ask you for a favor, so stop by often!
^4d4dffThis will result in a favorable evaluation of you.^000000
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
好了，下次見，也許我會請你幫忙，所以請常來！
^4d4dff這將對你產生有利的評價。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Ugh, it's hard. Adventurer, what's going on here. The thing you brought me is under construction... It's dangerous if you're here, so come back after dawn.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
唉，真難。冒險者，這裡怎麼回事。你帶給我的東西正在施工中...你在這裡很危險，所以請在黎明後再來。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Hello, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
你好，冒險者。

scripts.text: How's the construction going?
scripts.translation: 施工進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
It's fine. But we're still short on some things, like Steel and Very Unusual Crystals.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
還好。但我們還缺一些東西，比如鋼鐵和堅不可摧結晶。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
They use a lot of crystals here, and they're very hard, so they're great to use here and there.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
這裡用了很多結晶，而且它們非常堅硬，所以很適合在這裡使用。

scripts.text: I'll get it for you.
scripts.translation: 我會為你弄到的。

scripts.text: I'd love to get you one, but...
scripts.translation: 我很想幫你弄一個，但是...

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Are you busy? It seemed like that. Even if you are busy, make sure to eat your meals.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
你很忙嗎？看起來是這樣。即使你很忙，也要記得按時吃飯。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Wow, thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
哇，非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I would need 1 Steel and 10 Very Unusual Crystal, and the Very Unusual Crystal can be obtained from the Gray Wolf.
I'll wait!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我需要1個鋼鐵和10個堅不可摧結晶，堅不可摧結晶可以從灰狼身上獲得。
我會等著的！

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Thank you, Adventurer, for your efforts. Uh... but we're a little low on quantity, did you forget...?
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
謝謝你，冒險者，你的努力。呃...但是我們的數量有點少，你忘了嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
I would need 1 Steel and 10 Very Unusual Crystal, and the Very Unusual Crystal can be obtained from the Gray Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
我需要1個鋼鐵和10個堅不可摧結晶，堅不可摧結晶可以從灰狼身上獲得。

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I'm always grateful. I'll take a break today and see you again after dawn!
^4d4dff The villagers of the gray wolf have accepted you as part of the village.^000000
You are eligible to participate in the ^4d4dff conference.^000000
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
冒險者，你辛苦了。我一直很感激。我今天休息一下，黎明後再見！
^4d4dff灰狼的村民們已接納你為村莊的一員。^000000
你有資格參加^4d4dff會議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ezekiel]
Adventurer, you've worked hard. I'm always grateful. I'll take a break today and see you again after dawn!
scripts.translation:
[以西結]
冒險者，你辛苦了。我一直很感激。我今天休息一下，黎明後再見！

scripts.text:
[Old man]
If you have any difficulties in life, tell me.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如果你在生活中有任何困難，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Do you have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你有什麼問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I've got to see the newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我得去看看新來的人。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The people who came in this time will also have to adapt well.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
這次來的人也需要好好適應。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We'll have to take another look.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我們得再仔細看看。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
She doesn't like it when I visit too often. You think it's the same as when we were kids?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
她不喜歡我常去打擾。你覺得這和我們小時候一樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Now, if you want to live here from now on, you have to fit in. You have to follow the rules here so we can all live in harmony.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
既然你想在這裡生活，就必須融入其中。要遵守這裡的規矩，大家才能和睦相處。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Whether it's the same as ours or not, it's always nice to have one more neighbor to talk to. Who doesn't love a friendly neighbor?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
不管是不是和我們一樣，多一個能聊天的鄰居總是好事。誰不喜歡友好的鄰居呢？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Who are you? I don't recognize you.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你是誰？我不認識你。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh, you're back again? Wasn't it a while ago? Are you going to be here more often now?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦，你又回來了？不是很久以前的事嗎？你以後會常來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Welcome, welcome, welcome, and be sure to ask if you have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
歡迎，歡迎，歡迎。如果有問題，儘管問。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Feel free to ask, not everyone here is bothered by that.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
儘管問吧，這裡並不是每個人都介意這個。

scripts.text: I'm here for a clinic matter...
scripts.translation: 我是為了診所的事來的...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What's that? A clinic? This can't be the clinic they're building, can it?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼？診所？這不是他們正在建的那個診所吧？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I think I said it well enough for everyone to understand. There is no need to build a clinic, and you should not build one.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我想我已經說得很清楚了，大家都聽懂了。不需要建診所，也不應該建。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Why build a new building, a foreign one even, when you can just do the treatment where you are now?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
既然可以在原地治療，為什麼要建一座新的、甚至像是外來的建築呢？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Isn't that how we all live without it?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
難道我們一直不都是這樣生活的嗎？

scripts.text: Because medical facilities are important.
scripts.translation: 因為醫療設施很重要。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
No, what? So you're saying this is because we don't think it's important? Are we not good enough?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
不，什麼？你的意思是，因為我們覺得不重要嗎？是我們不夠好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We know it's good, we know it's comfortable, we know how good it is, but you can't get used to it.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我們知道它很好，知道它很舒適，知道它有多好，但你不能習慣它。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We get used to the way of life of the foreigners, and eventually we get used to it, and then we can't live without that convenience.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我們會習慣外來的生活方式，最終習以為常，然後就無法離開那種便利了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What you have now is enough, but you shouldn't rely on it. That means losing.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你現在擁有的已經足夠了，但你不應該依賴它。依賴就意味著失去。

scripts.text: But it's a necessary facility.
scripts.translation: 但這是必要的設施。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, it hasn't been lacking, because if it had, we wouldn't have survived here for as long as we have.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，我們並不缺乏，因為如果缺乏，我們就不可能在這裡生存這麼久。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Anyway, I think that's the case. Even though I said it in a nice way, you still don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
總之，我覺得情況就是這樣。雖然我話說得委婉，但你還是不明白。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
If you want to live here from now on, you'd better forget all about life over there as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如果你打算在這裡生活下去，最好儘快忘掉那邊的生活方式。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The sooner you adapt to life here, the better off you will be.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你越早適應這裡的生活，對你越好。

scripts.text: I'm not... I'm not from here...
scripts.translation: 我...我不是這裡的人...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
What? You're not even from here? What right do you have to interfere?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什麼？你甚至不是這裡的人？你有什麼資格插手？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Calm down. You can do that. Don't be mad at him, he's been helping your kids.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
冷靜點。你可以那樣做。別生他的氣，他一直在幫你的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]

scripts.translation:
[老人]
關於<NAVI>[那顆牙齒]<INFO>wolfvill,171,253,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>的事，我們稍後在診所再談，但我認為應該把外人擋在外面。

scripts.text:
[Old man]
I'll have to go to the newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我得去見見新來的人。

scripts.text: He is busy sharpening his knife, so I call, but there is no answer.
scripts.translation: 他正忙著磨刀，我喊他，但他沒有回應。

scripts.text:
[Larama]
Oh, I'm busy right now. We'll talk later.
scripts.translation:
[拉拉瑪]
哦，我現在正忙著。我們稍後再談。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
...
Hunting non-monster animals in this forest is forbidden for outsiders..
Don't catch any rabbits.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
...
禁止外人在這片森林裡獵殺非魔物動物。
不要抓兔子。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
...You say an adventurer has arrived.
Are you wandering around, looking for something to do?
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
...聽說有冒險者來了。
你是在四處遊蕩，想找點事做嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
If you don't have anything to do, don't just sit around here and watch the fire that's been lit over there.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
如果你沒事做，別隻是坐在這裡看那邊燒著的火。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
I am in charge of livestock and wildlife viewing with the Eruin and their families over there.
It's also my job to maintain knives and other blades.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
我負責和那邊的埃魯因家族一起管理牲畜和野生動物觀賞。
維護刀具和其他刃具也是我的工作。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
...Tsk tsk.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
...嘖，嘖。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
If there's one thing I'd leave to an outsider, it's to checking the traps I set this morning.
Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
如果有一件事我可以交給外人的，那就是檢查我今早設下的陷阱。
你能做到嗎？

scripts.text: That shouldn't be too hard
scripts.translation: 這應該不難

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
It's good to have a quick answer.
...
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
回答得真快。
...

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
<NAVI>[Gray Wolf Forest]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> If you look around, you'll see a bunch of traps..
If you've got some time, go get five of them.
If you leave the remaining bait alone, something will catch on it again, so you'll just have to wait and see.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
<NAVI>[灰狼森林]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> 如果你四處看看，會看到一堆陷阱。
如果你有時間，去取回五個。
如果剩下的誘餌不動，會有東西再次咬鉤，所以你只能等著看。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
謝謝你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
<NAVI>[Gray Wolf Forest]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>I'd like you to collect about 5 of the things caught in the trap.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
<NAVI>[灰狼森林]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>我想請你收集大約5個被陷阱捕獲的東西。

[Eruin]
...Okay. Good job.
If you're free enough to hang around here tomorrow, can I ask you again?
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
...好吧。幹得好。
如果你明天有空閒時間留在這裡，我可以再拜託你嗎？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: I think I'll be busy tomorrow
scripts.translation: 我想明天會很忙

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Okay. I'm in charge of trapping and grooming, so I'm always working, so if you peek again, I'll know and I'll make you do the work instead of bothering me.
It's no different for an outsider.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
好吧。我負責設定陷阱和舔毛，所以我一直在工作，如果你再次偷看，我會知道，並讓你代替我工作。
對外人來說也是一樣。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Go back and rest today.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
今天回去休息吧。

scripts.text:
[Eruin]
Are you here? I see you're snooping around again, so it looks like you're free.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
你在這裡？我看到你又在四處窺探，看來你有空。

scripts.text: Go investigate the trap
scripts.translation: 去調查陷阱

scripts.text: Chat
scripts.translation: 聊天

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

If you lend a hand, I have a lot of other things to do, so I appreciate it.
While going around the area, collect 5 things caught in the traps I've set up.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
如果你能幫忙，我還有很多其他事情要做，所以我很感激。
在四處走動時，收集5個被我設定的陷阱捕獲的東西。

scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Decline

別動來動去，坐好。你坐立不安。

It would be nice if you could gather about 5 things caught in traps from <NAVI>[Gray Wolf Forest]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[埃魯因]
如果你能從<NAVI>[灰狼森林]<INFO>gw_fild01,25,101,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>收集大約5個被陷阱捕獲的東西，那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Ah, an outsider...
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
啊，一個外人...

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Haaam... Huh? Someone I haven't seen before. Are you a new member of the Gray Wolf Village?
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
哈姆... 咦？沒見過的人。你是灰狼村的新成員嗎？
唉...

scripts.text: Did you have trouble sleeping last night?
scripts.translation: 昨晚沒睡好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Yes, I couldn't sleep a wink.
Haaam... In the forest of the Gray Wolves, if you lie down to sleep, you hear all sorts of sounds.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
是啊，我一點都睡不著。
哈姆... 在灰狼的森林裡，躺下睡覺時能聽到各種各樣的聲音。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
The sounds of fireflies, the chatter of adults, the sounds of beasts...
The most disturbing sound that disrupts sleep is the cries of various monsters
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
螢火蟲的聲音，大人的閒聊聲，野獸的吼叫聲...
最讓人無法安睡的是各種魔物的叫聲。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Huam... Among them, the cries of the {0} are the most frightening.
People even worry that they might bring sparks and burn down the entire village.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
呼姆... 其中，{0}的叫聲最讓人害怕。
人們甚至擔心它們會引來火花，把整個村莊燒掉。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
The sight of them crying with sparks in their mouths and the suppressed voices are truly terrifying...
Ugh, just thinking about it makes my body tremble.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
看著它們嘴裡含著火花哭泣，還有那壓抑的聲音，真的非常可怕...
唉，光是想想我就渾身發抖。

scripts.text: I'm an Adventurer, shall I hunt them down for you?
scripts.translation: 我是冒險者，要我幫你們把它們趕盡殺絕嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Wow! You're an Adventurer?
In that case, I'll definitely ask for your help!
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
哇！你是冒險者？
那一定要請你幫忙了！

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Would you catch only 30 {0} for us?
If we hunt down a bunch, maybe the {1} will keep quiet for tonight.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
你能只抓30只{0}嗎？
如果我們把它們都趕盡殺絕，也許今晚{1}就會安靜下來。

scripts.text: Just leave it to me!
scripts.translation: 就交給我吧！

scripts.text: Oops, I'm in a bit of a pickle right now.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我現在有點忙。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Well, I imagine even adventurers like you must be busy, right?
I know you are been busy right now, but have you ever try to close your eyes and sleep well with all these various noises? That's what happened to me recently.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
嗯，我想像你們這樣的冒險者肯定也很忙吧？
我知道你現在很忙，但你有沒有試過閉上眼睛，在這些嘈雜聲中好好睡一覺？我最近就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Wow, thank you, Adventurer!
It's 30 {0}. I'll be counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
哇，謝謝你，冒險者！
是30只{0}。拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Once you've hunted them all down please let me know by return to me. I'll prepare a small reward for you!
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
等你把它們都趕盡殺絕後，請回來告訴我。我會準備一點小獎勵給你的！

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Thank you, Adventurer!
There are 30 {0}. Please, take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
謝謝你，冒險者！
有30只{0}。請多關照。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Thank you! The chirping sound of the windstorm kite has definitely been reduced!
I can sleep comfortably tonight.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
謝謝！風箏的叫聲確實減少了！
今晚我可以睡個好覺了。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
Okay, it probably won't last long.
It will increase again tomorrow, but I hope you will come again after dawn and catch a {0}.
scripts.translation:
[阿希爾]
好吧，這大概持續不了多久。
明天聲音又會變大，但希望你在黎明後能再來抓一隻{0}。

scripts.text:
[Ahir]
This is a thank you for letting me sleep well tonight.
Please accept even a small heart, adventurer.

如果你現在挑釁我，可能會因為邪惡而變得更吵。

scripts.text:

If you hunt in a group, the {0} will probably be silent tonight.
scripts.translation:

如果你組隊狩獵，{0}今晚大概就會安靜下來。

scripts.text: For sure, I will catch them all.

scripts.text: I'm not interested to catch them.
scripts.translation: 我對抓它們沒興趣。

Well, I suppose you're busy too, Adventurer?
You must be tired, so go ahead and get some rest. It might be hard to sleep with all this chipred, though.
scripts.translation:

好吧，我想你也很忙吧，冒險者？
你一定累了，去休息吧。不過，聽著這些嘰嘰喳喳的聲音，可能很難入睡。

...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
...

scripts.text:
[Albert]
If you ever decide to go back to Rachel, will you do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
如果你決定回拉赫，能幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Albert]
To put it bluntly... I have a friend who worked as a clerk at Rachel's hotel.
If he hasn't come here yet, he's probably still working there.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
直說吧...我有個朋友在拉赫的酒店當職員。
如果他還沒來這裡，他大概還在那裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
Me and my friend... Horim has lived next door to me since we were kids.
I used to live in Rachel, but I couldn't stand it anymore, so...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
我和我的朋友...霍里姆從小就是鄰居。
我以前住在拉赫，但我再也受不了了，所以...

scripts.text:
[Albert]
Their family and my family decided to knit Rachel.
But Horim said he would stay in Rachel.
We couldn't wait any longer, so we left him behind and moved him here.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
他們家和我家決定把拉赫織起來。
但霍里姆說他要留在拉赫。
我們等不了了，所以把他留在那裡，搬到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
Rachel is a big city, but right now he's alone.
...
If you don't mind, I was wondering if I could stop by and see how he is doing.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
拉赫是個大城市，但現在他一個人。
...
如果不介意的話，我想去那裡看看他過得怎麼樣。

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: I'm not going anywhere for a while.
scripts.translation: 我暫時不會去那裡。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
If that's the case, so be it then.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
如果是這樣，那就這樣吧。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
thanks.
Just... stop by and take a look. You don't need to report to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
謝謝。
只是...去那裡看一眼就行。不需要向我彙報。

scripts.text:
[Albert]
You don't need to report to me.
All you have to do is check that Horim is doing well.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯特]
你不需要向我彙報。
你只需要確認霍里姆過得好就行。

scripts.text:
[Alber]
Has he met the boy?
Yes.
...yes.
I said everything I couldn't say when I left.
Now I have no regrets left.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯]
他見到那個男孩了嗎？
是的。
...是的。
我把離開時沒能說出口的話都說了。
現在我沒有遺憾了。

scripts.text:
[Alber]
It feels like a gray forest is shining.
I can't.
All adventurers, thanks to you.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾伯]
感覺灰狼森林在閃閃發光。
我做不到。
所有冒險者，謝謝你們。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Ha~ I wonder what happens when people use such harsh words.
scripts.translation:
[員工]
哈~ 我想知道當人們使用如此嚴厲的話語時會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Ackoooo! Welcome! Freyja's favor be with you!
scripts.translation:
[員工]
啊~ 歡迎！願弗蕾雅眷顧你！

scripts.text:
[Horim]
I've never seen anything like it.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
我從未見過這樣的景象。

scripts.text:
[Horim]
As an adventurer, you see things like this all the time.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
作為一名冒險者，你經常看到這樣的事情。

scripts.text:
[Horim]
What does it look like there?
Word on the street is that it's not a very comfortable place to live.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
那裡看起來怎麼樣？
據說那裡不是一個很舒服的居住地方。

scripts.text:
[Horim]
Still...
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
不過...

scripts.text:
[Horim]
I like this path.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
我喜歡這條路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This length?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個長度嗎？

scripts.text:
[Horim]
There are so many monsters, you can't go alone...
You've traveled so much, aren't you getting a little tired of adventuring?
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
魔物太多了，你不能一個人去...
你走了這麼遠的路，難道不覺得有點厭倦冒險了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Horim]
That's okay, I'm good at this.
After all, this is what I do for a living.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
沒關係，我很擅長這個。
畢竟，這是我的工作。

scripts.text:
[Horim]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[霍里姆]
我們走吧。

scripts.text: Let's head back to the gray wolf forest.
scripts.translation: 讓我們回到灰狼森林。

scripts.text: - This quest is only available for players level 170 and above -
scripts.translation: - 此任務僅對170級及以上的玩家開放 -

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Man, I'm thirsty. Could you get me some water? Your house is the closest.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
天哪，我渴死了。你能幫我拿點水嗎？你家最近。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Do you have anything to eat at home? If not, could you buy some dried fruit?
Man, you're so kind.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你家裡有什麼吃的嗎？如果沒有，能買些乾果嗎？
天哪，你真好。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
There's... nothing to eat.
I don't have any money....
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
沒有...沒有吃的。
我沒有錢....

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Hey, where's this house with nothing to eat?
You're just being stingy, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
嘿，那家沒有吃的房子在哪裡？
你只是小氣，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Disappointing, Naiman.
I thought you were a kind person.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
真令人失望，奈曼。
我還以為你是個善良的人呢。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
Oh, no!
We have water, so I'll go fetch some.
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
啊，不！
我們有水，我去拿一些來。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Fine. Water will be wasted. Where's our share?
Even water is bought with money, yet you claim to have none.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
算了。水也是會浪費的。我們的那份呢？
水也是要用錢買的，可你卻說沒錢。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Ah, I'm hungry and thirsty from playing.
I wish I could sit somewhere cool and have some iced tea with dried fruit.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
啊，玩累了又餓又渴。
真想找個涼快的地方坐著，喝點加了乾果的冰茶。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Why don't you have any money? Doesn't your dad work at Lukshi's pawn shop?
Is it because Lukshi's mom didn't give your dad any money?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你為什麼沒錢？你爸爸不是在盧克希的當鋪工作嗎？
是因為盧克希的媽媽沒給你爸爸錢嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Our mom gives money to your dad, but you don't want to buy us a single fruit that's on sale?
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
我們媽媽給你爸爸錢，可你連打折的水果都不肯給我們買？

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Alright, let's stop. It's pitiful~ Let's stop saying we don't have money.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
好了，別說了。真可憐~ 別再說沒錢了。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
No!!! It's not pitiful....
It's not pitiful...!!
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
不！！！才不可憐....
才不可憐...!!

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Oh, sorry~ It was a joke.
Why are you getting serious and angry. Scary....
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
哦，抱歉~ 我只是開玩笑。
你怎麼這麼認真還生氣了。好可怕....

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
I heard the natives are a bit hot-tempered, but still, isn't it a bit much to get angry one by one?
Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
我聽說原住民脾氣有點急，但即便如此，一個個都生氣是不是有點過了？
不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Yeah, that's right. Even if you're angry, you have to know how to endure it to play together.
Be grateful to us for playing with a kid like you.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
是啊，沒錯。就算生氣，也得學會忍耐才能一起玩。
要感謝我們願意和你這樣的小孩玩。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I want to drink sweet tea with lots of ice.
Then it would be even more fun to play!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
我想喝加了很多冰的甜茶。
那樣玩起來會更有趣！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
It's too hot and I'm thirsty right now.
But I don't want to go home either.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
現在太熱了，我渴死了。
但我也懶得回家。

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Yes, you should thank us!
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
沒錯，你應該感謝我們！

scripts.text: I can't stand it anymore.
scripts.translation: 我受不了了。

scripts.text: Stop bothering us.
scripts.translation: 別來煩我們。

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Hmm? Who are you to interrupt us while we're playing?
You don't seem like you belong here... Why are you meddling?
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
嗯？我們正玩得開心，你算哪根蔥來插嘴？
你看起來不像這裡的人... 為什麼要多管閒事？

scripts.text: Is that playing?
scripts.translation: 那是在玩嗎？

scripts.text: It's playing, not bothering.
scripts.translation: 是在玩，不是來煩人的。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
It's inevitable that we're a bit different from you due to our age~
This one is a native here, and we're all immigrants.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
因為年齡不同，我們和你有點不一樣也是難免的~
這位是這裡的原住民，我們都是移民。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Everyone knows that natives have some shortcomings compared to immigrants, right?
But still, we're all playing together like this.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
大家都知道，和移民相比，原住民有些不足，對吧？
不過，我們大家還是像這樣一起玩。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
No! Who says that? What's the difference between natives and immigrants!
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
不！誰說的？原住民和移民有什麼區別！

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Shouting again.
You're proving that natives are more hot-tempered.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
又在吼了。
你這是在證明原住民脾氣更暴躁。

scripts.text: You're behaving in a way that makes people angry.
scripts.translation: 你的行為讓人生氣。

scripts.text: Of course, people get angry when you speak like that.
scripts.translation: 當然，你那樣說話會讓人生氣。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
But it's true, isn't it?
Naiman's dad works at Lukshi's shop, and Lukshi's mom always says that.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
但這是事實，不是嗎？
奈曼的爸爸在盧克希的店裡工作，盧克希的媽媽總是這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Natives learn things late and are hot-tempered.
But the aunty who hires such natives and pays them a salary is amazing, right?
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
原住民學得慢，脾氣也暴躁。
但僱傭這些原住民並給他們發薪水的那位阿姨，真的很了不起，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
We have cool drinks and snacks at our house!
But it's too far... Isn't Naiman's house the closest from here?
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
我們家有冷飲和零食！
但太遠了... 奈曼的家離這裡最近，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Notice]
 - Your inventory is full. Please check the weight and the quantity of items you're carrying, then talk to me again. -
scripts.translation:
[告示]
 - 您的背包已滿。請檢查攜帶物品的重量和數量，然後再來找我。 -

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
......
Why do you hang out with these kids?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼和這些孩子混在一起？

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
Yes, yes?
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
嗯，嗯？

scripts.text: Why do you let them treat you like this?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼任由他們這樣對待你？

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
Well... they're my friends.
If it weren't for them, I wouldn't have anyone to hang out with.
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
嗯... 他們是我的朋友。
如果沒有他們，我就沒有可以一起玩的人了。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
See? Naiman hangs out with us because he likes it.
If we were really bothering him, he wouldn't hang out with us.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
看吧？奈曼和我們在一起是因為他喜歡。
如果我們真的在打擾他，他就不會和我們一起玩了。

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
I already know that foreigners are busybodies, but....
Don't butt in on things you don't understand.
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
我早就知道外國人愛管閒事，但是....
別插手你不懂的事情。

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
I... I'm going home to get some water.
And... sorry for getting upset for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
我... 我要回家拿水。
還有... 抱歉剛才無緣無故發火。

scripts.text:
[Samariam]
Well, things happen when you hang out together, right?
Don't worry too much.
scripts.translation:
[薩馬裡安]
嗯，大家在一起玩難免會有些小摩擦，對吧？
別太在意。

scripts.text:
[Lukshi]
Let's go somewhere else and have fun.
Let's leave the busybody foreigner here.
scripts.translation:
[盧克希]
我們去別的地方玩吧。
把這個愛管閒事的外國人留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Yeah, let's do that.
Goodbye, foreign adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
是啊，就這麼辦。
再見了，外來的冒險者！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
....Feels like I've gained some life experience.
It's not exactly a pleasant feeling, but....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...感覺像是經歷了一些人生。
雖然不是什麼愉快的體驗，但是...

scripts.text:
[Naiman]
It's hot... I want to go home.
But everyone else wants to play more.....
scripts.translation:
[奈曼]
好熱...我想回家。
但是大家都還想繼續玩.....

scripts.text:
[Notice]
 - Your inventory is full. Please check the weight and the quantity of items you're carrying, then talk to me again. -
scripts.translation:
[告示]
 - 您的背包已滿。請檢查攜帶物品的重量和數量，然後再來找我。 -

scripts.text: - This quest is only available for players level 170 and above -
scripts.translation: - 此任務僅對170級及以上的玩家開放 -

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
They still haven't paid the salary today. It's been three months already...
I'd love to quit this shop right away, but then I wouldn't have any way to get the overdue salary.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
他們今天還是沒有發工資。已經三個月了...
我很想立刻辭職，但那樣我就更拿不到拖欠的工資了。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
And if rumors spread that I quit like that, as a native, I won't be able to work in other shops either.
Oh, what should I do...
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
而且如果傳出去我像這樣辭職了，作為原住民，我也沒法去其他店鋪工作了。
唉，我該怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Oh, were you listening to my story?
Judging by your outfit, you must be an adventurer. How lucky. Living a free life as an adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
哦，你在聽我說話嗎？
看你的裝束，你一定是個冒險者吧。真幸運。作為冒險者過著自由的生活...

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Um, excuse my shamelessness, but I have a favor to ask of you.
Although my boss pretends to listen to me, if it's advice from a famous adventurer like yourself, I think he'll pay attention.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
嗯，請原諒我的唐突，但我有個請求想拜託你。
雖然我的老闆假裝在聽我說話，但如果是像你這樣著名的冒險者給出的建議，我想他會重視的。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Could you please go to my boss's shop and urge him to pay my salary?
I can't even afford to buy tomorrow's meal like this.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
你能去我老闆的店裡，催他發我的工資嗎？
照這樣下去，我連明天的飯都吃不起了。

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我會幫忙的。

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
You don't necessarily have to do that.
I was just curious if you could help a bit.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
你不必非做不可。
我只是好奇你能不能幫點小忙。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Thank you, thank you!
My boss's shop is <NAVI>[here]<INFO>rachel,136,95,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
謝謝你，謝謝你！
我老闆的店在<NAVI>[這裡]<INFO>rachel,136,95,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
You came. Do you have some good news?
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
你來了。有什麼好訊息嗎？

scripts.text: Share my story.
scripts.translation: 分享我的故事

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
They'll pay the overdue salary tomorrow! Oh, thank you so much. I'm really grateful.
Now I can buy food and clothes for my children.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
他們明天會發拖欠的工資！哦，太感謝你了。我真的非常感激。
這樣我就能給孩子買食物和衣服了。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
I might get scolded tomorrow, but honestly, I'm happier that I finally got my salary.
Getting scolded is nothing, it's just for a day or two.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
明天我可能會被罵，但說實話，拿到工資讓我更開心。
被罵沒什麼，也就是一兩天的事。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Aren't you angry? Of course, I am.
But what can I do? Being born as a native was my mistake.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
你不生氣嗎？當然，我生氣。
但我能怎麼辦？生為原住民是我的錯。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
I can't even run away anywhere.
I heard rumors about a village where natives who fled to Veins live, but I doubt if such a place really exists.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
我甚至無處可逃。
我聽說有個村莊，那裡住著逃到伯仁斯的原住民，但我懷疑這樣的地方是否真的存在。

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
But even if it does, I don't have the courage to live there. Oh, I've talked too much.
I'm sorry for keeping you busy. Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
但即使存在，我也沒有勇氣在那裡生活。哦，我說了太多了。
抱歉耽誤了你的時間。非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Amodipin]
Worrying about meals every day, worrying about the children... There's never a day without worry.
Why was I born a native, to suffer unnecessary hardships.
scripts.translation:
[阿莫迪頻]
每天擔心吃飯，擔心孩子...從來沒有一天不擔心的。
為什麼我要生為原住民，承受這些不必要的苦難。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Welcome, I am Dahil.
Nice to meet you. Judging by your attire, you must be an adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
歡迎，我是達希爾。
很高興見到你。看你的裝束，你一定是個冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
I really like adventurers!
I once dreamed of being an adventurer myself. But then I took an arrow to the knee and now I'm stuck in the city.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
我真的很喜歡冒險者！
我曾經夢想自己也能成為冒險者。但後來我膝蓋中了一箭，現在只能困在城市裡了。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
If you're okay with it, could you browse some items while telling me your adventure stories?
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
如果你不介意的話，能不能一邊瀏覽商品，一邊給我講講你的冒險故事？

scripts.text: I came for a different story.
scripts.translation: 我是來聽別的故事的。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
A different story?
Hmm, about Amodipin's salary? Did Amodipin ask you to talk about it?
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
別的？
嗯，是關於阿莫迪頻的薪水嗎？阿莫迪頻讓你來打聽這個？

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Well, Amodipin may know about it, but the shop's situation isn't good.
I promised to pay it all at once next month, but using my favorite adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
雖然阿莫迪頻可能知道，但店裡的情況並不好。
我答應下個月一次性付清，但我可是用著我最喜歡的冒險者呢。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Is it fair to hide behind someone else's back like that?
You seemed to be good at your job so I hired you, but maybe I should reconsider hiring natives.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
躲在別人背後這樣做公平嗎？
我看你工作挺不錯的才僱了你，但也許我該重新考慮一下，還是僱原住民比較好。

scripts.text: What do you mean by that?
scripts.translation: 你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Oh, don't worry about it, adventurer. It's an old ritual problem with the natives.
They're weak and like to hide behind others.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
哦，別擔心，冒險者。這只是原住民的老毛病。
他們軟弱，喜歡躲在別人身後。

scripts.text: Still, withholding wages is wrong
scripts.translation: 即便如此，拖欠工資也是不對的

scripts.text: Isn't that discrimination?
scripts.translation: 這不是歧視嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Who doesn't know that? Even if you know, if there's no money, what can you do?
Well, Amodipin's salary is the last to be paid. But that can't be helped.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
誰不知道呢？就算知道，沒錢又能怎麼辦？
好吧，阿莫迪頻的薪水是最後發的。但這也沒辦法。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
It's not discrimination against the natives.
It's just that he's the last one to come in, so the order goes like that.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
這不是對原住民的歧視。
只是因為他最後才來，所以順序就是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
Ah, why do I have to talk only about this with adventurers?
Tell Amodipin to put the salary in tomorrow and stop this nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
啊，為什麼和冒險者在一起只能聊這些？
告訴阿莫迪頻明天把薪水拿來，別再搞這種無聊的事了。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
I won't discipline you for this incident, but please tell <NAVI>[Amodipin]<INFO>rachel,181,51,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to come to work properly.
I'm not someone who discriminates against natives, but they lack responsibility, so if I scold them, I might just leave it at that.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
這次的事我不追究你的責任，但請告訴<NAVI>[阿莫迪頻]<INFO>rachel,181,51,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>好好來上班。
我並不是歧視原住民，但他們缺乏責任感，如果我要批評他們，可能也就那樣了。

scripts.text:
[Dahil]
I am currently running the shop, but I really like adventurers!
I once dreamed of being an adventurer myself. But then I took an arrow to the knee and got stuck in the city.
scripts.translation:
[達希爾]
我現在正在經營這家店，但我真的很喜歡冒險者！
我曾經夢想自己也能成為冒險者。但後來我膝蓋中了一箭，只能困在城市裡了。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
I hope the situation calms down soon. Let's talk after you've organize some of your belongings.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
希望局勢能儘快平息。等你整理好一些物品後，我們再談。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Hello. It seems you may lack the experience to undertake my request at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
你好。看來你目前還缺乏足夠的經驗來接受我的委託。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Please come back to me after gaining a bit more training.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
請多接受一些訓練後再來找我。

scripts.text: - This quest is available for those level 170 and above. -
scripts.translation: - 此任務僅限170級及以上角色接受。-

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Hello, my name is Priest Junok.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
你好，我是牧師俊옥。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
This village has been divided into two factions, the natives and the immigrants, for some time now, leading to a state of confrontation.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
這個村莊已經分裂成兩派很久了，原住民和移民，導致了現在的對峙狀態。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Efforts to resolve the conflict between the two factions are ongoing, but clear results have not been achieved.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
雙方正在努力解決衝突，但至今尚未取得明確的結果。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Therefore, I would like you to approach each of them directly and find out what the issues are.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
因此，我希望你能直接去接觸他們，瞭解他們各自的問題所在。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Would you be able to have a conversation with them on my behalf? I find it difficult to leave my post.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
你能替我和他們談談嗎？我很難離開我的崗位。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Next Time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text:
[Junok]
I'm disappointed that you rejected me. My heart is in so much pain.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
你拒絕了我，這讓我很失望。我的心好痛。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Please talk to the specified 3 natives and 3 immigrants, and let me know the results afterward.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
請去和指定的3名原住民以及3名移民交談，之後告訴我結果。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
The list of people to talk to can be found in the quest window or mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
需要交談的人員名單可以在任務視窗或小地圖中找到。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Today, I have gathered enough information. If you need assistance again, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
今天，我已經收集了足夠的資訊。如果你還需要幫助，請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Sure, I'll check the atmosphere between the indigenous people and the immigrants today. If there's anything specific you need assistance with, feel free to let me know.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
好的，我今天會去了解一下原住民和移民之間的氛圍。如果你有任何具體需要幫助的地方，請隨時告訴我。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Then, I'll leave it to you. If you need any assistance, feel free to ask. Have a great day!.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
那麼，就交給你了。如果需要任何幫助，請儘管開口。祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Please come back after talking to the 3 natives and the 3 immigrants.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
請在與3名原住民和3名移民交談後回來。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
The list of people to talk to can be found in the quest window or on the mini-map.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
需要交談的人員名單可以在任務視窗或小地圖中找到。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Please have conversations with all 6 citizens and return afterward.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
請與所有6名市民交談，然後回來。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Is that so...
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
是嗎...

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It seems there is still a lot of resentment between them.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
看來他們之間還有很多怨恨。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It's worse than I expected. Hm... I wonder what can be done about this.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
比我想像的還要糟糕。嗯...我在想該怎麼辦才好。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Today, I have gathered enough information. If you need assistance again, please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
今天，我已經收集了足夠的資訊。如果你還需要幫助，請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Is that so...
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
是嗎...

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It seems there is still a lot of resentment between them.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
看來他們之間還有很多怨恨。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It's worse than I expected. Hm... I wonder what can be done about this.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
比我想像的還要糟糕。嗯...我在想該怎麼辦才好。

scripts.text:
[Junok]
It was helpful guidance..
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
很有幫助的建議...

scripts.text:
[Junok]
Thank you for your help. Please come again if you can assist tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[俊옥]
謝謝你的幫助。如果你明天還能幫忙，請再來。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
There was a big disturbance in the village not too long ago.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
不久前，村裡發生了一場大騷亂。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
A speaker was giving a speech on the theme of respecting the dignity of an ideal human, but it seems to have stirred up some of the audience instead.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
有位演講者正在發表關於尊重理想人格尊嚴的演講，但似乎反而激怒了一些聽眾。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
I also felt that the speech was not received as favorably as one would hope.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
我也覺得這場演講並沒有像人們期望的那樣受到歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
It was merely an idealistic narrative, detached from reality.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
那不過是一段脫離現實的理想主義敘述。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
A loud exchange of words occurred, and even physical confrontation seemed imminent, but bystanders managed to prevent it.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
現場爆發了激烈的爭吵，甚至差點發生肢體衝突，幸好被旁觀者阻止了。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
Well, if it doesn't affect me personally, I don't really mind.
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
嗯，只要不影響到我，我就無所謂了。

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
Have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text: - You have completed the conversation with Jarad. -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與傑拉德的對話。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 讓我們去找下一個人 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
Quietly...
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
安靜地...

scripts.text:
[Jarad]
I want to live without any trouble..
scripts.translation:
[傑拉德]
我想過沒有麻煩的生活...

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Hello, My name is Rohi.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
你好，我叫羅希。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
I was living in poverty without any suitable work until recently...
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
直到不久前，我一直過著貧困的生活，沒有合適的工作...

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Thanks to Dina, I was able work on building management work recently, allowing me to put food on the table.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
多虧了蒂娜，我最近得以從事建築管理工作，終於能填飽肚子了。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
However, from some point onward, the given working hours have increased, but there has been no increase in compensation for that.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
然而，從某個時間點開始，工作時間增加了，但報酬卻沒有相應增加。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Why is that happening? Even among immigrants, Dina is considered wealthy, so it doesn't seem like she would lack the funds to pay.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
為什麼會這樣？即使在移民中，蒂娜也被認為很富有，看起來她並不缺錢。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
I talked directly to Dina about the unfair aspect, but it was in vain.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
我直接找蒂娜談過這種不公平的情況，但毫無結果。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Even if they offer a lower salary, many people are willing to take the job, you know...
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
即使工資較低，也有很多人願意接受這份工作，你知道的...

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
I've decided to wait for now, as Maram and other senior members are currently discussing ways to address this issue and find a solution.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
我決定先等等，因為瑪拉姆和其他前輩目前正在討論如何解決這個問題並找到解決方案。

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
Thank you, I wish you a peaceful day as well!.
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
謝謝，也祝你度過平靜的一天！

scripts.text: - You concluded the conversation with Rohi -
scripts.translation: - 與羅希的對話結束 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 讓我們去找下一個人 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Rohi]
With so much work given today, I'm not sure if I can finish everything on time..
scripts.translation:
[羅希]
今天的工作量這麼大，我不確定能否按時完成...

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Hello, I'm called Jeojin.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
你好，我叫祖真。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
You could say I'm a native, having lived in this area since my ancestors' time.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
可以說我是本地人，從祖輩起就生活在這片區域。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
These days, there's been some noise due to friction with immigrants.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
最近，因為與移民之間的摩擦，有些嘈雜。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Some of them are wealthy, and among them, Dina, in particular, holds significant economic power.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
其中有些人很富有，特別是蒂娜，擁有相當的經濟實力。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Even among the native, I, who have a considerable amount of property, can't really compare with that person.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
即使在本地人中，像我這樣擁有相當財產的人，也無法與她相比。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
They've begun to influence the native business district, and policies are being shaped in their favor, making my business gradually more difficult.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
他們開始影響本地商業區，政策也向他們傾斜，讓我的生意越來越難做。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
At that time, Dina proposed to purchase some of the buildings I own. I'm not sure what to do.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
當時，蒂娜提議購買我名下的一些建築。我不知道該怎麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Well then, have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
那麼，祝你度過愉快的一天。

scripts.text: - You've finished the conversation with Jeojin. -
scripts.translation: - 與祖真的對話結束 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Jeojin]
Hmm... What should I do
scripts.translation:
[祖真]
嗯...我該怎麼辦

scripts.text:
[Squain]
Hello~~
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
你好~~

scripts.text:
[Squain]
Thank you so much for the job.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
非常感謝這份工作。

scripts.text:
[Squain]
You don't have to depend on others anymore!
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
你不再需要依賴別人了！

scripts.text:
[Squain]
If I get paid, I'd like to change the clothes I'm wearing first.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
如果拿到報酬，我想先換掉身上穿的衣服。

scripts.text:
[Squain]
There have been many people's help...
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
之前有很多人幫助過我...

scripts.text:
[Squain]
Now I will become a person who can help others.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
現在，我要成為一個能幫助別人的人。

scripts.text:
[Squain]
Then enter carefully.
scripts.translation:
[斯誇因]
那麼，請小心進入。

scripts.text: - Finished the conversation with Squain. -
scripts.translation: - 與斯誇因的對話結束 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next contact. -
scripts.translation: - 讓我們尋找下一個聯絡人。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Senado]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
Senado is someone who has trained in martial arts for over 20 years.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
塞納多是一位練習武術超過20年的人。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
I've been traveling to various villages to test the strength of my accumulated martial arts skills. After breaking many dojos, I settled here in Rachel quite a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
我一直在各個村莊旅行，以檢驗我多年積累的武術功底。在打倒了許多道場之後，我很久以前就定居在拉赫了。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
However, lately, I've sensed that the atmosphere in this village is not quite right.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
不過，最近我感覺到這個村莊的氣氛不太對勁。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
It seems that people are divided into two factions and engaged in a confrontation, a conflict between the natives and immigrants...
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
看來人們分成了兩派，正在發生衝突，是原住民和移民之間的對立...

scripts.text:
[Senado]
In a strict sense, I belong to the natives. However, I don't want to be part of this confrontation.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
嚴格來說，我屬於原住民。但是，我不想捲入這場衝突。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
I have no interest in their power struggle.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
我對他們的權力鬥爭不感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Senado]
Then let's meet again next time.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
那麼，下次再見。

scripts.text: - I have finished the conversation with Senado. -
scripts.translation: - 與塞納多的對話結束 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 讓我們去找下一個人 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Senado]
Whether native or immigrant...
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
無論是原住民還是移民...

scripts.text:
[Senado]
I don't know why they are so divided and arguing.
scripts.translation:
[塞納多]
我不知道他們為什麼如此分裂並爭吵不休。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
Hello, they call me Trader Japer..
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
你好，他們叫我商人賈珀。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
I believe I have exceptional business skills compared to anyone else. That's how I've reached my current position.
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
我相信我的商業才能比任何人都出色。正是憑藉這一點，我才達到了現在的位置。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
Certainly, the prosperity of the nation is not possible without dedicated individuals like me fulfilling their roles diligently, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
當然，沒有像我這樣盡職盡責的人，國家的繁榮是不可能的，你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Japer]
Moreover, by establishing a significant merchants' association, I've been able to provide employment opportunities for many indigenous residents living in Rachel..
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
此外，通過建立龐大的商人協會，我讓許多居住在拉赫的原住民獲得了就業機會。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
I see, it seems that there's currently a lot of tension and conflict between the immigrants and the native, especially with growing dissatisfaction towards me.
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
看來，目前移民和原住民之間存在著很大的緊張和衝突，尤其是他們對我的不滿情緒日益增長。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
It seems that the current working conditions are not satisfactory, and there's a sense of dissatisfaction, thinking that without me, they might not have had those job opportunities in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
似乎目前的工作狀況令人不滿意，他們感到不滿，認為如果沒有我，他們可能根本不會有這些工作機會。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
I am trembling because of the native people who are not only ungrateful but also filled with a sense of victimhood
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
那些不僅忘恩負義，還充滿受害者心態的原住民讓我感到不寒而慄。

scripts.text:
[Japer]
So, until next time then..
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
那麼，下次再見。

scripts.text: - You've finished talking to Japer -
scripts.translation: - 與賈珀的對話結束 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 讓我們去找下一個人 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Japer]
I was able to accumulate wealth by sticking to my own methods
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
我憑藉自己的方法積累了財富

scripts.text:
[Japer]
They are misunderstanding me.
scripts.translation:
[賈珀]
他們誤解了我。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
I am Japer disciple, Shiroan.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
我是賈珀的信徒，白安。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
I have always followed Japer.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
我一直追隨賈珀。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
His excellent business skills are truly something to learn from.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
他出色的商業才能確實值得學習。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
However, sometimes he forces things too much.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
不過，有時候他太固執己見了。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
As a result, conflicts with the native he employed increased
scripts.translation:
[白安]
結果，與他僱傭的原住民之間的衝突增加了

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
He is so stubborn that he doesn't listen to me... It's worrisome.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
他太固執了，不聽我的勸...讓人擔心。

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
Then I hope you have a peaceful day.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
那麼，祝你度過平靜的一天。

scripts.text: - I have finished the conversation with Shiroan. -
scripts.translation: - 與白安的對話結束 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 讓我們去找下一個人 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Shiroan]
I hope Japer stops arguing.
scripts.translation:
[白安]
希望賈珀能停止爭吵。

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Hello, nice to meet you. I'm Isira. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
你好，很高興見到你。我是伊希拉。有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isira]
I am a faithful follower of Freyja.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我是弗蕾雅忠實的信徒。

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Is the atmosphere among the believers tense lately?
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
最近信徒之間的氣氛很緊張嗎？

scripts.text:
[Isira]
I wasn't aware of it, but it seems that the tension between the native and immigrants has escalated recently, judging by the current situation.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我對此並不知情，但看來最近原住民和移民之間的緊張局勢升級了，從目前的狀況來看。

scripts.text:
[Isira]
The land, already rugged, was transformed into a fertile field through the grace of the goddess, providing a path for sustenance and life...
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
這片土地原本崎嶇不平，但在女神的恩澤下變成了肥沃的田野，提供了生存和生活的道路...

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Shouldn't we be grateful instead??
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我們難道不應該感恩嗎？？

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Despite that, the recent disturbance that occurred a while ago... sigh...
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
儘管如此，最近發生的一些騷亂...唉...

scripts.text:
[Isira]
I'm not sure what exactly is causing the dissatisfaction.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我不太清楚具體是什麼導致了這種不滿。

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Then, have a peaceful day.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
那麼，祝您度過平靜的一天。

scripts.text: - The conversation with Isira has concluded. -
scripts.translation: - 與伊希拉的對話結束了。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 讓我們去找下一個人 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Isira]
Thanks to the immigrants, the benefits received by the natives must be significant...
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
多虧了移民，原住民獲得的利益應該相當可觀...

scripts.text:
[Isira]
I don't really understand why they're acting like that.
scripts.translation:
[伊希拉]
我真的不明白他們為什麼那樣做。

scripts.text:
[Dina]
Hello, what brings you here??
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
你好，有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dina]
Ah~ It seems there are various rumors circulating about me in a negative light, right?
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
啊~ 看來最近關於我的負面傳聞不少呢，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Dina]
I hope you don't only think about the parts you heard from.
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
希望你不要只憑道聽途說就下結論。

scripts.text:
[Dina]
To accumulate the wealth I have now, I have always acted strategically and pragmatically.
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
為了積累現在的財富，我一直都在策略性地、務實地行動。

scripts.text:
[Dina]
It's regrettable to hear various negative stories recently, considering that we have a contractual relationship based on mutual understanding..
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
考慮到我們之間基於相互理解的契約關係，最近聽到各種負面故事真是令人遺憾...

scripts.text:
[Dina]
If it's about the building acquisition, I plan to maintain the current position..
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
如果是關於建築收購的事，我打算維持目前的立場...

scripts.text:
[Dina]
It's a process of rightfully gaining profit. Saying anything against this would be unreasonable..
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
這是正當獲取利潤的過程。對此提出反對是不合理的...

scripts.text:
[Dina]
Wishing you a good day!.
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text: - I have finished the conversation with Dina. -
scripts.translation: - 與蒂娜的對話結束了。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next person -
scripts.translation: - 讓我們去找下一個人 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

scripts.text:
[Dina]
Oh well, I don't know why I'm the only one dealing with this.
scripts.translation:
[蒂娜]
唉，真不知道為什麼只有我在處理這些事。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Hello, this is Jafer's wife Hari.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
你好，我是賈菲爾的妻子哈里。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Because of his fiery nature, sometimes when an accident occurs, I take care of the rearrangement.a person who does.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
因為他脾氣火爆，有時候發生事故後，都是由我來善後處理。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
I suffered a lot because there was no compromise on the wage increase for the natives.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
因為原住民的工資問題沒有達成妥協，我受了很多苦。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Actually, I didn't think there was any need for a raise, but I hated fighting with my husband more.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
其實我覺得沒必要漲工資，但我更討厭和丈夫吵架。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Anyway, I'm glad there seems to be some compromise.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
總之，很高興看到似乎達成了一些妥協。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
I want you to be quiet now.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
現在請保持安靜。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
Then just go inside~
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
那就進去吧~

scripts.text: - Conversation with Hari is over. -
scripts.translation: - 與哈里的對話結束。 -

scripts.text: - Let's find the next contact. -
scripts.translation: - 讓我們尋找下一個聯絡人。 -

scripts.text: - You have completed conversations with all 6 individuals. Let's return to Junok -
scripts.translation: - 你已完成與所有6個人的對話。讓我們回到俊옥那裡 -

Hello, this is Hari.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
你好，我是哈里。

scripts.text:
[Hari]
She is the stubborn and unyielding lady in front of me.
scripts.translation:
[哈里]
她是我面前這位固執且不肯讓步的女士。

scripts.text:
[Camper]
I couldn't find a job, and I kept failing my exams, so I left home in a fit of rage...
Then I stumbled upon a place like this.
I'm planning to stay here for a little while.
scripts.translation:
[露營者]
我找不到工作，考試也總是失敗，一氣之下就離家出走了...
然後我偶然發現了這樣一個地方。
我打算在這裡住一段時間。

scripts.text:
[Camper]
Aren't you scared?
The old timers who asked me when I was going to get a job and everytime I meet them are way scarier.
...
scripts.translation:
[露營者]
你不害怕嗎？
那些老傢伙問我什麼時候去找工作，每次見到他們我都覺得更可怕。
...

Oh, I heard you said it was peaceful, so you did my favor.
Thank you.

scripts.translation:

哦，聽說你說這裡很和平，真是幫了我的大忙。
謝謝你。
來吧，我把我的東西給你。
^4d4dff灰狼村的村民們已經接納你成為村莊的一員了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Oh, I heard you said it was peaceful, so you did my favor.
Thank you.
Come on, I'll give you what I have.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
哦，聽說你說這裡很和平，真是幫了我的大忙。
謝謝你。
來吧，我把我的東西給你。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Are you going to the village?
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你要去村莊嗎？

scripts.text: To the Grey Wolf Village
scripts.translation: 前往灰狼村

scripts.text: Don't go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Make Grey Wolf Forest safer
scripts.translation: 讓灰狼森林更安全

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Alright. You need to go through the gap between those trees.
Follow me.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
好的。你需要穿過那些樹之間的縫隙。
跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Okay then. How about hunting some monsters nearby?
They were too noisy when I was trying to sleep.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
那麼，要不要去附近打些魔物？
我睡覺的時候它們太吵了。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
As you can see, I'm the gate keeper.
I also drive away any unwanted visitors.
Usually, I disguise myself as a vagabond, but I'm not actually one.
Don't you dare think of me as one!
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你看，我是這裡的守門人。
我也負責趕走不速之客。
通常我會偽裝成流浪漢，但我其實不是。
千萬別把我當成流浪漢！

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
No, no. I wouldn't ask for a favor right after meeting you.
The forest may be a bit dangerous, but it's alright.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
不，不。剛見面我就提要求，那太失禮了。
森林雖然有點危險，但還過得去。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Um... it'll be fine for a while.
It's been a threat to some extent, so if they think about it, they won't attack.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
嗯...暫時應該沒事。
它們在一定程度上是個威脅，所以如果它們想通了，就不會攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
As you can see, I'm guarding the entrance here.
Sometimes monsters come all the way here and bother me even though I'm tired.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你看，我在這裡守著入口。
有時候魔物會一直跑到這裡來打擾我，儘管我很累。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Would you clear about thirty monsters in the nearby forest regardless of the type?
I have some beautiful amethyst fragments I found lying around. I'll give them to you.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
你能在附近的森林裡清除大約三十隻魔物嗎？種類不限。
我有一些漂亮的紫水晶碎片，是撿到的。我會把它們給你。

scripts.text: Accept the request
scripts.translation: 接受請求

scripts.text: Refuse
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
I see... You're someone who doesn't care about the safety of a poor gatekeeper's life...
Got it. I'll sincerely remember this deep in my heart.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
原來如此...您竟然不在乎一個可憐守門人的安危...
明白了。我會深深銘記這份恩情。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Thank you!
Now I can relax and unwind a bit!
I'll leave it to you then.
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
謝謝您！
這下我可以稍微放鬆一下了！
那就拜託您了。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper]
Anything's fine. Just hunt some monsters nearby.
That way, I can stand guard more safely too, right?
scripts.translation:
[守門人]
什麼都行。只要在附近的森林裡打些魔物就好。
這樣我也能更安心地站崗，對吧？
